ld.articleBody:
Box Office Milestone in North America

The documentary You Can See Everything has made waves at the North American box office, officially securing a place inside A24's all-time top ten highest-grossing domestic films. Its strong theatrical run has captured widespread attention from industry analysts and moviegoers alike.

With momentum continuing to build, the feature is steadily climbing higher on prestigious studio leaderboards, marking a notable commercial triumph for the distributor.

Second Weekend Surge and Screen Count

During its second weekend in theaters, the documentary pulled in an impressive $19.5 million domestically. This figure represents a robust 25% increase compared to its initial opening weekend performance.

Fueling this impressive growth, the film was granted 1,800 additional screens across North America following its strong debut week, directly contributing to its sustained ticket sales.

Ten-Day Gross and Weekend Breakdown

Over a span of just ten days, the feature's total North American box office earnings reached a cumulative $45.1 million, according to data from Box Office Mojo.

The second three-day weekend saw a steady daily intake, kicking off with $6.1 million on Friday, rising to $6.9 million on Saturday, and closing out the weekend with $6.4 million on Sunday.

Standing Among A24 All-Time Grossers

Sitting at number ten on A24's all-time domestic list, You Can See Everything trails just behind Primetime, which holds a domestic gross of $46.5 million.

Industry projections suggest the documentary could finish its theatrical run with a domestic haul between $90 million and $100 million, potentially catapulting it into the top three highest-grossing A24 releases of all time.

Documentary Rankings and History

Beyond its success within the studio's catalog, the film stands as the third highest-grossing documentary of all time domestically.

Furthermore, it has achieved the distinction of becoming the third highest-grossing non-music documentary in cinematic history.

Premise and Release Details

The documentary begins thirty-four days prior to the imprisonment of notorious Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes, tracking her as she invites a skeptical film crew to document her daily life.

What begins as an intimate look into her world ultimately expands into a complex, three-year narrative journey. The film was officially released to theaters on October 16.

News Overview

The A24 documentary You Can See Everything has entered the studio's top ten domestic grossers following a strong second weekend. Totaling $45.1 million over ten days, the feature continues to perform exceptionally well in North American theaters.

ld.articleBody:
The Unprecedented Pre-Release Momentum of Dhurandhar 2

Ranveer Singh's upcoming feature has firmly established its dominance as an extraordinary theatrical phenomenon long before opening night. Built upon the tremendous momentum generated by its predecessor, the sequel commanded immense eagerness from audiences across the country.

This high level of enthusiasm directly translated into staggering pre-release ticket purchases at the Indian box office, setting a remarkably high standard for upcoming cinematic projects.

Breaking Opening-Day Advance Sales Records

Ahead of its premiere, the action-heavy sequel shattered expectations by comfortably surpassing the fifty-crore milestone in gross advance collections for its first day, even when accounting for record paid previews.

Such formidable pre-sale numbers positioned the film as a towering benchmark that subsequent theatrical releases would find exceedingly difficult to challenge or eclipse.

Ramayana Enters the Box Office Race

Among the prominent challengers anticipated to threaten this ticket-sales record was the heavily anticipated project starring Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Yash.

Produced on an exceptionally grand scale and recognized as one of the most expensive Indian motion pictures ever made, the mythological epic carried extraordinarily high expectations from trade analysts and fans alike.

Comparing the Advance Booking Figures

Despite immense initial curiosity surrounding the star-studded cast and its historical subject matter, recent ticketing data indicates that the film will likely fall short of the benchmark established by its rival.

Reports show that the epic has sold roughly 523 thousand tickets on BookMyShow two days prior to its premiere, whereas the competing sequel had already moved approximately 1.1 million passes at the exact same timeframe.

Projected Collections Fall Behind

In terms of monetary value, the grand-scale epic has generated approximately 24 crore rupees through initial Day 1 pre-sales at the domestic box office.

Industry estimates project that its final advance figures will ultimately settle between 32 and 37 crore rupees, leaving it trailing significantly behind the 50-crore opening-day gross recorded by the Ranveer Singh starrer.

Legacy of the Dhurandhar Franchise

With the mythological contender failing to match these pre-release metrics, the extraordinary ticketing record set by the sequel appears secure through the year 2026.

The blockbuster outing highlights the unmatched commercial appeal and audience pull commanded by the franchise, further solidifying its status as a monumental success in modern cinema.

News Overview

Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar 2 continues to maintain its box office supremacy by outperforming Ranbir Kapoor's Ramayana in advance ticket bookings. While the ambitious epic led by Kapoor has generated substantial pre-release figures, it remains considerably behind the fifty-crore opening-day benchmark set by the Dhurandhar sequel.

ld.articleBody:
Rising Discontent in the Tower

The atmosphere inside the Rise And Fall 2 Tower reaches a boiling point following recent power moves and ranking decisions. Contestants find their long-standing bonds tested as strategic choices open up new fractures among the inhabitants.

Old loyalties are severely questioned, and bruised egos dictate daily interactions. The fallout from Gautam Gulati's rankings and Shehzad Poonawalla's decision to send Manish Kashyap and Sonam Malik to the Basement reverberates across every corner of the house.

Fallout Over Basement Demotions

Sonam Malik feels deeply betrayed by Gautam Gulati, who defends his choice as a necessary step for the benefit of the Penthouse and its Rulers. His explanations fail to pacify her, while the Rulers' attempts to calm the Workers only breed further suspicion downstairs.

Down in the quarters, the Workers perceive the Rulers' conciliatory gestures as a veiled threat. With Manish Kashyap and Sonam confined to the Basement, every single contestant now feels the looming threat of nomination hanging over their heads.

Swara and Shehzad Clash Openly

Friendships continue to fracture as Swara Bhasker confronts Shehzad Poonawalla for failing to save her, reminding him that she previously came to his rescue twice. The conversation quickly escalates into a full-scale argument touching upon their complicated equations with Gautam Gulati.

Karan Patel points out the risky nature of their political gambles, but Shehzad remains defensive. The verbal sparring intensifies when Shehzad brings up Swara's past voting choices, prompting her to retort by bringing up past grievances from outside the show.

Virender Sehwag Raises the Stakes

Host Virender Sehwag arrives to heighten the tension within the Tower, bringing major twists and turning points ahead of the grand finale. He officially awards Manish Kashyap the title of King of the Basement to shake up the dynamics.

Sehwag also puts Shehzad on the spot by offering him an opportunity to hand over his final ticket to another contestant, since Shehzad had previously expressed a desire to leave the Tower. Shehzad ultimately selects Swara, leading the host to playfully label it as damage control.

Triple Eviction Threat Looms

Six Workers find themselves directly under the eviction cloud: Priyanka Chahar Choudhary, Jashwanth Bopanna, Sonam Malik, Manish Kashyap, Rishabh Jaiswal, and Niharika Tiwari. The audience steps in to save Priyanka and Niharika.

This leaves Manish, Jashwanth, Rishabh, and Sonam squarely on tenterhooks as the triple eviction twist approaches its climax. Every remaining contestant must now brace for the unpredictable powerplay outcomes.

Audience Reactions and Scrutiny

Virender Sehwag brings external audience comments and reactions directly into the Tower to spotlight past rivalries and questionable decisions. Gautam and Priyanka are called in first to review their previous showdown and Priyanka's controversial decision to shift the prize pot to six lakh rupees.

The host warns Gautam that his harsh Gauti persona could ultimately cost him the trophy if he is not careful. Later, Sehwag strongly objects when Shehzad refers to Priyanka as a vamp during a discussion, demanding that he retract the remark.

Production and Streaming Details

Produced by Banijay Asia and hosted by Virender Sehwag, Rise And Fall 2 continues to stream fresh daily episodes at twelve noon. Viewers can watch the reality series free and exclusively on Prime Video.

The show is additionally accessible through MX Player by Prime Video across Android devices, mobile platforms, connected televisions, the Amazon shopping app, and Fire TV.

news:15zymm2.k: SZA Vans collaboration, VANSZA collection, Knu Skool Mule, Authentic Kickdown, SZA artistic director, SZA VANSZA Crew Socks, VANSZA Crew Socks, SZA, Sage Adams VANSZA Crew Socks, entertainment news

ld.articleBody:
The Artistic Partnership

SZA has officially teamed up with the renowned skate brand Vans, stepping into the role of the company's very first artistic director. This partnership unites the distinct creative vision of the artist with the classic aesthetic of the heritage footwear brand.

The resulting collaborative effort introduces a fresh line of merchandise that blends everyday comfort with distinct outdoor motifs, giving fans a chance to wear pieces that mirror the singer's personal style.

Reimagined Footwear Highlights

The collection features two distinct sneaker styles that have been given a custom overhaul. The Knu Skool Mule takes the classic nineties silhouette and converts it into a backless slip-on complete with a sculpted heel.

Additionally, the Authentic Kickdown introduces a distressed canvas upper decorated with fish-print artwork created by artist Sage Adams, alongside a collapsible heel that allows the shoe to easily transition into a mule.

Workwear and Outerwear Pieces

Drawing inspiration from nature and utilitarian design, the apparel line includes standout garments like the Hunting Vest, which features a bold safety-orange lining and cargo pockets.

Other notable items include the Denim Hunting Jacket and a creative trompe l'oeil crewneck fleece printed to visually mimic a heavily worn work jacket while maintaining soft sweater comfort.

Cozy Essentials and Winter Gear

For colder weather, the capsule offers matching lounge pieces such as the Bug Out Hoodie and matching Bug Out Sweatpants, built for relaxed days and chilly mornings.

Layering options also extend to a thermal-lined Flannel Hoodie equipped with elbow patches and a quilted interior for extra warmth.

Accessories and Graphic Tees

Everyday staples in the lineup include fitted graphic items like the Baby Tee and a loose-fit short-sleeve shirt showcasing original artwork by Sage Adams and custom branding.

Accessories such as the Snapback Hat featuring RealTree camo flames and crew socks round out the accessories portion of the release.

Pants and Bottoms Selection

The bottom wear selection leans heavily into utilitarian and cargo trends, featuring Multi-Pocket Denim Pants with a vintage wash.

Pants options also feature the Parachute Pant, which incorporates ripstop material, hidden stash pockets, and an adjustable drawstring waistband.

News Overview

SZA has joined Vans as their first-ever artistic director to launch the new VANSZA capsule collection. The line features footwear like the Knu Skool Mule alongside various workwear-inspired apparel items and accessories currently available while supplies last.

ld.articleBody:
Passing of a Television Icon

Hollywood has lost a cherished matriarch of the small screen following the death of veteran actress Barbara Barrie at the age of 95. Her representative issued a statement confirming that the performer passed away inside her Manhattan home. She chose to utilize end-of-life care permitted under the New York State Medical Aid in Dying statute, a regulation she had actively supported and championed during her later years.

The celebrated performer had been facing a terminal cancer diagnosis prior to her peaceful passing surrounded by medical assistance. Her career spanned decades of memorable television and film projects, earning her deep admiration from colleagues and audiences alike who remembered her warmth and incredible versatility across various genres.

Acclaimed Film and Stage Career

ld.articleBody:
A Historic Pre-Release Milestone

Shah Rukh Khan's highly anticipated film King has achieved an unprecedented feat even before hitting theaters. The upcoming movie has secured a landmark overseas theatrical rights agreement, commanding a massive valuation that sets a brand new benchmark across the Indian film industry.

While southern Indian cinema has dominated domestic markets extensively in recent years, this massive international agreement proves that Shah Rukh Khan's star power abroad remains unmatched. The deal cements the project as one of the most commercially anticipated global releases of the year.

The Record-Breaking Phars Films Agreement

According to industry reports, Phars Films has acquired the international theatrical distribution rights for King at a staggering 175 crore rupees, which exceeds 18 million dollars. Previously, international rights for Shah Rukh Khan's ventures were predominantly handled by Yash Raj Films, which successfully distributed both Pathaan and Jawan in 2023.

Phars Films brings extensive global distribution experience to the table, having previously partnered with Yash Raj Films on multiple projects and independently handling the distribution of Prabhas's film Saaho. The 175 crore rupee figure represents a minimum guarantee amount, surpassing the 100 crore rupee threshold for the first time in Indian cinema history.

Financial Breakdown and Break-Even Targets

A minimum guarantee commitment of this magnitude highlights the immense confidence distributors hold in the theatrical potential of the feature. In international markets, distributors typically retain about 50 percent of the total box office collections, meaning King will need to generate substantial revenue to break even.

To clear its financial hurdles, the movie will need to pull in roughly 35 to 40 million dollars internationally, translating to approximately 350 to 375 crore rupees. For context, Shah Rukh Khan's previous blockbuster hits Pathaan and Jawan both crossed the 400 crore rupee mark in overseas territories.

Chasing International Benchmarks

Given the historic size of the minimum guarantee, turning a profit will require King to match or exceed the international milestones set by major hits like Dhurandhar 2 at 460 crore rupees or RRR at 430 crore rupees. These titles stand among the greatest international successes ever recorded by Indian cinema.

In addition to the international rights, separate reports indicate that Pen Marudhar has acquired the all-India distribution rights for 250 crore rupees. This continues a long-standing association with the actor's production house, following previous collaborations on Jawan, Dunki, Zero, Badla, and Ittefaq.

A High-Stakes Holiday Clash

Securing such high financial backing comes with heavy competition, as King is scheduled to premiere during the Christmas holiday season. The film faces a formidable box office showdown against massive Hollywood releases including Jumanji, Avengers: Doomsday, and Dune 3.

This high-profile scheduling creates one of the most intense competitive clashes in cinematic history. It offers the Bollywood superstar a major platform to demonstrate his enduring global dominance against top-tier international competition.

Star-Studded Cast and Crew

King features Shah Rukh Khan in the lead role and is directed by Siddharth Anand. This marks the second collaboration between the actor and director following their successful 2023 release Pathaan.

The supporting cast features Suhana Khan, Deepika Padukone, Abhishek Bachchan, Rani Mukerji, Jaideep Ahlawat, Raghav Juyal, and Saurabh Shukla. Notably, this project marks the first time Shah Rukh Khan shares the screen with his daughter Suhana Khan, who made her acting debut in 2023 with The Archies.

Release Details and News Overview

King is officially scheduled to open in cinemas worldwide on December 24, 2026.

Shah Rukh Khan's upcoming film King has set a historic benchmark by selling its overseas theatrical rights to Phars Films for 175 crore rupees ahead of its December 24 release. Backed by a high-stakes minimum guarantee, the action entertainer directed by Siddharth Anand must match legendary international earners like RRR and Dhurandhar 2 while navigating a massive holiday box office clash.

ld.articleBody:
Global Theatrical Launch and Scale

Nitesh Tiwari’s highly anticipated cinematic adaptation, 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend', has officially commenced its theatrical journey across India and international markets. Mounted as a massive two-part epic, the production has generated extraordinary pre-release anticipation, widely regarded as one of the most expensive cinematic ventures ever attempted in the country.

Produced by Namit Malhotra, the project has been brought to life with a reported overall budget of Rs 4,000 crore, with the first installment accounting for Rs 2,000 crore. The release strategy encompasses multiple languages, tailoring the runtime and distribution to appeal to both domestic and worldwide audiences.

Stellar Cast and Character Interpretations

The film features an ensemble cast led by Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Goddess Sita, and Yash in the role of the antagonist Ravana. Producer Namit Malhotra praised Ranbir Kapoor’s dedication and talent, describing him as the finest actor of the current generation.

Supporting cast members have also shared insights into their preparations. Rakul Preet Singh portrays Ravana's sister Surpanakha, aiming to highlight the multi-layered and complex nature of the character. Meanwhile, Sunny Deol steps into the role of Lord Hanuman, noting that his screen time develops further in the second part of the epic.

Advance Bookings and Box Office Projections

The theatrical rollout is supported by robust pre-release sales. According to Sacnilk, the film secured Rs 49.75 crore gross in opening-day advance bookings within India, including block seats. Overseas advance ticket sales contributed approximately USD 5.6 million, pushing the total worldwide advance-booking collections beyond Rs 150 crore gross.

Trade analysts project an opening-day collection ranging between Rs 75 crore and Rs 100 crore across languages. Long-term industry forecasts suggest a potential lifetime box-office haul spanning from Rs 1,000 crore to Rs 3,000 crore, alongside ambitious international targets.

Promotional Scale and International Targets

According to reports from trade tracker Venky Box Office, Prime Focus Studios and Sony Pictures allocated a USD 10 million promotional and marketing budget, establishing a record for an Indian production. The distribution strategy sets its sights on achieving at least USD 65 million in international theatrical revenues.

North America serves as a primary overseas market, with targeted collections of USD 30 million. The production's global reach is further augmented by alternate language versions, such as a shortened English edit tailored for international viewing preferences.

Yash's Approach and Industry Collaboration

Actor Yash discussed his immersive preparation for playing Lankesh, explaining that he played loud Lord Shiva chants on set to maintain the character's intense emotional headspace. He also emphasized that an undertaking of this magnitude requires solidarity across every regional sector of the Indian film industry.

Yash joined the project not only as an actor portraying Ravana but also as a co-producer following discussions with Namit Malhotra regarding a unified vision to take Indian cultural stories to a worldwide audience.

Industry Support and Critical Anticipation

Renowned filmmaker SS Rajamouli expressed his public support for the production, commending the team for bringing the mythological narrative to life with significant depth and visual scale. Rajamouli noted that adapting the epic remains a lifelong aspiration for many Indian storytellers.

Early viewer reactions have focused on the scale of the visual effects, Yash's intense performance as Ravana, and the distinct interpretation of the timeless source material as the global theatrical run unfolds.

ld.articleBody:
A Familiar Routine and a Surprising Discovery

As the story picks up following a narrative time skip, Yoo-jin remains deeply comfortable within Professor Lee's personal space, taking care of his plants and handling his apartment with ease. During a conversation about mathematics, the professor hands her a slip of paper containing Min-jae's new telephone number from the United States.

Instead of keeping the contact information, Yoo-jin angrily discards it out the window, offering a bitter curse toward her former partner. This strong reaction heavily implies that Min-jae was the one who originally chose to end their relationship, leaving deep emotional scars that have yet to heal.

An Accidental Connection and Drunk Dialing

A drunken Yu-seong stumbles across the discarded telephone number outside Yoo-jin's house and decides to call the foreign digit. Operating without his usual mental filters, he bumbles through the conversation before learning a critical piece of information: Min-jae has completed his post-doc and is heading back to Seoul.

Realizing the magnitude of his mistake, Yu-seong scrambles to cover his tracks and seeks help from Soo-bin to keep Yoo-jin from discovering his late-night interference. Meanwhile, the perpetual eavesdropper Se-jin overhears the plans, setting off a chain reaction of gossip across the campus.

Professor Lee Gestures and Growing Affection

Professor Lee struggles to keep his professional boundaries intact as his feelings for Yoo-jin continue to deepen. Returning from overseas, he quietly stores a bracelet and a set of couple rings away in his nightstand, hinting at unspoken romantic intentions.

When Professor Ahn suggests a collaborative project between departments, he easily notices how the professor's demeanor brightens at the mention of Yoo-jin. ld.articleBody:
The Passing of a Sci-Fi Legend

The entertainment industry is mourning the loss of legendary actor Patrick Stewart, who passed away on Wednesday at his home in Los Angeles. He was 86 years old at the time of his death.

His longtime spokesperson, Kelly Bush Novak, revealed that the star had been experiencing a brief and poignant journey with Alzheimer's disease and Lewy body dementia. Family and friends surrounded him with live music, prayer, tears, and laughter during his final moments.

Defining Professor X on the Big Screen

Stewart anchored the original live-action X-Men franchise adapted from Marvel comic books for 20th Century Fox. He debuted as Professor Charles Xavier in the inaugural 2000 film, bringing immense gravitas and dignity to the mutant leader.

He reprised the iconic character across multiple sequels including X2: X-Men United, X-Men: The Last Stand, and X-Men: Days of Future Past, as well as making memorable appearances in the Wolverine standalone projects and the critically acclaimed Logan.

Tributes From Fellow Mutants and Co-Stars

Co-star Hugh Jackman, who portrayed Wolverine alongside Stewart, took to social media to express his heartbreak. Jackman noted that he lost a tremendous friend and mentor who taught him invaluable lessons about the craft of acting.

Rebecca Romijn, the original actress behind Mystique, shared her reflections on working with Stewart across two decades. She recalled his booming theatrical voice and wonderful sense of humor, celebrating his status as a classically trained Shakespearean great.

Memories From Star Trek and Television

Famke Janssen, who worked with Stewart on both Star Trek: The Next Generation and the X-Men franchise where she played Jean Grey, remembered him as an absolute legend. She highlighted her early experiences opposite him when she portrayed Kamala to his Captain Picard.

Kelsey Grammer also offered heartfelt recollections of collaborating with Stewart on the X-Men movies where Grammer played Beast. Grammer praised Stewart's unforgettable guest appearance on the hit sitcom Frasier during its eleventh season.

Marvel Studios and Kevin Feige Honor His Legacy

Marvel Studios head Kevin Feige shared his deep admiration for the actor, recalling the awe he felt seeing Stewart step onto the original X-Men set. Feige emphasized the actor's warm charm, quiet strength, and profound mentorship of younger talent.

Marvel Studios released an official statement recognizing the extraordinary grace and humanity Stewart brought to Professor Charles Xavier. The studio noted his lasting impact on generations of fans worldwide.

Final Cinematic Appearances

Beyond his decades of television and film history, Stewart was slated to appear in Marvel's upcoming project Avengers: Doomsday. His involvement in the feature will bring back several original Fox-era cast members.

His enduring presence in contemporary blockbusters cemented a career that bridged classic theatrical training with massive commercial success in science fiction cinema.

Co-stars, industry executives, and fans worldwide have shared heartfelt tributes celebrating his monumental contributions to the X-Men and Star Trek franchises.

ld.articleBody:
Milestone Reached Before Theatrical Debut

Namit Malhotra's upcoming film Ramayana: Part One has officially crossed the fifty crore gross threshold in cumulative advance ticket sales across India. This major pre-release milestone arrives with three days left on the clock before the Nitesh Tiwari directorial officially arrives in theaters on November 5, 2026. Industry trackers noted that the robust pre-sales are being driven by a strong expansion in bookings stretching well beyond the opening day.

As additional cinema halls and screening slots come online, interest has heavily gravitated toward subsequent days like Saturday. The final phase of pre-sales is widely expected to set the stage for what could be a massive Diwali opening weekend for the big-budget epic.

Detailed Breakdown of Pre-Sale Numbers

According to the latest tracking data from early November 2026, the film generated approximately 49.75 crore gross including blocked seats. This figure accounts for nearly 11.87 lakh tracked tickets distributed across 37,685 shows spanning 1,738 cinemas nationwide. Factoring in additional Sunday bookings pushed the cumulative advance tally comfortably past the fifty crore mark.

A closer examination of the scheduled checkpoints reveals that Thursday, November 5 leads the charge with ₹25.94 crore from 6.05 lakh tickets. Friday, November 6 follows with ₹13.44 crore from 3.19 lakh tickets, while Saturday, November 7 has currently secured ₹10.28 crore from 2.62 lakh tickets.

Surging Momentum for Saturday Screenings

Saturday has quickly emerged as one of the most fascinating narratives in the current booking trend. Early in the week, the advance gross for Saturday stood at a modest 6.50 crore, but that figure climbed sharply to 10.25 crore by the afternoon checkpoint, representing a surge of roughly 56 percent.

This rapid upward trajectory is being supported by expanding show availability and fresh seat allocations across multiple regions. With Sunday's figures still awaiting separate reflection in these specific checkpoints, the movie retains substantial room to expand its overall weekend advance figures further.

Language Dominance and Regional Trends

In terms of linguistic contribution, the Hindi version continues to command the lion's share of the pre-sales, capturing approximately 84 percent of the total gross. The Kannada version stands second with roughly 9 percent, while the Telugu version accounts for 5 percent of the overall collections.

Regionally, Maharashtra leads the state-level figures with over 10.50 crore in gross collections. Delhi follows closely with 7.50 crore, and Karnataka records 7.30 crore, all figures inclusive of blocked seats. Meanwhile, Telangana is demonstrating notably stronger occupancy rates than several larger Hindi-speaking markets, whereas Tamil-language bookings remain comparatively subdued.

Impact of Premium Formats

Specialized premium formats are playing a vital role in elevating the value of Ramayana's advance bookings. Screenings across IMAX, 4DX, Dolby Cinema, ICE, and EPIQ have collectively pulled in approximately 9.50 crore gross including blocked seats.

Remarkably, these high-end formats account for about 19 percent of the total advance revenue despite representing only 2 percent of the tracked shows. While this highlights the immense revenue-generating capacity of premium screens, standard 2D and 3D formats will ultimately dictate the movie's broader, mass-market reach.

Pre-Release Foundation and Outlook

The achievement of crossing the fifty crore milestone before the final booking rush underscores a powerful pre-release foundation for the mythological project. Stakeholders are now watching closely to see how effectively this early momentum translates into continuous box office dominance during the festive window.

The final outcome will heavily depend on the ongoing pace of fresh ticket purchases, theater availability, and overall audience reception during the vital Diwali holidays, which will determine just how high the opening weekend figures can climb.

Global Premiere in Los Angeles

The much-anticipated mythological epic Ramayana: Rise of a Legend celebrated its grand worldwide debut in Los Angeles, drawing immense attention from fans and media alike. The main cast members gathered to launch the project internationally through an exclusive red carpet event.

Attendees and admirers caught the very first glimpses of the ambitious project during this major introductory phase held abroad.

Red Carpet Appearances by the Lead Stars

Ranbir Kapoor arrived at the venue dressed in a sparkling silver bandhgala while greeting supporters outside. Yash stepped onto the carpet alongside his wife Radhika Pandit, wearing a dark outfit paired with sunglasses and a detailed brooch, while Radhika wore a green and gold silk saree.

Sai Pallavi completed the main trio's look by opting for a red zardosi saree with detailed embroidery, keeping her styling simple and traditional.

Venue and Screening Details

The special 3D presentation took place at the David Geffen Theatre, situated within the Academy Museum of Motion Pictures. This initial viewing was strictly restricted to invited guests.

Social media feeds featured packed screening rooms filled with both domestic and international attendees waiting to witness the footage.

Notable Attendees and Interactions

Beyond the primary cast and crew, several notable figures from the entertainment industry joined the festivities. Jada Pinkett Smith, Rohini Iyer, Benji Kelly, and Gisella Marengo were among those spotted at the gathering.

Highlights from the red carpet included a warm embrace shared between Ranbir Kapoor and Yash in front of photographers.

Production Background and Creative Team

Nitesh Tiwari serves as the director of the film, with Namit Malhotra taking on production duties. The narrative adapts the classic ancient Indian epic for modern cinema audiences.

The central plot centers on the exile of Rama, the abduction of Sita by Ravana, and the subsequent confrontation representing the victory of righteousness over malevolence.

Cast and Release Schedule

The extensive star-studded cast features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Sunny Deol as Hanuman, and Ravie Dubey as Lakshman. Additional supporting performers include Anupam Kher, Kajal Aggarwal, Rakul Preet Singh, Vivek Oberoi, Kunal Kapoor, Adinath Kothare, Arun Govil, Indira Krishnan, and Lara Dutta.

The theatrical rollout is scheduled globally for October 5, followed by paid preview screenings starting on November 4.

News Overview

The primary cast of Ramayana: Rise of a Legend attended an exclusive invite-only global premiere in Los Angeles. The event featured red carpet appearances by the lead actors alongside international celebrities prior to the film's upcoming theatrical release.

ld.articleBody:
Official Arrival Confirmed

The wait for Salman Khan fans is finally drawing to a close as the official release schedule for the upcoming feature has been locked. Industry followers have tracked the project through various phases, and the latest confirmation places the theatrical premiere squarely in the current month.

Cinemas across the nation will welcome the big-budget presentation in just two weeks on Friday, November 20. The final schedule dispels earlier industry chatter and gives eager audiences a definitive date to mark on their calendars.

From Galwan To Maatrubhumi

The cinematic project underwent significant changes during its developmental journey, most notably a title alteration. Originally announced under the working title Battle Of Galwan, the production was later rechristened as Maatrubhumi earlier this year.

The narrative itself draws direct inspiration from the tense 2020 border dispute between India and China. Because of sensitive political undertones and changing bilateral dynamics, the project faced hurdles regarding its script and references to the neighboring country.

Censor Board Hurdles And Delays

Getting the feature across the finish line proved challenging due to bureaucratic steps with regulatory authorities. Initial plans by producers pointed toward an earlier November 13 theatrical debut, but delays in securing a proper censor certificate pushed those targets back.

Following discussions and necessary reviews, the makers briefly evaluated potential dates in late November or mid-December. Fortunately, clearance from the government and finalization by the Central Board of Film Certification resolved the logjam.

Trailer Launch And Censor Details

The official confirmation of the theatrical calendar arrived during a promotional event held on the afternoon of November 6. Exhibited at a suburban Mumbai multiplex, the grand trailer launch proudly displayed the locked release date to assembled media and fans.

According to official board records, the promotional cut was cleared on Wednesday, November 4. It secured a U/A 16+ certification and runs for an extensive duration of four minutes and forty-three seconds.

Cast And Musical Milestone

Headlining the war-themed drama is superstar Salman Khan, supported by an ensemble that includes Chitrangda Singh in a prominent role. The theatrical venture also boasts major backing through Jio Studios, which has taken charge of nationwide distribution.

Beyond his acting duties, the leading man has achieved a personal milestone with this project. He returns to playback singing after an absence of eleven years, lending his voice to a track titled 'Teri Sexy Beauty'.

News Overview

The Salman Khan-starrer Maatrubhumi has officially locked its theatrical release date for November 20 following clearance from the Central Board of Film Certification and the government. The war drama, which was previously known as Battle Of Galwan, features Chitrangda Singh and is distributed nationwide by Jio Studios.

ld.articleBody:
The Inaugural Cut Week Arrives

Viewers are bracing for a massive shakeup on the popular reality singing competition as the series introduces its first-ever Cut Week. Bypassing traditional intermediate stages, this unique format serves as the sole bridge connecting the earlier battle rounds directly to upcoming live performances.

Under the new guidelines, coaches find themselves managing seven artists each. While two contestants on every team automatically secure their advancement to the live broadcasts, the remaining five must fiercely battle over a single open spot, ultimately narrowing the field down to the final twelve hopefuls.

Schedule and Time Slot Adjustments

Fans tuning in must make note of a permanent timing shift for the series. Moving forward, the program shifts to a Monday slot beginning at 9:00 p.m. Eastern Time.

This adjustment accommodates the scheduling returns of two network comedies, St. Denis Medical and The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins, which occupy the preceding hour from 8:00 to 9:00 p.m. ET.

Broadcast Details for Monday Night

The special episode, designated as Season 30, Episode 11 and titled Cut Week, is scheduled to broadcast on Monday, November 2. The extended broadcast runs from 9:00 to 11:00 p.m. ET.

Following this intense elimination event, the competition transitions entirely into weekly live shows leading directly up to the grand season finale.

Traditional Cable and Cord-Cutting Options

Traditional television viewers can catch the broadcast live using standard cable credentials through NBC or via the official network website and mobile application.

Audiences who have eliminated traditional cable subscriptions can utilize alternative live television streaming platforms. Services such as DIRECTV, fuboTV, Hulu + Live TV, YouTube TV, and Sling TV offer access to the live NBC feed, with several providers offering introductory free trials for new sign-ups.

Streaming on Peacock

In a major first for the current season, episodes receive a simultaneous broadcast on Peacock, allowing fans to watch the event as it airs digitally.

Additionally, full episodes become available for next-day streaming on the platform. Subscribers can choose between the ad-supported Premium tier or the commercial-free Premium Plus option, with annual billing discounts also available.

Alternative Ways to Access Peacock

Viewers looking for trial access can subscribe to Peacock Premium Plus through Prime Video to utilize a seven-day promotional period not offered directly through the platform itself.

Another alternative involves utilizing Instacart+, which bundles a complimentary subscription to the streaming service as part of its membership perks.

News Overview

The Voice introduces its inaugural Cut Week with a special two-hour episode airing on Monday, November 2, from 9:00 to 11:00 p.m. ET on NBC due to a schedule shift for network comedies. Fans can watch the historic elimination round live on television, via live-streaming platforms, or stream the program on Peacock.

ld.articleBody:
The Controversy Surrounding Vijay Sethupathi's Emmy Announcement

Actor Vijay Sethupathi is preparing to represent Indian cinema as a presenter at the upcoming 54th International Emmy Awards. The ceremony is scheduled to take place in New York on November 23, generating considerable excitement among his followers.

However, this announcement triggered a widespread debate after several media reports labeled him as the very first Indian to present an award at the prestigious international event. This specific claim quickly drew objections from members of the Indian television fraternity.

Prerna Wanvari Speaks Out on Social Media

Reacting to an online report on Instagram, actor Prerna Wanvari publicly challenged the assertion that Vijay Sethupathi holds a unique first-time distinction. She pointed out that multiple Indian television personalities had already walked that stage years prior.

Wanvari explicitly referenced fellow industry members, noting that previous pioneers paved the way long before the current headlines were written, thereby questioning the accuracy of the recent media statements.

Recalling Earlier Indian Presenters at the Emmys

In a follow-up interaction with Indian Television Dot Com, Wanvari elaborated on the historical timeline of Indian participation at the global ceremony. She emphasized that while Sethupathi's involvement is worthy of celebration, earlier contributions must not be erased.

According to her detailed recollections, Simone Singh presented at the International Emmys in 2003, followed by Aashka Goradia in 2009. Wanvari herself presented the Arts Programming award at the 40th International Emmy Awards in 2012.

Origins of the 'First Indian Presenter' Claim

The narrative describing Vijay Sethupathi as the first Indian presenter originated from a report published by The Hollywood Reporter India. The coverage mistakenly overlooked past precedents set by actors from the television sector.

This oversight sparked discussions regarding the depth of research behind entertainment journalism, bringing much-needed attention back to the historical milestones achieved by Indian artists on global platforms.

Broader Indian Representation at the 54th Edition

Aside from the presenter debate, the 54th International Emmy Awards will feature notable Indian content competing across multiple categories. This highlights a growing footprint for South Asian talent on the international stage.

SonyLIV's project 'Real Kashmir Football Club' has earned a nomination in the Best Drama Series category. Simultaneously, Vir Das' Netflix comedy special 'Fool Volume' is actively contending for the Best Comedy Series prize.

Legacy of Indian Television Personalities Globally

The ongoing discourse has successfully shed light on the enduring legacy of Indian television actors who represented the nation at the international event in previous decades. Figures like Singh, Goradia, and Wanvari established an important international presence long before recent mainstream shifts.

Industry observers note that acknowledging these past milestones ensures accurate historical records for future generations of artists venturing into worldwide entertainment arenas.

News Overview

Prerna Wanvari challenged reports calling Vijay Sethupathi the first Indian International Emmy presenter by recalling earlier appearances by Simone Singh, Aashka Goradia, and herself. While Sethupathi prepares for the upcoming ceremony in New York, Indian projects like 'Real Kashmir Football Club' and 'Fool Volume' also compete for honors.

The Grand Unveiling of the Eetha Trailer

Maddock Films and Kathputli Creations have officially launched the highly anticipated trailer for their upcoming cinematic project titled Eetha. The preview offers audiences an immediate glimpse into an epic musical drama that traces the remarkable trajectory of a true legend.

At the center of this grand production is actress Shraddha Kapoor, who takes on the titular role of Eetha Bai. The newly revealed footage showcases her transformation into an iconic figure of Lavani, setting the stage for a theatrical release scheduled for December 4, 2026.

Stepping Into the Vibrant World of Eetha Bai

The newly released trailer transports viewers directly into the rich and visually striking universe inhabited by Eetha Bai. It highlights a narrative where raw ambition routinely clashes with severe adversity, turning human passion into an engine of power.

Every single performance depicted in the preview emphasizes themes of deep courage and unwavering conviction. The footage relies heavily on evocative musical compositions, striking visual aesthetics, and intense emotional displays to build anticipation.

Celebrating an Extraordinary Artistic Legacy

The cinematic narrative draws profound inspiration from the real-life journey of a Lavani legend who systematically defied societal conventions. She fought against overwhelming odds to carve out a permanent place in history.

By focusing on her resilience, the film aims to celebrate the unyielding spirit of an artist whose impact spans across generations. The project positions itself as a grand spectacle specifically tailored for the big screen experience.

A Distinctive Role for Shraddha Kapoor

Taking on the character of Eetha Bai marks one of the most distinctive and demanding acting assignments of Shraddha Kapoor's career thus far. The actress anchors the sweeping saga with a commanding presence visible throughout the preview.

Her portrayal invites moviegoers to witness a deeply compelling story of triumph over obstacles, executed through a performance designed to leave a lasting impression on cinema audiences.

The Creative Minds Behind the Camera

The film brings together a dedicated crew committed to delivering a larger-than-life storytelling experience. Directorial duties are handled by Laxman Utekar, who also serves as a producer alongside Dinesh Vijan.

The backing of major banners like Maddock Films and Kathputli Creations underscores the considerable scale and ambition of this musical biographical drama.

Release Details and Anticipation

Fans eagerly awaiting the film's debut can mark their calendars for December 4, 2026, when Eetha officially arrives in cinemas. The combination of its lead star, musical elements, and historical inspiration has quickly made it a major talking point.

As promotional materials continue to roll out, the project stands out as a unique entry in contemporary Indian cinema, blending musical grandeur with biographical drama.

Shraddha Kapoor Transforms Into a Lavani Icon in the New Trailer for Eetha

Maddock Films and Kathputli Creations have released the grand trailer for the epic musical drama Eetha, starring Shraddha Kapoor as the legendary Eetha Bai.

Published 30 October 2026

The Grand Unveiling of the Eetha Trailer

Maddock Films and Kathputli Creations have officially launched the highly anticipated trailer for their upcoming cinematic project titled Eetha. The preview offers audiences an immediate glimpse into an epic musical drama that traces the remarkable trajectory of a true legend.

At the center of this grand production is actress Shraddha Kapoor, who takes on the titular role of Eetha Bai. The newly revealed footage showcases her transformation into an iconic figure of Lavani, setting the stage for a theatrical release scheduled for December 4, 2026.

Stepping Into the Vibrant World of Eetha Bai

The newly released trailer transports viewers directly into the rich and visually striking universe inhabited by Eetha Bai. It highlights a narrative where raw ambition routinely clashes with severe adversity, turning human passion into an engine of power.

Every single performance depicted in the preview emphasizes themes of deep courage and unwavering conviction. The footage relies heavily on evocative musical compositions, striking visual aesthetics, and intense emotional displays to build anticipation.

Celebrating an Extraordinary Artistic Legacy

The cinematic narrative draws profound inspiration from the real-life journey of a Lavani legend who systematically defied societal conventions. She fought against overwhelming odds to carve out a permanent place in history.

By focusing on her resilience, the film aims to celebrate the unyielding spirit of an artist whose impact spans across generations. The project positions itself as a grand spectacle specifically tailored for the big screen experience.

A Distinctive Role for Shraddha Kapoor

Taking on the character of Eetha Bai marks one of the most distinctive and demanding acting assignments of Shraddha Kapoor's career thus far. The actress anchors the sweeping saga with a commanding presence visible throughout the preview.

Her portrayal invites moviegoers to witness a deeply compelling story of triumph over obstacles, executed through a performance designed to leave a lasting impression on cinema audiences.

The Creative Minds Behind the Camera

The film brings together a dedicated crew committed to delivering a larger-than-life storytelling experience. Directorial duties are handled by Laxman Utekar, who also serves as a producer alongside Dinesh Vijan.

The backing of major banners like Maddock Films and Kathputli Creations underscores the considerable scale and ambition of this musical biographical drama.

Release Details and Anticipation

Fans eagerly awaiting the film's debut can mark their calendars for December 4, 2026, when Eetha officially arrives in cinemas. The combination of its lead star, musical elements, and historical inspiration has quickly made it a major talking point.

As promotional materials continue to roll out, the project stands out as a unique entry in contemporary Indian cinema, blending musical grandeur with biographical drama.

ld.articleBody:
A Surprising Streaming Phenomenon

The World War II survival thriller Lucky Strike has rapidly climbed to the top of streaming charts, securing the number one film position on Hulu. Following its arrival on the platform, the feature managed to capture a massive audience despite fierce competition from horror features and Halloween-themed programming.

This sudden surge in viewership marks a remarkable turnaround for the project. Although it struggled significantly during its theatrical release, home audiences have embraced the title, demonstrating that traditional war dramas still hold substantial appeal in the modern digital landscape.

Plot and Setting

Set against the backdrop of the historic Battle of the Bulge, the narrative follows John Castle, an American soldier cut off from his unit after a botched operation. Left behind enemy lines, he must navigate treacherous European terrain while evading hostile German forces.

With a standard military radio serving as his solitary lifeline, Castle attempts to reestablish contact with allied troops. While SS soldiers actively hunt him down, the protagonist relies entirely on his basic training and scarce resources to disrupt enemy movements and survive.

Cast and Character Focus

The production features performances by Scott Eastwood, Colin Hanks, Aunjanue Ellis-Taylor, and Taylor John Smith. However, Eastwood shoulders the majority of the dramatic burden, taking center stage throughout the runtime.

Unlike many contemporary war projects that rely heavily on large ensemble casts, this film narrows its perspective tightly onto the struggles of a single individual. This focused approach highlights personal endurance and isolation over massive tactical troop movements.

Connections to Cinematic Classics

Observers have naturally drawn comparisons between this modern release and Steven Spielberg's acclaimed Saving Private Ryan. While Spielberg's classic famously opens with the chaotic intensity of the Omaha Beach invasion before shifting to a small squad's mission, both stories explore similar themes of ordinary people facing extraordinary peril.

An interesting connection links the two projects: Lucky Strike stars Colin Hanks, whose father, Tom Hanks, played a leading role in the 1998 war masterwork. Despite differing scales, both features understand that powerful narratives often stem from individual acts of bravery.

Box Office Struggles and Mixed Reviews

The path to streaming success was unconventional for the production, which originally opened in cinemas. During its domestic theatrical run, it brought in a modest total of approximately $1.5 million.

Critics offered mixed assessments upon its initial premiere. While reviewers generally commended the combat sequences and action beats, some pointed out that the script leaned too heavily on familiar genre tropes and predictable storytelling elements.

Enduring Appeal of War Dramas

The unexpected popularity of the film decades after the conclusion of World War II proves that viewers remain intensely fascinated by historical accounts of courage. Audiences continue to seek out stories centered on duty, sacrifice, and survival under extreme pressure.

Ultimately, this digital comeback highlights how modern viewing platforms can breathe new life into titles that missed out on box-office glory. Poor theatrical returns no longer spell the absolute end for a project's potential to find an appreciative audience.

News Overview

The World War II survival drama Lucky Strike has become the number one film on Hulu after debuting on the platform. Despite struggling at the box office and receiving mixed reviews following its theatrical release, the Scott Eastwood-led feature has successfully found a major second life through streaming.

news:17jioxt.d: Rajinikanth's action thriller Jailer 2 maintains a strong global standing, surpassing the Rs 823 crore mark worldwide by its twenty-second day in theatres.
news:17jioxt.k: Jailer 2 box office collection, Rajinikanth Jailer 2 earnings, Jailer 2 worldwide collection, Jailer 2 Tamil Telugu collection, Rajinikanth Jailer 2, Jailer 2, Rajinikanth, Nelson Dilipkumar Jailer 2, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
Global Milestone and Worldwide Earnings

The theatrical run of Jailer 2 has achieved notable commercial success on a global scale. Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, the action-heavy venture has powered past the significant threshold of Rs 823 crore in gross worldwide collections after completing twenty-two days at the box office.

While international territories have provided substantial support to the overall tally, domestic earnings have experienced a gradual deceleration following a remarkably strong opening phase.

Domestic Collections and Earnings Breakdown

Within the domestic market, the movie has accumulated a net total of Rs 467.65 crore across various regions. Total domestic gross figures currently stand at Rs 546.95 crore following twenty-two days of theatrical screenings.

Meanwhile, international markets have contributed an impressive Rs 276.50 crore, which pushes the combined worldwide gross earnings to a grand total of Rs 823.45 crore.

Strong Opening Week Performance

The theatrical journey began with a high-performing opening week that established a solid foundation for the feature film. During its first eight days at ticket windows across the country, the Rajinikanth vehicle secured Rs 334.35 crore in net domestic earnings.

Domestic gross figures reached Rs 391.55 crore during that initial stretch. This strong early momentum played a pivotal role in driving total global collections closer to the massive Rs 800 crore milestone.

Subsequent Weekly Slowdown

Following the initial surge, box office collections witnessed a noticeable downward correction in the weeks that followed. Between days nine and fifteen, the title brought in Rs 95.55 crore net domestically, which represented a 71.4 percent decline compared to the opening week.

The downward trajectory continued into the third week as the film added another Rs 37.75 crore to its domestic net total, marking a further 60.5 percent drop from the preceding weekly figures.

Language-Wise Contribution and Regional Reach

An examination of language-specific earnings highlights how the picture performed across different state boundaries. The original Tamil version dominates domestic collections with Rs 323.73 crore, accounting for 69.2 percent of the net total.

The Telugu market emerged as a vital secondary contributor by adding Rs 85.65 crore, representing 18.3 percent of domestic earnings. Hindi language screenings contributed Rs 50.15 crore, while the Kannada version added Rs 8.12 crore.

Overseas Strength and Plot Background

International markets accounted for roughly 33.6 percent of the total worldwide revenue, helping offset the slowdown observed in Indian theatres. The narrative itself centers on Tiger Muthuvel Pandian, a retired jailer played by Rajinikanth, whose peaceful routine is disrupted by a fresh criminal threat.

Across its first twenty-two days in cinemas, the production recorded a total of 2,47,034 screenings nationwide while maintaining its position as one of the major commercial performers of the year.

News Overview

Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 has crossed Rs 823 crore in worldwide gross collections by its twenty-second day in theatres. Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, the film recorded strong domestic net earnings led primarily by the Tamil and Telugu language markets alongside a significant contribution from overseas territories.

ld.articleBody:
Los Angeles World Premiere and Review Embargo

The first wave of international reviews for the high-profile epic Ramayana has officially arrived following a grand world premiere in Los Angeles. The review embargo for the film lifted on a recent Friday night, allowing a select group of international publications to share their initial assessments.

The movie features a star-studded cast including Ranbir Kapoor and Yash. While anticipation for the project has been immense, the first batch of critiques provides a nuanced look at how the cinematic adaptation of the classic epic is being received abroad.

Praise for Visuals and Production Value

Despite mixed feelings regarding the plot, several critics heaped high praise on the technical execution and grand scale of Ramayana. Reviewers highlighted the ambitious production design and visual effects as major highlights of the cinematic experience.

Avi Offer of NYC Movie Guru commended the feature as a visually dazzling action adventure backed by strong set and costume design. Similarly, Screen Rant awarded the film a 7 out of 10, calling it an impressive achievement on a purely visual and technical level.

IndieWire and Other Critical Perspectives

IndieWire awarded the production a 'B', describing it as an epic that successfully achieves its goal of delivering the highest possible production value. However, the reviewer noted that the final product occasionally lacks a distinct voice to make it uniquely memorable.

Other publications were less forgiving of the storytelling choices. Some critics felt the heavy reliance on high-end production overshadowed the character depth, leaving certain elements of the narrative feeling mechanical rather than organic.

Criticism of Length and Stuffed Narrative

Even though the English version of Ramayana runs nearly half an hour shorter than the Indian cut, the two-and-a-half-hour runtime failed to satisfy several early reviewers. Complaints centered around a bloated and exhausting narrative structure.

Some international critics described the viewing experience as emotionally hollow and overly cluttered. One reviewer bluntly compared the theatrical format unfavorably against grand serialized television productions.

Comparisons to Television Formats

The sheer density of the mythological material prompted discussions on whether a traditional feature film format was the ideal medium. Reviewers suggested that the sprawling plotlines required significantly more room to breathe.

Next Best Picture remarked that the movie might have worked better as a television adaptation akin to Game of Thrones, allowing the narrative to flesh out its extensive cast and world fully instead of feeling overly stuffed.

Harsh Critiques and Technical Missteps

Among the tougher assessments, IGN handed out a lower score of 4 out of 10. The review pointed to clunky action sequences, subpar computer-generated imagery, and awkward artificial intelligence lip-syncing as drawbacks.

Furthermore, these critical reviews emphasized that this installment represents only the first part of a larger planned cinematic journey, leaving certain structural resolutions for future entries.

Cast, Crew, and Release Details

Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Ravie Dubey as Lakshman, and Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman. The project is produced by Namit Malhotra’s Prime Focus Studios alongside DNEG and Yash’s Monster Mind Creations.

The film is structured as a two-part release. The first part is slated to arrive globally on November 5, with paid previews in the United States set for November 4, while the second part is scheduled for a Diwali 2027 release. Sony Pictures handles international distribution outside India, and Dharma Productions distributes in the Hindi market.

News Overview

International reviews for the Ranbir Kapoor and Yash-starrer Ramayana have emerged following its premiere in Los Angeles. While critics widely applauded the film's dazzling visuals and high production scale, they raised concerns about its exhausting and overstuffed narrative.

ld.articleBody:
Introduction to Physical Craftsmanship

While modern mythological epics lean heavily onto computer-generated effects, Ramayana also relied on intricate physical builds crafted entirely by hand. Art director Ramesh Andhale recently shed light on the meticulous work invested in bringing specific legendary items to life for the big screen.

Rather than depending solely on digital wizardry, the production team constructed tangible set pieces that required months of specialized labor. These physical assets formed a critical part of establishing the distinct visual tone of the cinematic world.

Yash's Golden Throne

Among the most talked-about physical assets is the massive seat designed specifically for Yash in his portrayal of Ravana. Reports indicate that this opulent throne required a four-month construction timeline and totaled an expense of approximately Rs 1 crore.

The stunning visual appeal of the seat came from the application of 24-karat melted gold and gold leaf finishes. This luxurious treatment aimed to capture the supreme wealth and power expected of the king of Lanka.

The Creation Process of the Throne

Constructing the grand seat was not a direct process, as the art department began by shaping a precise clay model to finalize every intricate detail and measurement. Once the initial prototype received approval, the final structure was built using durable fibre materials.

This methodical workflow accounted for the extensive duration required to complete the prop. Every single phase of development needed strict quality checks before the team could transition to the next step.

Rakul Preet Singh's Surpanakha Chariot

In addition to the monarchical seating, art director Ramesh Andhale detailed the creation of a specialized vehicle assigned to Rakul Preet Singh's character, Surpanakha. Even though the prop features in just a single sequence, the construction process lasted three full months.

This gold-plated transport carried a reported price tag of Rs 1.15 crore, placing its total cost slightly higher than the grand throne built for Yash. The significant investment underscored the meticulous planning behind minor scenes.

Functional Engineering on Set

Building the transport presented unique hurdles for the design crew because the vehicle needed to be fully operational on location. Aesthetics alone were insufficient, as the structure had to function smoothly during live filming sessions.

Engineering a working vehicle while maintaining an extravagant appearance added substantial complexity to an already demanding timeline. The team successfully blended mechanical utility with high-end cinematic design.

Scale and Critical Reception

The staggering financial resources and hours poured into props that appear briefly on screen demonstrate the immense dedication of the art department. Such deep attention to tangible detail helped anchor the mythical atmosphere of the project.

Early reviews for the feature have largely commended its striking visuals and the extensive effort invested in crafting the mythological environment. Furthermore, critics highlighted Yash as a major standout, praising his commanding presence as Dashanan.

Rather than depending solely on digital wizardry, the production team constructed tangible set pieces that required months of specialized labor. These physical assets formed a critical part of establishing the distinct visual tone of the cinematic world.

Yash's Golden Throne

Among the most talked-about physical assets is the massive seat designed specifically for Yash in his portrayal of Ravana. Reports indicate that this opulent throne required a four-month construction timeline and totaled an expense of approximately Rs 1 crore.

The stunning visual appeal of the seat came from the application of 24-karat melted gold and gold leaf finishes. This luxurious treatment aimed to capture the supreme wealth and power expected of the king of Lanka.

The Creation Process of the Throne

Constructing the grand seat was not a direct process, as the art department began by shaping a precise clay model to finalize every intricate detail and measurement. Once the initial prototype received approval, the final structure was built using durable fibre materials.

This methodical workflow accounted for the extensive duration required to complete the prop. Every single phase of development needed strict quality checks before the team could transition to the next step.

Rakul Preet Singh's Surpanakha Chariot

In addition to the monarchical seating, art director Ramesh Andhale detailed the creation of a specialized vehicle assigned to Rakul Preet Singh's character, Surpanakha. Even though the prop features in just a single sequence, the construction process lasted three full months.

This gold-plated transport carried a reported price tag of Rs 1.15 crore, placing its total cost slightly higher than the grand throne built for Yash. The significant investment underscored the meticulous planning behind minor scenes.

Functional Engineering on Set

Building the transport presented unique hurdles for the design crew because the vehicle needed to be fully operational on location. Aesthetics alone were insufficient, as the structure had to function smoothly during live filming sessions.

Engineering a working vehicle while maintaining an extravagant appearance added substantial complexity to an already demanding timeline. The team successfully blended mechanical utility with high-end cinematic design.

Scale and Critical Reception

The staggering financial resources and hours poured into props that appear briefly on screen demonstrate the immense dedication of the art department. Such deep attention to tangible detail helped anchor the mythical atmosphere of the project.

Early reviews for the feature have largely commended its striking visuals and the extensive effort invested in crafting the mythological environment. Furthermore, critics highlighted Yash as a major standout, praising his commanding presence as Dashanan.

Art director Ramesh Andhale revealed that a custom 24-karat gold throne for Yash cost Rs 1 crore and took four months to build for Ramayana. Additionally, a functional gold-plated chariot for Rakul Preet Singh cost Rs 1.15 crore and took three months to complete for a brief scene.

ld.articleBody:
Digital Announcement of the 26th IIFA Winners

The International Indian Film Academy published the complete winners list for its 26th edition through its official social media channels. Organizers chose to disclose the triumphant films, performers, and technical creators ahead of the physical celebrations.

This digital reveal granted cinema enthusiasts an early glimpse into which projects captured audience and jury favor throughout the entertainment calendar.

Dhurandhar Secures a Record-Breaking 12 Trophies

Aditya Dhar's espionage action feature emerged as the undisputed titan of the evening, securing a massive total of 12 awards spanning popular, creative, and technical domains.

The project triumphed in categories such as Best Film, Best Director for Aditya Dhar, and Best Original Story, reflecting its overarching dominance across the board.

Ranveer Singh and Aneet Padda Earn Top Acting Prizes

The leading acting accolades went to prominent stars for their acclaimed performances in major theatrical releases. Ranveer Singh secured the trophy for Best Actor in a Leading Role.

Meanwhile, Aneet Padda triumphed in the Best Actress category for her widely discussed work in a major romantic drama released earlier in the theatrical cycle.

Saiyaara Shines Bright Across Musical and Romantic Categories

Mohit Suri's directorial venture made waves by capturing multiple major music and performance honours. The romantic drama resonated deeply with audiences through its emotional core and commercial triumph.

Playback singers and lyricists associated with the project were duly recognized for crafting some of the most memorable tracks of the year.

Streaming Projects Lead the Digital Awards Segment

The digital categories celebrated outstanding work originating from various streaming platforms and web series formats. High-profile productions took home top honours for web series and digital feature films.

Creators and actors working within the digital ecosystem received recognition for expanding the scope of contemporary storytelling.

Upcoming Live Ceremony and Broadcast Details

While winners were unveiled online, the physical celebration is slated to take place at the Etihad Arena located on Yas Island in Abu Dhabi. The main gala and digital awards events will unfold across consecutive dates.

Global fans will be able to stream the main festivities live via YouTube, while regional television broadcasts will cater to audiences within India through official partnerships.

news:184h51d.d: Wicker: Starring Olivia Colman, the adult comedy is poised to surpass Jason Statham’s Shelter as Black Bear’s highest-grossing domestic release.
news:184h51d.k: Wicker box office, Olivia Colman Wicker, Black Bear domestic release, Shelter Jason Statham, Wicker, Olivia Colman, Jason Statham Wicker, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
Box Office Performance

The adult comedy Wicker is currently outperforming many previous releases from Black Bear that featured prominent Hollywood stars. Industry tracking indicates that the film is on track to surpass the domestic haul of Jason Statham's Shelter, establishing itself as the studio's biggest hit at the North American box office in the year 2026.

Due to its strong commercial traction, the feature has also secured a significant expansion in screen time across North America.

Crossing the Ten Million Mark

Headlined by Olivia Colman, the movie has successfully crossed the $10 million threshold at the North American box office, reaching a total of $10.6 million according to Box Office Mojo data.

The theatrical footprint for the feature expanded substantially, growing from 1,471 theaters to 2,374 locations across the region.

Second Friday Record

On its second Friday, the film brought in $1.4 million at the North American box office. This figure marked a modest decline of just 39.6% compared to its opening Friday earnings.

Industry records confirm this performance stands as the biggest second Friday ever recorded in the history of the Black Bear studio.

Weekend Projections and Shelter Comparison

Current industry estimates project that the feature will earn between $3.5 million and $4.5 million over the three-day weekend in North American cinemas.

For context, Shelter was released earlier in the year and finished its domestic run with a gross of $12.8 million. The current trajectory places Wicker firmly on course to exceed that number.

Studio Profitability

This milestone cements Wicker as Black Bear's biggest domestic success and represents the studio's first major hit at the North American box office. Data regarding the film's overseas collections remains unavailable.

The studio acquired the North American rights for the film at a modest cost of $2.5 million, rendering the venture highly profitable.

Plot and Premise

Directed by Alex Huston Fischer and Eleanor Wilson, the story follows an ostracized fisherwoman who hires a local basketmaker to weave a husband for her.

When her wicker creation turns out to be unexpectedly extraordinary, his sudden arrival generates jealousy and turmoil that threatens the peace of their quiet village.

Cast and Release Details

The movie features a notable ensemble cast including Olivia Colman, Alexander Skarsgård, Elizabeth Debicki, Marli Siu, Nabhaan Rizwan, Richard E. Grant, and Peter Dinklage in key roles.

Wicker was officially released to audiences on October 23.

News Overview

Wicker is on track to surpass Jason Statham's Shelter to become Black Bear's highest-grossing domestic release, having crossed the $10.6 million mark in North America. Directed by Alex Huston Fischer and Eleanor Wilson and starring Olivia Colman, the profitable acquisition is achieving record-breaking second-weekend numbers for the studio.

ld.articleBody:

The K-pop landscape is buzzing as the talented vocalist Nayeon from the globally renowned girl group TWICE officially prepares to step back into the solo spotlight. Fans have eagerly awaited fresh material from the artist, and the announcement of her upcoming project has instantly electrified social media channels and fan communities worldwide.

This upcoming venture marks a major milestone in her career as she takes center stage independently once again, showcasing her distinct artistic growth and vocal prowess outside of group activities.

Unveiling NA-STY

The new solo project has been officially titled NA-STY, capturing a bold and intriguing aesthetic that has already begun to generate massive curiosity. With this upcoming release, the singer aims to present a fresh musical direction and visual concept that sets her apart from her previous work.

Listeners can expect high production values, catchy hooks, and memorable choreography that will undoubtedly define the upcoming musical season.

Baby Angel as the Title Track

At the core of the upcoming release is the newly unveiled lead single, titled Baby Angel. This track has been chosen to spearhead the promotional campaign and will serve as the primary window into the sonic universe of the project.

Anticipation is exceptionally high for the music video and promotional performances associated with the song, as the performer is well known for her charismatic stage presence and dynamic delivery.

A Long-Awaited Timeline

This upcoming release holds immense significance for supporters because it represents her first solo comeback in two years and five months. The extended hiatus between solo projects has only heightened the excitement surrounding every new detail revealed through the promotional scheduler.

The newly dropped scheduler outlines a comprehensive rollout of teasers, concept photos, and preview clips leading up to the official drop date.

The recently published scheduler provides a structured roadmap for the upcoming weeks, detailing exactly when fans can expect various promotional drops. Every update brings supporters one step closer to the full unveiling of the record.

As each phase of the timeline unfolds, public interest continues to surge, cementing her status as a powerhouse solo artist within the global music scene.

news:18643y9.d: Ramayana: Part One is gearing up for a special screening in Mumbai on November 3 following earlier premieres in Los Angeles and London.
news:18643y9.k: Ramayana Part One, Ranbir Kapoor Yash Ramayana, Ramayana Mumbai premiere, Ramayana advance booking, Mahi Pillai Ramayana: Part One, Ramayana: Part One, Mahi Pillai, Ranbir Kapoor Ramayana: Part One, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
Upcoming Mumbai Screening

Ramayana: Part One is scheduled for a special event in Mumbai before its official theatrical debut in India. The upcoming gathering serves as a dedicated screening for the project's cast and crew members along with invited industry guests.

A separate media screening has also been scheduled to follow the initial event, providing journalists and reviewers an opportunity to watch the production ahead of its wide theatrical launch.

Venue and Timeline Details

The Mumbai premiere is set to take place at Lower Parel's IMAX on November 3, with the media screening arranged for November 4. Organizers had initially considered the Nita Mukesh Ambani Cultural Centre for the gathering before ultimately deciding on the IMAX venue.

The theatrical release across India is officially scheduled for November 5, bringing the project to local audiences following weeks of promotional activity and international showcases.

International Screenings and Reactions

Prior to the Mumbai schedule, the film held its Los Angeles premiere on October 27, where audience reactions were noted as mixed. Following that event, a screening took place in London on November 1.

The London presentation specifically welcomed critics and members of the BAFTA jury to view the Hindi version of the production before its broader commercial rollout.

Advance Booking Numbers

As the theatrical launch approaches, advance ticket sales have opened across multiple formats throughout the country. Reports indicate that the production accumulated a considerable advance booking collection of Rs 45 crore in India by the early hours of November 2.

These early sales figures reflect strong pre-release interest from moviegoers eager to secure their seats for opening day across various participating theatres.

Cast and Crew Members

The feature is directed by Nitesh Tiwari and features a prominent ensemble cast. Ranbir Kapoor takes on the role of Lord Ram, Sai Pallavi stars as Sita, and Yash portrays Ravana.

Additional key cast members include Ravi Dubey as Lakshman, Sunny Deol as Hanuman, Arun Govil as King Dashrath, Lara Dutta as Kaikeyi, and several others spanning a large supporting roster.

Distribution and Global Reach

Dharma Productions is managing the distribution responsibilities for the theatrical run within India. Meanwhile, Sony Pictures is handling the international distribution strategy, which includes plans for the China market.

These partnerships aim to ensure a wide global footprint as the multi-language production reaches audiences across different international territories.

Ramayana: Part One is scheduled for a special Mumbai premiere at Lower Parel's IMAX on November 3 ahead of its November 5 India release. The production has already held international screenings in Los Angeles and London while accumulating Rs 45 crore in Indian advance bookings by November 2.
