news:82kn2y.d: Jailer 2: The Nelson Dilipkumar directorial becomes only the second Tamil film in history to cross 500 crore gross at the Indian box office.
news:82kn2y.k: Jailer 2 box office, Rajinikanth Jailer 2, Jailer 2 500 crore India gross, Jailer 2 vs 2.0 box office, Jailer 2, Rajinikanth, Nelson Dilipkumar Jailer 2, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
Reaching the Milestone

Rajinikanth has achieved another historic box office milestone as Jailer 2 crossed the 500 crore gross threshold at the Indian box office. The Nelson Dilipkumar directorial achieved this feat on Thursday, October 29, marking its 15th day in theatrical release. With this performance, the film becomes only the second Tamil production in cinema history to enter this elite domestic earnings bracket.

The only other film to previously accomplish this feat is also headlined by Rajinikanth. Shankar's 2.0 set the initial benchmark back in 2018, finishing its lifetime domestic run with approximately 520 crore in gross collections. Rajinikanth now holds both positions at the top of Tamil cinema's domestic box office records.

Comparing Two Blockbusters

While both films share the rare distinction of surpassing 500 crore gross domestically, their commercial journeys followed very different paths. The 2018 release 2.0 benefited immensely from a massive nationwide Hindi distribution strategy, bolstered by the presence of Akshay Kumar and extensive screenings across major multiplex chains, contributing over 240 crore from the Hindi market alone.

Conversely, Jailer 2 reached the same milestone with much lower figures from the Hindi-speaking belt, earning around 50 crore through its first 15 days. Major national chains such as PVR INOX and Cinepolis chose not to screen the dubbed version due to ongoing disputes regarding the film's four-week theatrical-to-OTT release window.

Domestic Net Versus Gross

An analysis of the box office numbers highlights the distinct relationship between India net and India gross figures. Jailer 2 has already outpaced 2.0 in domestic net collections, recording 429.55 crore compared to the earlier film's 407.05 crore net.

Despite trailing in net collections, 2.0 maintains a slight advantage in total India gross at 519 crore against Jailer 2's 502.65 crore. Only 16.35 crore separates the two titles, setting the stage for a dramatic race during the third weekend.

Strong Southern Territory Contributions

The driving force behind Jailer 2's domestic success stems from its exceptional reach across southern India. While Tamil Nadu naturally remains the strongest individual market with 195.60 crore, the combined revenues from neighboring states have provided an immense financial foundation.

Performances across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, Karnataka, and Kerala have elevated the film's domestic standing. Furthermore, the familiarity of the franchise, supported by appearances from actors like Mohanlal and Shiva Rajkumar, helped secure strong regional viewership without heavy reliance on northern multiplexes.

Sustained Momentum and Daily Holds

The sequel maintained impressive daily figures deep into its theatrical run, bringing in 6.85 crore gross on its third Thursday, representing an 18.1 percent decline from the previous day. This steady momentum followed a robust extended eight-day opening week and a strong second weekend.

With fresh competition expected from upcoming Diwali releases, the third weekend will serve as a crucial test for the film's remaining box office potential and its attempt to claim the all-time domestic record.

Global Standings and Overseas Strength

Beyond domestic borders, Jailer 2 has already surpassed 2.0 to claim the title of the highest-grossing Tamil film worldwide. Its global collections stand at 765.15 crore, outpacing 2.0's lifetime worldwide total of 691 crore.

Overseas markets have contributed significantly to this total, with international gross collections reaching 262.50 crore compared to 172.00 crore for the 2018 predecessor, demonstrating the expanding global appetite for major Kollywood spectacles.

News Overview

Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 has crossed 500 crore in India gross on its 15th day, becoming only the second Tamil film after 2.0 to achieve the milestone. Despite earning less in the Hindi market due to multiplex limitations, the sequel has relied on strong southern territories and robust worldwide earnings to challenge domestic records.

Comparing Two Blockbusters

While both films share the rare distinction of surpassing 500 crore gross domestically, their commercial journeys followed very different paths. The 2018 release 2.0 benefited immensely from a massive nationwide Hindi distribution strategy, bolstered by the presence of Akshay Kumar and extensive screenings across major multiplex chains, contributing over 240 crore from the Hindi market alone.

Conversely, Jailer 2 reached the same milestone with much lower figures from the Hindi-speaking belt, earning around 50 crore through its first 15 days. Major national chains such as PVR INOX and Cinepolis chose not to screen the dubbed version due to ongoing disputes regarding the film's four-week theatrical-to-OTT release window.

Domestic Net Versus Gross

An analysis of the box office numbers highlights the distinct relationship between India net and India gross figures. Jailer 2 has already outpaced 2.0 in domestic net collections, recording 429.55 crore compared to the earlier film's 407.05 crore net.

Despite trailing in net collections, 2.0 maintains a slight advantage in total India gross at 519 crore against Jailer 2's 502.65 crore. Only 16.35 crore separates the two titles, setting the stage for a dramatic race during the third weekend.

Strong Southern Territory Contributions

The driving force behind Jailer 2's domestic success stems from its exceptional reach across southern India. While Tamil Nadu naturally remains the strongest individual market with 195.60 crore, the combined revenues from neighboring states have provided an immense financial foundation.

Performances across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, Karnataka, and Kerala have elevated the film's domestic standing. Furthermore, the familiarity of the franchise, supported by appearances from actors like Mohanlal and Shiva Rajkumar, helped secure strong regional viewership without heavy reliance on northern multiplexes.

Sustained Momentum and Daily Holds

The sequel maintained impressive daily figures deep into its theatrical run, bringing in 6.85 crore gross on its third Thursday, representing an 18.1 percent decline from the previous day. This steady momentum followed a robust extended eight-day opening week and a strong second weekend.

With fresh competition expected from upcoming Diwali releases, the third weekend will serve as a crucial test for the film's remaining box office potential and its attempt to claim the all-time domestic record.

Global Standings and Overseas Strength

Beyond domestic borders, Jailer 2 has already surpassed 2.0 to claim the title of the highest-grossing Tamil film worldwide. Its global collections stand at 765.15 crore, outpacing 2.0's lifetime worldwide total of 691 crore.

Overseas markets have contributed significantly to this total, with international gross collections reaching 262.50 crore compared to 172.00 crore for the 2018 predecessor, demonstrating the expanding global appetite for major Kollywood spectacles.

News Overview

Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 has crossed 500 crore in India gross on its 15th day, becoming only the second Tamil film after 2.0 to achieve the milestone. Despite earning less in the Hindi market due to multiplex limitations, the sequel has relied on strong southern territories and robust worldwide earnings to challenge domestic records.

Key facts

  • Jailer 2 crossed 500 crore gross at the Indian box office on Thursday, October 29, 2026, its 15th day in theatres.
  • 2.0 earned around 520 crore India gross during its lifetime in 2018.
  • Jailer 2 has earned around 50+ crore Hindi gross through Day 15.
  • Jailer 2 15-day India Gross is ₹502.65 Cr and India Net is ₹429.55 Cr.
  • 2.0 lifetime India Gross is ₹519.00 Cr and India Net is ₹407.05 Cr.
  • Jailer 2 overseas gross is ₹262.50 Cr and worldwide gross is ₹765.15 Cr.
  • 2.0 lifetime overseas gross is ₹172.00 Cr and worldwide gross is ₹691.00 Cr.
  • Jailer 2 earned 6.85 crore gross on its third Thursday.
  • Tamil Nadu contributed ₹195.60 Cr (38.91%) to Jailer 2's India gross.

ld.articleBody:
Introduction to November 2026 K-Dramas

The eleventh month of the year brings a diverse wave of Korean television productions to various streaming platforms. Audiences can look forward to a blend of fresh narratives and returning favorites featuring prominent actors.

The slate covers multiple genres, ensuring options ranging from lighthearted workplace romance to gritty crime investigations and royal palace intrigues.

The Remarried Empress

Releasing on November 4 on Disney+, this royal drama centers on Empress Navier. After her husband attempts to divorce her to wed his mistress, Navier refuses to surrender quietly and partners with Prince Heinrey.

The series is directed by Cho Su-won and features a star-studded main cast including Shin Min-a, Ju Ji-hoon, Lee Se-young, and Lee Jong-suk.

What a Boss Wants

Scheduled for a November 11 release on Viki, this romantic comedy is adapted from a web novel. It follows wealthy CEO Kwon Do-hyuk as he tracks down indie band vocalist Lee Eun-chae after hearing her voice.

The narrative explores a three-month contractual agreement where Eun-chae works as his secretary, while paediatrician Moon Tae-kyung also develops a bond with her.

Crash 2: Fury Road

Arriving on JioHotstar on November 16, the second season of Crash brings back the Traffic Crime Investigation team for more road-related crime solving.

Cast members Lee Min-ki, Kwak Sun-young, Heo Sung-tae, and Lee Ho-cheol reprise their roles, alongside rookie officer addition Ji Dae-se played by NCT's Jisung.

Good Partner 2

Premiering on November 20 on Viki, the second season of Good Partner follows divorce lawyer Cha Eun-kyung as she establishes her new practice named Libom.

She teams up with emotionally invested lawyer Kang Hye-seong, alongside cast members Pyo Ji-hoon and Park Hae-jin.

The Blue Road and Nine to Six

The Blue Road launches on Netflix on November 20, bringing Korean detective Kim Seok and Japanese detective Inose together to track a cross-border serial killer.

Meanwhile, Nine to Six premieres on November 25 on Prime Video, starring Park Min-young, Yook Sung-jae, and Go Soo in a workplace romance setting.

News Overview

November 2026 brings multiple high-profile Korean dramas across Disney+, Viki, JioHotstar, Netflix, and Prime Video. Viewers can expect a diverse selection of genres ranging from legal and workplace romances to investigative thrillers and royal stories.

ld.articleBody:
Introduction to the Tracking Tracker

Trade tracking platforms have updated their opening day projections for several high-profile films preparing for theatrical distribution. The latest analytical forecast focuses heavily on audience awareness, past star track records, and commercial parameters to estimate initial earnings.

Among the prominent titles entering the tracker are upcoming romantic and action features, alongside final pre-release evaluations for major festive spectacles.

Yeh Prem Mol Liya Opening Outlook

Director Sooraj Barjatya returns to the big screen with Yeh Prem Mol Liya, scheduled to release on November 27, 2026. The filmmaker holds a legacy of major blockbusters in domestic cinema history, though trade experts note that his directorial ventures typically rely on strong theatrical legs rather than massive opening figures.

The leading man, Ayushmann Khurrana, has seen his recent standalone releases debut within modest ranges. Consequently, initial forecasts place the opening day collection between Rs. 4 crore and Rs. 7 crore nett, with potential upside driven by the director's historical box office appeal.

Gunmaaster G9 Box Office Potential

Emraan Hashmi stars in Gunmaaster G9, which is also slated for a November 27, 2026 release. Following the commercial run of Awaraapan 2, expectations for this genre are cautiously optimistic, though this project lacks the direct intellectual property backing of its predecessor.

Industry analysts indicate that the initial audience pull will heavily depend on music reception and upcoming promotional trailers. Current projections anticipate a first-day range stretching from Rs. 2.5 crore to Rs. 5.5 crore nett.

Ramayana Part One Final Adjustments

Ahead of its November 5, 2026 release, Ramayana Part One (Hindi) has received a final downward revision in its pre-release tracking. The pre-Diwali theatrical window presents specific limitations across Northern circuits, while dubbed versions face heightened competition in major metropolitan centers like Bengaluru and Hyderabad.

The revised forecast narrows the opening projection to between Rs. 52 crore and Rs. 60 crore nett, with a targeted pinpoint estimate of Rs. 56 crore nett. These figures exclude potential 3D format surcharges, which could elevate totals by approximately ten percent.

Nature of Analytical Tracking

Industry tracking figures remain entirely subjective, relying on advance booking indicators, distributor sentiment, and commercial parameters rather than verified accounting records. These predictive models intentionally evaluate organic ticket sales while excluding unverified or inorganic collection metrics.

While multiple films occupy the theatrical calendar during this period, tracking parameters prioritize projects equipped with notable star power and substantial pre-release visibility.

Trade forecasters have published opening day estimates for upcoming theatrical releases, led by projections for Yeh Prem Mol Liya and Gunmaaster G9 alongside a final update for Ramayana Part One. The analysis highlights varying commercial expectations shaped by star involvement, seasonal timing, and historical audience trends.

news:87lu9f.k: Kartik Aaryan, Vivek Agnihotri, KJS 'Tiny' Dhillon, Operation Sindoor, Operation Sindoor: The Untold Story of India's Deep Strikes Inside Pakistan, Kartik Aaryan Operation Sindoor, Vivek Agnihotri Operation Sindoor, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
First-Time Collaboration Revealed

Bollywood actor Kartik Aaryan and filmmaker Vivek Agnihotri are joining forces for the very first time in an upcoming feature titled Operation Sindoor. According to reports from Variety India, the project brings together two prominent figures from the Hindi film industry to tell a gripping story rooted in real-life events.

The announcement of this collaboration has generated substantial buzz across entertainment circles, marking a significant shift in the kind of subjects Kartik Aaryan is choosing to helm as a leading man.

Source Material and Real-Life Roots

The narrative of Operation Sindoor draws heavily from Lieutenant General KJS 'Tiny' Dhillon's published work titled Operation Sindoor: The Untold Story of India's Deep Strikes Inside Pakistan. Furthermore, the film is deeply connected to the aftermath of the April 2025 terror attack in Pahalgam.

Director Vivek Agnihotri previously stated that the project stems from thorough, ground-level research conducted in close partnership with various wings of the Indian Armed Forces to ensure factual clarity on screen.

Production Backing and Creative Team

Behind the scenes, Operation Sindoor is being supported by prominent industry banners. The movie is backed by Bhushan Kumar's T-Series alongside Vivek Agnihotri's own production company, I Am Buddha Productions.

Agnihotri is widely recognized for his past directorial ventures that deal with intense geopolitical and historical themes, including The Tashkent Files, The Kashmir Files, The Vaccine War, and The Bengal Files.

Kartik Aaryan's Current and Future Schedule

Before diving fully into Operation Sindoor, Kartik Aaryan has to wrap up his ongoing work on Captain India, which is being directed by Shimit Amin and set against the backdrop of the Houthi conflict in Yemen.

Beyond these two titles, the actor maintains a busy lineup of upcoming theatrical releases spanning multiple genres, such as the creature feature Naagzilla, an untitled romantic musical with Anurag Basu, and a biographical sports drama about Kashmiri athlete Tajamul Islam.

Production Status and Remaining Details

As of now, further specifics regarding the rest of the main cast members and the official theatrical release date for Operation Sindoor remain unannounced by the makers.

Audience members and trade analysts will have to wait for subsequent updates from the production houses to learn when filming will officially commence on the floors.

News Overview

Kartik Aaryan will star in Vivek Agnihotri's upcoming real-events drama Operation Sindoor, marking their first collaboration. The movie draws inspiration from Lieutenant General KJS 'Tiny' Dhillon's book and the aftermath of the Pahalgam terror attack.

news:8fqiev.k: RESCENE PULSE mini-album, RESCENE first-week sales, PULSE Hanteo Chart, RESCENE members Woni Liv Minami May Zena, Woni PULSE, PULSE, Woni, Liv PULSE, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
Explosive First-Week Sales Achievement

Rising K-pop girl group RESCENE has achieved remarkable commercial momentum with their fourth mini-album, PULSE. As of November 7, the record surpassed 450,000 cumulative copies sold during its first week on the market.

This stellar performance brings the five-member act extraordinarily close to securing their very first half-million seller designation as tracking continues to unfold.

Hanteo Chart Milestones and Tracking Data

According to official figures released by Hanteo Chart on November 7, the mini-album officially dropped on November 3 and recorded 412,158 cumulative sales through November 6.

A dramatic surge on the fifth tracking day brought in an additional 47,137 copies by 2:00 PM on November 7 alone, pushing the verified first-week total to 459,295 copies and placing the release at the peak of the daily physical charts.

Counting Down to the Final Window

With the official first-week tracking period scheduled to wrap up on November 9, excitement is building across the fandom. Supporters are watching closely to see if the group can clear the remaining 40,705 copies needed to cross the prestigious 500,000-copy threshold.

news:8gts37.k: Yash Ramayana, Yash Ravana son reaction, Nitesh Tiwari Ramayana cast, Ramayana release date 2026, Ramayana, Yash, Nitesh Tiwari Ramayana, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
An Unexpected Parental Dilemma

Preparing for a major cinematic project often involves intensive physical training, script reading, and look tests, but for Kannada superstar Yash, stepping into a legendary character brought an entirely unforeseen challenge at home. The actor, who is set to play the formidable demon king Ravana in Nitesh Tiwari’s highly anticipated mythological epic, recently shared a candid behind-the-scenes anecdote regarding his family life. While diving deep into his character preparation, Yash found himself having to explain his professional choices to his young son, whose immediate reaction was one of pure astonishment.

The conversation unfolded when the youngster began learning the narrative of the ancient scripture and discovered that his own father had been cast as the primary antagonist rather than the revered hero. This unexpected revelation caught the child off guard, leading to a memorable domestic exchange that highlighted the innocence of childhood perspective when confronted with cinematic storytelling.

A Child’s Shocked Interrogation

Recounting the interaction through an IANS report, Yash described how his son struggled to reconcile his father’s real-world identity with the villainous stature of Ravana. Upon making the connection, the little boy voiced his disbelief directly, questioning how his father could possibly agree to play such a part. The child exclaimed that his father was supposed to be the good person, expressing outright shock at the casting choice.

The actor noted that his son’s inquiries did not stop at moral objections regarding the plot. The curious youngster quickly pressed further into the narrative arc, asking pointed questions about the ultimate fate of the character. Wanting to know whether Ravana ultimately loses the battle and perishes at the conclusion of the story, the child’s questions forced the seasoned star to navigate a delicate conversation about dramatic arts and mortality.

Separating Reality from Performance

Faced with his son's emotional response, Yash realized he needed to provide a thoughtful lesson on the nature of acting and dramatic performance. He had anticipated the demands of delivering a compelling portrayal for moviegoers, but he admitted that preparing for his own child's probing questions was an entirely unique experience. The actor had to carefully explain the fundamental difference between a fictional character and the real-life individual breathing life into that role.

This meant sitting the child down to clarify that playing an antagonist does not equate to endorsing or supporting the character's destructive actions. Yash emphasized that storytelling requires the full spectrum of characters to be depicted accurately so that audiences can truly comprehend the entire scope and historical or cultural weight of the traditional epic narrative.

Teaching Core Moral Values

Beyond explaining the technicalities of filmmaking and character portrayal, Yash used the opportunity to reinforce essential ethical lessons for his children. He wanted to ensure that while his son might cheer for his performance inside a movie theater, the child would maintain a clear moral compass in real life. The actor explicitly directed his son to look past the theatrical grandeur associated with Ravana.

During their discussion, Yash stressed that true righteousness and lasting victory in life stem from following the path of Lord Rama rather than being swayed by outward displays of power and imposing strength. He advised his son to admire the central figure of the epic as the ultimate ideal of virtue, ensuring the young boy could distinguish between cinematic entertainment and moral guidance.

About Nitesh Tiwari's Cinematic Epic

The upcoming two-part cinematic adaptation directed by Nitesh Tiwari stands as one of the most ambitious projects in contemporary Indian cinema. The sprawling cast features Ranbir Kapoor stepping into the role of Lord Rama, alongside Sai Pallavi as Sita and Yash anchoring the production as the formidable Ravana. The ensemble cast also includes Ravi Dubey as Lakshman, Sunny Deol as Hanuman, Arun Govil as Dasharatha, Lara Dutta as Kaikeyi, Rakul Preet Singh as Surpanakha, Sheeba Chaddha as Manthara, and Adinath Kothare as Bharat.

In addition to its star-studded roster, the epic boasts an internationally renowned musical backing. The musical landscape for the film is crafted by the celebrated composer AR Rahman alongside legendary Hollywood composer Hans Zimmer. With meticulous planning and global talent attached, anticipation surrounding the project remains exceptionally high.

Release Details and Global Expectations

As production progresses toward completion, the makers have locked in a major timeline for the project's theatrical rollout. The first instalment of Nitesh Tiwari’s mythological magnum opus is officially scheduled to hit silver screens worldwide on November 5, 2026. This wide release strategy aims to capture audiences across domestic and international markets simultaneously.

With top-tier talent both in front of and behind the camera, the film continues to generate significant buzz across entertainment circles. The unique blend of seasoned star power and high-profile technical collaborations positions the two-part feature as a monumental cinematic event for the coming year.

Kannada superstar Yash shared a charming anecdote about his young son reacting with shock upon learning his father is playing the villainous Ravana in Nitesh Tiwari’s upcoming epic 'Ramayana'. Yash used the moment to teach his children the difference between an actor and a fictional character while reinforcing that Lord Rama remains the true moral ideal. The highly anticipated two-part film, starring Ranbir Kapoor and Sai Pallavi alongside Yash, is slated for a worldwide theatrical release on November 5, 2026.

ld.articleBody:
Second Sunday Momentum

The theatrical run of the newly released action thriller starring veteran superstar Rajinikanth witnessed a notable upswing in earnings as it concluded its second weekend. Bringing in a strong collection during Sunday screenings, the movie demonstrated its continued appeal among audiences across various regions. Industry trackers and public reports highlight that the feature has successfully maintained high engagement levels well past its opening week, showing consistent footfalls in theaters nationwide.

Screenings and Eleventh Day Rise

The film recorded a significant number of screenings across the country on its eleventh day, allowing it to register a notable percentage increase compared to its previous day's tally. Exhibitors and trade analysts noted that evening and afternoon show slots drew particularly heavy crowds, contributing heavily to the overall daily net revenue generated within domestic territories.

Domestic and International Figures

In terms of cumulative financial performance, the movie has amassed massive figures since its initial premiere. Total domestic net collections have reached substantial heights, complemented by strong domestic gross tallies. International markets have additionally proven to be a vital revenue driver, adding consistent daily grosses from overseas territories to elevate the cumulative worldwide gross past the monumental threshold.

Opening Week and Weekend Comparison

While the second weekend performance demonstrated impressive staying power—pulling in a strong three-day net total across Friday, Saturday, and Sunday—these figures arrive on the heels of a massive opening week. Although current daily earnings sit below the record-breaking heights established on the very first day of release, the film continues to command thousands of shows daily with steady occupancy percentages.

Multi-Language Appeal

The project's box office triumph is heavily anchored by its performance across multiple regional languages. The Tamil version naturally captured the lion's share of the domestic earnings, commanding a vast majority of the total net revenue with high overall theater occupancy. At the same time, versions released in Telugu, Hindi, and Kannada also contributed meaningfully to the overall tally, proving the widespread multi-lingual appeal of the lead star.

State-Wise Distribution

State-wise distribution reports emphasize that Tamil Nadu remained the primary contributor to the gross collection figures, followed closely by Karnataka and the Andhra Pradesh-Telangana region. Kerala and other parts of the country rounded out the regional contributions, pushing total reported state-wise gross collections past the thirty-crore mark for the specific Sunday window alone.

Plot and Character Context

Directed to appeal to fans of high-octane commercial cinema, the narrative centers on the protagonist Tiger Muthuvel Pandian, a retired jailer portrayed by Rajinikanth. The storyline kicks into high gear when an unexpected and dangerous threat from the criminal underworld shatters the tranquility of his everyday life, forcing him to step back into his former ruthless persona.

The ensuing conflict drives the core of the action thriller, as the seasoned protagonist sets out to neutralize antagonistic forces and safeguard his family. This mixture of emotional stakes and signature action sequences has resonated strongly with moviegoers, fueling the massive attendance numbers recorded at ticket windows globally.

Attendance and Global Milestones

Cumulative theatrical attendance has seen millions of tickets sold since the feature premiered, reflecting the enduring superstardom of the lead actor. Sunday screenings alone registered massive footfalls across various territories, with different language versions displaying varying degrees of peak viewing hours, ranging from strong evening turnouts to respectable morning and afternoon occupancies.

As public and industry sources continue to monitor the performance of this blockbuster, final figures are expected to adjust slightly as official studio verifications are completed. Nevertheless, the milestone achievement of crossing the Rs 710 crore global threshold solidifies its place as one of the major commercial successes of the theatrical calendar.

ld.articleBody:
Day 10 Revenue Recovery

Jailer 2 experienced a notable revenue recovery on Saturday, October 24, following a decline in earnings during the previous day. According to tracking figures from Sacnilk, the Tamil-language film collected an estimated ₹24.15 crore net in India on Day 10, representing a 66.6% increase compared to the ₹14.50 crore earned on Day 9.

Cumulative Domestic Collections

With these latest figures factored in, the cumulative domestic net collection for the feature has reached an estimated ₹373 crore. Simultaneously, the domestic gross collection has advanced to ₹436.80 crore over the same ten-day theatrical span.

International Performance

The theatrical run extends globally, with the Nelson Dilipkumar directorial pulling in an additional ₹10 crore in overseas gross during its tenth day in cinemas. This international contribution elevated the film's total overseas gross to ₹229.50 crore.

Worldwide Totals

Combined with domestic figures, the worldwide gross for Jailer 2 has climbed to an estimated ₹666.30 crore as it approaches the ₹670 crore milestone. The production originally opened worldwide on October 15.

Language Breakdown of Domestic Earnings

Domestic revenue on Saturday was led predominantly by the Tamil version, which contributed ₹16.25 crore net across 5,545 shows while maintaining an occupancy rate of 46.2%. The Telugu edition brought in an estimated ₹4.40 crore from 1,835 shows, registering a 38.4% occupancy level.

Meanwhile, the Hindi version generated ₹2.90 crore net from 4,008 shows with a 20% occupancy rate. The Kannada language run added a further ₹60 lakh from 203 shows, marking a 41% occupancy rate for the territory.

First Week Theatrical Trajectory

The feature debuted on October 15 with a strong opening day of ₹59.70 crore net in India. Following the launch, daily domestic earnings saw fluctuations, moving from ₹37.10 crore on Friday, October 16, to ₹47.25 crore on Saturday and ₹55.85 crore on Sunday.

Subsequent weekday numbers included ₹42.35 crore on Monday and ₹46.80 crore on Tuesday, before descending to ₹28.15 crore on Wednesday. By the end of its first full week in cinemas, the film had accumulated a domestic net total of ₹334.35 crore.

Cast and Production Background

Jailer 2 serves as a direct sequel to the 2023 release Jailer, with lead actor Rajinikanth reprising his celebrated role as the retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian. Returning cast members from the original installment include Ramya Krishnan, Yogi Babu, Mirnaa, and Rithvik.

The expanded ensemble cast also features S. J. Suryah, Mithun Chakraborty, Suraj Venjaramoodu, and Vidya Balan. The project is written and directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, produced by Kalanithi Maran under the Sun Pictures banner, and features a musical score composed by Anirudh Ravichander.

The film's worldwide gross has reached an estimated ₹666.30 crore as it nears the ₹670 crore landmark. Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, the action sequel stars Rajinikanth reprising his role as Tiger Muthuvel Pandian.

Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 Surges on Day 10 as Worldwide Gross Nears ₹670 Crore

The Tamil action sequel Jailer 2 experienced a significant 66.6% revenue jump on its second Saturday, pushing its cumulative domestic net collections to ₹373 crore according to tracking data.

Published 25 October 2026

Day 10 Revenue Recovery

Jailer 2 experienced a notable revenue recovery on Saturday, October 24, following a decline in earnings during the previous day. According to tracking figures from Sacnilk, the Tamil-language film collected an estimated ₹24.15 crore net in India on Day 10, representing a 66.6% increase compared to the ₹14.50 crore earned on Day 9.

Cumulative Domestic Collections

With these latest figures factored in, the cumulative domestic net collection for the feature has reached an estimated ₹373 crore. Simultaneously, the domestic gross collection has advanced to ₹436.80 crore over the same ten-day theatrical span.

International Performance

The theatrical run extends globally, with the Nelson Dilipkumar directorial pulling in an additional ₹10 crore in overseas gross during its tenth day in cinemas. This international contribution elevated the film's total overseas gross to ₹229.50 crore.

Worldwide Totals

Combined with domestic figures, the worldwide gross for Jailer 2 has climbed to an estimated ₹666.30 crore as it approaches the ₹670 crore milestone. The production originally opened worldwide on October 15.

Language Breakdown of Domestic Earnings

Domestic revenue on Saturday was led predominantly by the Tamil version, which contributed ₹16.25 crore net across 5,545 shows while maintaining an occupancy rate of 46.2%. The Telugu edition brought in an estimated ₹4.40 crore from 1,835 shows, registering a 38.4% occupancy level.

Meanwhile, the Hindi version generated ₹2.90 crore net from 4,008 shows with a 20% occupancy rate. The Kannada language run added a further ₹60 lakh from 203 shows, marking a 41% occupancy rate for the territory.

First Week Theatrical Trajectory

The feature debuted on October 15 with a strong opening day of ₹59.70 crore net in India. Following the launch, daily domestic earnings saw fluctuations, moving from ₹37.10 crore on Friday, October 16, to ₹47.25 crore on Saturday and ₹55.85 crore on Sunday.

Subsequent weekday numbers included ₹42.35 crore on Monday and ₹46.80 crore on Tuesday, before descending to ₹28.15 crore on Wednesday. By the end of its first full week in cinemas, the film had accumulated a domestic net total of ₹334.35 crore.

Cast and Production Background

Jailer 2 serves as a direct sequel to the 2023 release Jailer, with lead actor Rajinikanth reprising his celebrated role as the retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian. Returning cast members from the original installment include Ramya Krishnan, Yogi Babu, Mirnaa, and Rithvik.

The expanded ensemble cast also features S. J. Suryah, Mithun Chakraborty, Suraj Venjaramoodu, and Vidya Balan. The project is written and directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, produced by Kalanithi Maran under the Sun Pictures banner, and features a musical score composed by Anirudh Ravichander.

News Overview

Jailer 2 saw a notable revenue surge on its tenth day in theaters, bringing its cumulative domestic net collections to ₹373 crore. The film's worldwide gross has reached an estimated ₹666.30 crore as it nears the ₹670 crore landmark. Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, the action sequel stars Rajinikanth reprising his role as Tiger Muthuvel Pandian.

  • Jailer 2 collected an estimated ₹24.15 crore net in India on Day 10 according to Sacnilk.
  • The Day 10 figures represent a 66.6% increase from the ₹14.50 crore earned on Day 9.
  • The film's cumulative domestic net collection reached ₹373 crore after ten days.
  • The worldwide gross for Jailer 2 climbed to ₹666.30 crore.
  • International collections added ₹10 crore on Day 10, bringing the overseas total to ₹229.50 crore.
  • The Tamil version earned ₹16.25 crore net from 5,545 shows with a 46.2% occupancy rate.
  • The Telugu version brought in ₹4.40 crore from 1,835 shows with a 38.4% occupancy rate.
  • The Hindi version collected ₹2.90 crore from 4,008 shows with a 20% occupancy rate.
  • The Kannada version added ₹60 lakh from 203 shows with a 41% occupancy rate.
  • The feature originally opened in theatres worldwide on October 15 with a ₹59.70 crore net opening day in India.

news:8qaobm.d: Avengers: Doomsday: Marvel Studios and WWE have teamed up for a groundbreaking two-day takeover featuring special events, merchandise, and an immersive fan…
news:8qaobm.k: Avengers Doomsday WWE crossover, John Cena Classic Netflix, Worlds Collide event Orlando, WWE World Fanatics Fan Experience, Mintu Kumar Tomar Avengers: Doomsday, Avengers: Doomsday, Mintu Kumar Tomar, Joe Russo Avengers: Doomsday, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
The Surprising Partnership

Marvel Studios and World Wrestling Entertainment have joined forces for an unexpected and massive collaborative event. Designed to build excitement leading up to the premiere of the upcoming superhero blockbuster, this partnership brings together two entertainment giants. Organizers aim to blend cinematic storytelling with professional wrestling to deliver a memorable experience for enthusiasts of both franchises.

Venue and Schedule

The special takeover will occupy ESPN's Wide World of Sports Complex situated near Orlando, Florida. Scheduled to run across two days, the festivities take place on December 14 and December 15, 2026. This location will serve as the central hub for all the live programming and interactive fan activities.

Featured Events and Live Broadcasts

The collaboration introduces two major highlights: The John Cena Classic and a Marvel-themed Worlds Collide event. The John Cena Classic will stream live on Netflix on December 14 as a special edition of Monday Night Raw. Following that broadcast, the Avengers: Doomsday edition of Worlds Collide will launch on December 15, showcasing talent from WWE, NXT, and AAA.

Immersive Fan Experiences

In addition to the in-ring action, attendees can participate in WWE World, a two-day immersive fan convention produced in partnership with Fanatics. This attraction gives supporters the chance to secure autographs, take photographs, and purchase exclusive merchandise. Additional details regarding further fan experiences are slated for announcement later this month.

Co-Branded Merchandise

The partnership yields unique physical items for collectors and followers of both brands. Marvel and WWE are producing co-branded products, most notably custom title belts themed around the upcoming film. These specialty items will be available for purchase at WWE World, the official online WWE shop, and select Disney retail locations.

Ticketing and Release Details

Tickets for the Florida event become available to the general public on November 13, 2026, starting at 10 a.m. ET via Ticketmaster. Additionally, a general presale for combo tickets goes live a day prior on November 12, 2026, at 10 a.m. ET. Meanwhile, the film driving this entire collaboration arrives in cinemas shortly after on December 18, 2026.

News Overview

Marvel and WWE are partnering for a two-day crossover event at the ESPN Wide World of Sports Complex near Orlando, featuring The John Cena Classic and an Avengers: Doomsday themed Worlds Collide showcase. The December 2026 collaboration includes exclusive co-branded title belts, immersive fan activities with Fanatics, and ticket sales beginning in mid-November ahead of the movie's theatrical release.

news:8u09sx.k: Mohanlal Anoop Sathyan, L368 movie, Mohanlal shooting Thodupuzha, Varane Aavashyamundu director, Mohanlal L368, L368, Mohanlal, Anoop Sathyan L368, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
Production Kickoff and Set Video

Malayalam cinema icon Mohanlal has commenced shooting for director Anoop Sathyan's upcoming movie, temporarily titled L368. A behind-the-scenes video from the sets has recently circulated online, generating excitement among fans.

The newly surfaced footage features the veteran actor arriving at the location dressed in a simple shirt and dhoti. Producer Antony Perumbavoor was present to welcome him warmly to the set.

Schedule Details and Locations

The upcoming project recently launched its production phase with a traditional pooja ceremony held in Kochi last week. Following the launch, the production team shifted locations to Thodupuzha for the ongoing schedule.

The behind-the-scenes clip also captures director Anoop Sathyan actively coordinating the shoot and giving instructions to the film crew. Mohanlal is seen interacting with the team and discussing operational aspects before wrapping up for the day.

Childhood Admiration and Family Background

The collaboration between Mohanlal and Anoop Sathyan stems from a deeply personal place for the filmmaker. During the film's pooja ceremony, Anoop shared that he has been an ardent admirer of the superstar since his childhood.

Anoop's father, veteran filmmaker Sathyan Anthikad, shared an amusing childhood anecdote about his son's devotion. He recalled a period when he could not work with Mohanlal for ten to twelve years, noting that Anoop would get upset and once even threatened to walk away to Mohanlal's house.

Director's Background and Debut

Anoop Sathyan made his directorial debut in 2020 with the acclaimed film Varane Aavashyamundu. That movie featured a multi-generational ensemble cast including Suresh Gopi, Shobana, Dulquer Salmaan, and Kalyani Priyadarshan.

Directing Mohanlal marks a major milestone for the filmmaker, given his lifelong admiration for the actor. Specific details regarding the plot, genre, and supporting cast of L368 are currently kept under wraps.

Legacy of Sathyan Anthikad Collaborations

Anoop Sathyan's father, Sathyan Anthikad, shares a legendary creative history with Mohanlal. Their past partnerships produced numerous classic Malayalam entertainers defined by humor and relatable characters.

Some of the most memorable collaborations between Mohanlal and Sathyan Anthikad include Nadodikattu, Gandhinagar 2nd Street, and Pattanapravesham. These titles remain pillars of Malayalam cinema.

Mohanlal's Busy Slate of Projects

Mohanlal maintains a packed schedule with several high-profile films and appearances. He recently made a brief cameo appearance in Rajinikanth's Jailer 2.

In addition to his ongoing work on L368, the actor is preparing for the theatrical release of Athimanoharam next month. Meanwhile, another previously discussed project with Jithu Madhavan was recently dropped due to scheduling issues.

News Overview

Malayalam superstar Mohanlal has started filming for Anoop Sathyan's upcoming directorial project, temporarily titled L368, following a pooja ceremony in Kochi and a move to Thodupuzha. A behind-the-scenes video has surfaced online, capturing the actor arriving on set and being greeted by producer Antony Perumbavoor.

news:8xdps2.d: Months after promising a historically accurate feature-length film, tech billionaire Elon Musk shares a 7-minute AI-generated episode of The Odyssey on X.
news:8xdps2.k: Elon Musk AI generated Odyssey episode, The Odyssey Grok Imagine, Elon Musk X video release, Dev Walker The Odyssey, Elon Musk The Odyssey, The Odyssey, Elon Musk, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
The AI Odyssey Release

Tech billionaire Elon Musk has taken a step toward fulfilling his ambitious pledge to adapt Homer's classic epic using artificial intelligence. His platform shared the initial 7-minute episode of an AI-generated series based on The Odyssey.

Grok Imagine Tool

The release follows a previous 3-minute short that was shared on the social media platform earlier in the year. The latest project utilizes the Grok Imagine tool to bring the ancient Greek text to life in a video format.

Creative Collaboration

While the initiative stems from Musk's artificial intelligence tools, the recent release credited specific external entities for the creative collaboration. Wonder Studios and director Dev Walker were recognized for their involvement in the AI filmmaking process.

Both collaborating names specialize in the emerging field of artificial intelligence filmmaking, helping shape the visual output delivered in this initial episodic release on the X platform.

Musk's Original Pledge

In July, Elon Musk first announced plans to produce a full-length feature version of the ancient Greek poem. He claimed at the time that the resulting project would remain historically accurate and true to the art of Homer.

Timeline for the Project

The tech mogul initially set a timeline indicating that the AI-driven adaptation would be ready before the end of 2026, sparking widespread discussion across the entertainment and technology sectors.

Hollywood Backlash

The announcement of an AI-driven classical adaptation drew sharp criticism from established Hollywood filmmakers. Director Scott Derrickson publicly dismissed the project and criticized Musk's understanding of cinema on social media.

Derrickson pulled no punches in his online response, arguing that the billionaire's opinions on art held no value and claiming he stopped reading books in his youth.

Criticism of Traditional Films

Musk's venture into AI filmmaking has frequently coincided with his vocal criticisms of traditional Hollywood productions. He previously took aim at another project's casting choices, specifically targeting actors Elliot Page and Lupita Nyong'o.

The tech entrepreneur alleged that those casting decisions were made solely to satisfy academy representation and inclusion standards for award eligibility, lobbing accusations at the film's director.

News Overview

Tech billionaire Elon Musk released a 7-minute AI-generated episode of The Odyssey on X using the Grok Imagine tool. The project involves Wonder Studios and director Dev Walker, following Musk's earlier pledge to produce a historically accurate feature adaptation by the end of 2026. The initiative has faced backlash from Hollywood director Scott Derrickson and coincides with Musk's criticisms of traditional film casting choices.

ld.articleBody:
Final Rites Held in Jalandhar

The final rites for Divit Aulakh, nephew of prominent musician Yo Yo Honey Singh and son of Speed Records owner Dinesh Aulakh, took place at the Model Town cremation ground in Jalandhar on Tuesday. A large gathering of mourners, well-wishers, and notable personalities from the Punjabi music and film industries assembled to offer their final respects to the young man.

Divit tragically lost his life in a road accident that occurred on Sunday in Jalandhar, Punjab. His grieving father, Dinesh Aulakh, performed the final rituals amidst an intensely emotional atmosphere that deeply moved the attendees.

Music Fraternity Stands with the Family

A heavy presence from the Punjabi entertainment world marked the solemn occasion. Renowned artists and singers including Gippy Grewal, Babbu Maan, Jazzy B, Amrit Maan, and Satinder Sartaaj stepped forward to personally shoulder the mortal remains.

Additional industry figures such as Preet Harpal and Ranjit Bawa were also in attendance to offer support. Yo Yo Honey Singh remained closely by the side of the bereaved family throughout the proceedings as they navigated the profound loss.

Details of the Tragic Accident

The fatal incident unfolded around 3:30 am on Sunday near Jalandhar, claiming the lives of both Divit Aulakh and his friend, Aarav Talwar. Technology played an unintended role in breaking the news when Divit's phone activated its crash detection feature.

An emergency alert containing their exact location was automatically dispatched to his mother's phone number, which was saved as an emergency contact. Family members discovered the reality of the crash after failing to reach Divit directly and subsequently contacting his friends.

Gurpreet Ghuggi Raises Road Safety Concerns

Addressing the media at the cremation ground, actor and comedian Gurpreet Ghuggi expressed deep anguish over the tragedy and the broader issue of highway safety. He emphasized that while condolences are common, only the affected family truly understands the weight of such an empty house.

Ghuggi sharply questioned the persistent loss of lives on regional roads, demanding urgent systemic reforms. He called for better road infrastructure, mandatory vehicle reflectors, stricter vehicle servicing standards, and greater educational outreach aimed at young drivers to curb ongoing tragedies.

Political Figures Offer Condolences

Local leaders also stepped forward to share their sympathies with the grieving family during this difficult time. BJP leader Sushil Rinku characterized the incident as an extremely unfortunate and heartbreaking loss beyond words.

Rinku extended his prayers for inner strength to Dinesh Aulakh and his wife, noting that finding solace from such profound grief would require seeking deep spiritual refuge.

Honey Singh's Public Expression of Grief

In the wake of the tragedy, Yo Yo Honey Singh took to social media to articulate his devastation. He shared a personal message describing the period as a dark decade marked by an irreplaceable familial loss.

The outpouring of support from fans and industry colleagues highlighted the close-knit nature of the Punjabi entertainment community during times of crisis.

The Punjabi entertainment community gathered in Jalandhar for the funeral of Divit Aulakh, son of Dinesh Aulakh and nephew of Yo Yo Honey Singh, following his death in a road accident. Industry members and public figures paid their respects while raising concerns over road safety and offering condolences to the grieving family.

ld.articleBody:
Episode 5 Premiere Details

Fans of Korean dramas are tuning in for the fifth installment of Final Table, which arrives today, November 7. As the series progresses, viewers are eager to witness how the plot unfolds and what challenges face the main characters.

Apart from the unfolding storyline, the talented ensemble has generated significant curiosity among audiences who want to learn more about the actors and the specific characters they bring to life on screen.

Global And Indian Streaming Schedule

Indian enthusiasts of the series can watch the fifth episode online via Prime Video starting at 7:10 PM IST on November 7.

In its home country of South Korea, the installment broadcasts on JTBC at 10:40 PM KST on the exact same day.

Plot And Culinary Competition Background

The narrative centers around an international cooking competition known as The Table: K-Chef 2026. This high-stakes event gathers talented Korean culinary artists from various parts of the world.

Beyond the kitchen showdowns, the script delves into the personal challenges, ambitions, interpersonal relationships, and familial conflicts experienced by the participants.

Lead Characters And Past Rivalries

Ahn Hyo-seop stars as Kang Han, a chef who spent years working abroad under the alias Chris K. He conceals his past, speaks multiple languages, and steps up as head chef at Familia.

Chang Ryul portrays his primary rival, Cha Woo-jin, who leads the kitchen at Exception. The two share a history from a previous international cooking contest, igniting renewed tension during their reunion.

Corporate Power Struggles

The narrative expands beyond culinary arts to include a separate corporate power struggle taking place within Pyeongyeon Group.

In this subplot, the chairwoman and her half-sister compete for control over the company, adding depth to themes of family ties and second chances.

Supporting Cast And Expert Chefs

Kim Sun-woo takes on the role of Yoo In-seop, a modern Korean restaurant head chef, while Kim Jung-hwan appears as Joshua, leading the American establishment Hush.

Additional cast members include Lee Yoo-joon as Yang Ja-ryong, Lee Joo-young as royal court cuisine expert Jang Ok-sun, Lee Hyun-kyun as Park Je-hyun, and Hailey as Isabel.

Broadcast Format And Series Length

Directed and written by Kim Do-hoon, the series goes far beyond a standard professional competition. The entire production consists of twelve total episodes.

The creative team maintains a twice-a-week release format with fresh episodes dropping every Saturday and Sunday, leading up to the final episode scheduled for November 29.

News Overview

Episode 5 of Final Table premieres on Prime Video in India at 7:10 PM IST on November 7, following an international cooking competition plot starring Ahn Hyo-seop. The twelve-episode K-drama features a twice-weekly release schedule on Saturdays and Sundays, heading toward its finale on November 29.

news:9c9z7j.k: Ramayana advance booking collection, Ranbir Kapoor Ramayana box office, Ramayana Rise of a Legend release, Yash Ramayana movie tickets, Ranbir Kapoor Ramayana, Ramayana, Ranbir Kapoor, Yash Ramayana, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
Global Advance Booking Milestone

The upcoming mythological epic Ramayana has achieved a massive milestone by crossing the Rs 75 crore mark in worldwide advance bookings. Fans across the globe have shown tremendous enthusiasm for the film, contributing to strong pre-sales numbers as the release date approaches.

Trade reports indicate that international markets alone have added significantly to this total, with overseas advance bookings generating $3.9 million. This figure includes more than $1.5 million specifically from paid previews in the United States.

Domestic Pre-Sales And Ticket Figures

Within India, the film has recorded phenomenal numbers, selling nearly 9 lakh tickets in pre-sales. According to portal data, the domestic advance gross collections stand at an impressive Rs 47.62 crore.

When excluding blocked seats, the domestic advance collection reaches Rs 38.03 crore derived from 9.02 lakh tickets. These pre-booking figures were recorded across 36,211 shows spanning 532 Indian cities.

Language Markets And Regional Performance

Ticket sales for the movie are currently being led by Hindi markets across the country. Meanwhile, the Kannada and Telugu versions of the epic are also picking up substantial momentum in pre-sales.

The widespread appeal across multiple regional languages highlights the massive anticipation for the multi-lingual release of the mythological drama.

Cast And Creative Ensemble

Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the film features Ranbir Kapoor starring as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Goddess Sita, and Yash taking on the role of Ravana. The two-part epic is produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash under Prime Focus Studios, Monster Mind Creations, and DNEG.

The expansive supporting and ensemble cast includes Ravi Dubey, Sunny Deol, Arun Govil, Lara Dutta, Indira Krishnan, and numerous other prominent actors in pivotal parts, alongside music by AR Rahman and Hans Zimmer.

Release Schedule And Parts

Titled Ramayana: Rise of a Legend, the first part of the two-part epic is scheduled to release in theatres worldwide on November 5. The second part of the franchise is planned for release during Diwali 2027.

With less than three days remaining until the film hits theatres, the hype surrounding the mythological project has reached an all-time high among moviegoers.

Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi starrer Ramayana has grossed Rs 75 crore worldwide in advance bookings, selling nearly 9 lakh tickets in India. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the mythological epic is set to release worldwide on November 5.

ld.articleBody:
The Box Office Journey Enters Week Four

The theatrical run of the prominent crime thriller has entered its fourth week, showcasing remarkable stamina despite a natural cooling off period at the ticket counters. While fresh cinematic releases continue to vie for viewer attention across the country, this installment maintains a steady presence in cinemas nationwide.

Industry trackers note that although the explosive momentum seen during the initial weeks has tapered off, the film continues to pull in loyal audiences as it crosses significant milestones in its extended run.

Fourth Monday Collections and Recent Dips

On its twenty-fifth day in theatres, the feature brought in a net collection of Rs 1.05 crore across 3,127 active shows throughout the domestic market. This figure represents a notable 65 percent drop compared to the business it generated on the preceding day.

Despite this weekday decline, the cumulative domestic net total for the film has climbed to Rs 369.95 crore, while the gross collection within India has reached an impressive Rs 443.15 crore.

International Performance and Global Totals

Beyond domestic borders, the cinematic venture has continued to add to its overseas tally, pulling in an additional Rs 25 lakh during its fourth Monday screenings.

This international contribution elevates the overseas gross to a substantial Rs 131.50 crore, bringing the combined worldwide gross collection of the movie to a staggering Rs 574.65 crore.

A Look Back at Weekly Earnings

The picture began its commercial journey with a massive opening week, accumulating a phenomenal Rs 245.50 crore. This was followed by a solid second week that added another Rs 87.50 crore to the ledger.

During its third week, the feature brought in Rs 28.85 crore. As it transitioned into its fourth week, it registered daily figures starting with Rs 1.40 crore on Day 22, before rising to Rs 2.65 crore and Rs 3 crore on the subsequent two days, leading up to the latest Monday figures.

Cast, Crew, and Creative Direction

Directed by Abhishek Pathak, the suspenseful drama brings back Ajay Devgn in his acclaimed role as the resourceful protagonist Vijay Salgaonkar, who must navigate fresh legal scrutiny and threats to his family.

The stellar ensemble cast also features prominent actors such as Tabu, Shriya Saran, Ishita Dutta, Mrunal Jadhav, Rajat Kapoor, Prakash Raj, and Jaideep Ahlawat, contributing to the dramatic weight of the narrative.

Plot Background and Release Context

The storyline picks up years after the protagonist successfully eluded law enforcement, forcing him to defend the elaborate alibis he constructed when a renewed investigation threatens to unravel his past.

The picture officially opened in cinemas on October 2, 2026, quickly establishing itself as a major box office contender before settling into its current steady phase of its theatrical exhibition.

ld.articleBody:
Omar Abdullah Endorses Qazi Touqeer

Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah has publicly extended his support to singer and reality television contestant Qazi Touqeer. Speaking during a podcast appearance, the political leader mentioned that he is well aware of Qazi's journey and is thoroughly impressed by his performance on the hit reality show Bigg Boss.

The Chief Minister noted that if given the opportunity, he would personally cast his vote for the singer. He expressed optimism about Qazi's prospects in the competition, hoping that he will emerge victorious and bring the winner's trophy home to Jammu and Kashmir.

Familiarity With Qazi's Musical Background

Omar Abdullah's appreciation for Qazi Touqeer stems from more than just his current television stint. The politician recalled watching the singer perform at various live concerts in the past and praised his melodious vocal abilities. He also mentioned reading about the contestant's progress and household dynamics in newspaper reports.

Highlighting Qazi's past achievements, the Chief Minister pointed out that the singer previously triumphed in a competitive reality show by defeating prominent artist Arijit Singh. This prior background has cemented Qazi's reputation as a talented performer in the eyes of many supporters.

A Nod To Regional Pride

The political leader expressed immense joy over Qazi Touqeer's strong standing in the Bigg Boss house, linking it to a broader wave of regional pride. He humorously compared the excitement to a recent moment when Jammu and Kashmir celebrated a victory in the Ranji Trophy cricket tournament.

With Qazi capturing the attention of viewers and fellow contestants alike, the Chief Minister feels that another major win for the region on national television would be a remarkable achievement. He emphasized that the singer's dedicated fanbase views him as a formidable contender for the ultimate title.

Addressing Controversies And Salman Khan's Scolding

During the podcast discussion, Omar Abdullah also referenced a notable incident involving show host Salman Khan and Qazi Touqeer. The superstar host had previously reprimanded the singer after Qazi jokingly spat near Scout's ear during a lighthearted moment.

Despite the temporary setback and the stern warning from Salman Khan, the Chief Minister believes that Qazi has managed to maintain his composure and focus on the overall competition. He noted that the contestant's ability to navigate house drama is a testament to his maturity.

Navigating House Politics And Alliances

Within the Bigg Boss house, Qazi Touqeer has occasionally taken a quieter approach, especially amidst intense clashes between other contestants like Scout and Love Gill. Although these surrounding disputes sometimes overshadow his screen time, Qazi has consistently focused on his individual path.

Observers have noted that the singer recently stepped in to mediate and help Love Gill understand the situation with Scout. This diplomatic handling of house tensions has earned him silent appreciation from both viewers and the show's host, Salman Khan.

ld.articleBody:
The Unreleased 90s Project

A long-lost promotional video for an undeveloped animated spin-off titled Escape from Jurassic Park has suddenly emerged online. Dating back to the summer of 1993, the project was conceived right after Steven Spielberg's dinosaur masterpiece became a massive box office phenomenon in theaters.

Long before any official sequels or modern animated adaptations like Jurassic World: Chaos Theory were created, Universal Cartoon Studios planned this ambitious cartoon. However, the endeavor was ultimately scrapped before full production could begin, leaving behind only this newly surfaced footage.

Targeting Mature Audiences

Unlike many typical television cartoons of that era designed strictly for younger viewers, this project was envisioned differently. The series aimed to appeal directly to the same mature audience that enjoyed the original live-action film.

Fan site Jurassic Outpost verified the authenticity of the vintage footage by cross-referencing it with previously discovered production materials. The clip proudly showcases distinct traditional 1990s animation aesthetics blended with nostalgic art direction.

Creative Leadership and Outlines

Production oversight for the ambitious undertaking fell to Will Meugniot, known for his work on The Real Ghostbusters and Captain Planet and the Planeteers. Meanwhile, the distinct visual look was crafted by renowned artist William Stout.

During the early planning stages, creators successfully outlined a complete first season consisting of 23 episodes. They also produced a one-minute pitch film to demonstrate the intended visual style, which even incorporated groundbreaking computer-generated imagery elements from MetroLight.

Reasons Behind the Cancellation

Despite having a full episode outline and a completed pitch trailer, the series never progressed past the initial development phase. Production stalled permanently due to creative and administrative roadblocks behind the scenes.

According to accounts from William Stout, director Steven Spielberg felt completely exhausted by the franchise and had zero interest in pursuing further expansions at that time. Other industry accounts suggested that Spielberg felt displeased because the project was commissioned entirely without his direct input.

Discovery and Fan Nostalgia

The revival of this vintage material came to light thanks to a tip shared by online accounts on Twitter. Fans of the franchise have since expressed immense nostalgia for the characteristic animation style representative of that period.

Although full episodes were never completed and this one-minute pitch remains the only surviving evidence of the production, its rediscovery offers a fascinating glimpse into what could have been.

ld.articleBody:
North American Run Ends After 105 Days

Christopher Nolan's latest directorial venture has officially concluded its box office run in North America. The cinematic project spent a total of 105 days playing in theaters across the domestic region before finally bidding farewell to the big screen.

During its final days in release, the feature managed to secure modest daily figures. On its 15th Thursday, operating across 144 screens in North America, the movie brought in $34k as it wrapped up its theatrical exhibition.

Domestic and Worldwide Totals

The cumulative domestic earnings for the feature reached a commendable $625.6 million by the time its theatrical run closed out. This domestic haul contributed significantly to its massive global performance.

On a broader scale, tracking data from Box Office Mojo indicates that the picture has accumulated over $1.79 billion globally. Industry analysts project that the original theatrical journey will ultimately conclude right around the $1.8 billion mark worldwide.

Global and IMAX Milestones

The project achieved staggering success in specialized viewing formats, most notably in IMAX. Industry figures show that the film pulled in an estimated $550 million globally from IMAX screenings alone, marking an all-time record for the format.

International markets contributed heavily to the massive overall gross, bringing in an estimated $1.17 billion to complement the domestic numbers.

Major Records and Rankings

The mythological epic established several notable box office milestones throughout its theatrical lifespan. Most prominently, it stands as Christopher Nolan's highest-grossing film of all time.

Additionally, the picture secured its place as the second-highest-grossing film of 2026 globally, trailing just behind Spider-Man: Brand New Day. It also ranks as the second-highest-grossing R-rated film domestically of all time and represents Universal's second-biggest release ever.

Star-Studded Cast and Critical Reception

Led by prominent Hollywood figures including Matt Damon and Anne Hathaway, the picture earned widespread acclaim upon release. Critics praised the scale and direction of the feature.

Alongside its massive commercial success, the project has also generated significant awards season buzz, widely regarded by industry observers as a major contender for upcoming Oscar recognition.

News Overview

Christopher Nolan's epic concluded its 105-day domestic theatrical run in North America with a total of $625.6 million, contributing to a worldwide gross of over $1.79 billion. Starring Matt Damon and Anne Hathaway, the film set multiple records including becoming Nolan's biggest hit and an all-time IMAX milestone.

ld.articleBody:
Opening Up About Postpartum Changes

Award-winning actress Jennifer Lawrence has recently shared candid details regarding her physical transformation following motherhood. In a recent media appearance, the Hollywood star verified that she underwent a breast lift procedure after welcoming her second child.

The conversation highlighted how her body evolved across multiple pregnancies, providing fans with an honest look into the personal choices public figures make when dealing with postpartum physical shifts.

Previous Discussions With The Media

This latest revelation builds upon comments Lawrence previously made during an extensive 2025 interview with a major publication. At that time, she reflected on filming a nude scene for a comedy project released in 2023.

She noted that while her physical form largely recovered after her initial pregnancy, the arrival of her second child brought much more noticeable and permanent changes to her body.

The Influence of a Film Career

When questioned about whether her profession as a prominent movie star uniquely influenced her decision to seek cosmetic surgery, Lawrence offered a pragmatic perspective.

She admitted that while her high-profile career might have accelerated her journey to the doctor's office, she likely would have pursued the procedure regardless of her celebrity status.

Perspectives on Other Cosmetic Treatments

Beyond discussing her breast lift, the actress touched on various other beauty enhancements and anti-aging treatments during her conversation with the press.

She mentioned that she intentionally avoids dermal fillers due to how they can alter appearance on high-definition camera lenses, though she humorously hinted at potential future procedures like a facelift.

Balancing Motherhood and Personal Image

Lawrence also reflected on the daily realities of raising children while maintaining a polished outward appearance. She expressed a desire to embody the concept of a stylish and confident mother.

Even during routine morning school drop-offs when she might feel overwhelmed internally, her personal goal remains presenting an organized and put-together exterior to the world.

News Overview

Jennifer Lawrence recently confirmed in an interview that she underwent a breast lift after experiencing significant postpartum body changes following her second child. The actress discussed how her high-profile career influenced the decision while also sharing her views on aging, cosmetic treatments, and balancing the demands of motherhood.

ld.articleBody:
First Look Unveiled At American Film Market

A promotional first look image has been revealed for the biographical feature Falcon, featuring actor Pierfrancesco Favino transformed into the late and ambitious Fiat-Chrysler chief executive Sergio Marchionne. Rai Cinema International Distribution released the photograph as part of its promotional efforts, preparing to present the project to international buyers at the upcoming American Film Market.

The newly published promotional photograph was captured on location at the historic Mirafiori manufacturing facility located in Turin. The landmark automotive plant is currently undergoing active renovation work while serving as a primary production site for the biographical movie.

Plot And Timeline Details

The cinematic narrative sets its starting point in the year 2004, capturing a precarious moment when the historic Italian automotive brand Fiat stood on the precipice of total collapse. This vulnerability followed directly after the passing of the enterprise's long-standing leader and legendary industrialist Gianni Agnelli.

Into this crisis steps Sergio Marchionne, who forcefully takes control of the dying enterprise to steer it away from destruction. The story details his aggressive restructuring tactics, including clearing out senior leadership and mentoring Gianni Agnelli's heir John Elkann, before expanding his sights toward conquering the North American market.

The Cast And Character Dynamics

Acclaimed actor Pierfrancesco Favino steps into the leading role of Sergio Marchionne, bringing his extensive dramatic experience from prior screen credits such as Il Traditore, Maria, and Rush to the demanding biographical portrayal. His character is depicted as both ruthless and visionary in his corporate strategies.

Joining the primary lead is actor Louis Garrel, who portrays John Elkann, the heir to Gianni Agnelli. The ensemble cast also features performances by Benedetta Cimatti and Barbara Ronchi, alongside a special participating appearance by Valeria Bruni Tedeschi.

Behind The Camera And Creative Team

The film's screenplay is a collaborative effort penned by director Marco Bellocchio alongside Ludovica Rampoldi, Andrea Di Stefano, and Stefano Rulli, with additional creative participation from Oliviero Del Papa. Distribution plans are already set for the picture to premiere in Italy through 01 Distribution.

Marco Bellocchio has also assembled a trusted team of frequent collaborators for the production. Production designer Andrea Castorina, costume designer Daria Calvelli, and editor Francesca Calvelli all return after previously working with the director on projects including The Traitor, Exterior Night, and Kidnapped.

Cinematic Style And New Collaborations

Director of photography Matteo Cocco joins the director's creative circle for the very first time on this feature. Cocco brings his previous cinematography expertise from titles such as The Weight and Hidden Away to help establish the film's visual tone.

The overarching narrative functions as a financial thriller infused with psychological insight. The story examines the personal tolls and heavy private costs that accompanied Marchionne's daring business maneuvers and his ultimate rise to global renown.

Historical Context Of The Automotive Empire

The narrative explores Marchionne's critical historical impact in reviving the Turin-based manufacturing institution Fiat during the decade of the 2000s. His leadership marked a defining chapter in modern European industrial history.

Beyond resuscitating the Italian brand, the storyline follows his strategy of orchestrating a major corporate merger with the struggling American manufacturer Chrysler. By engaging in high-stakes corporate battles against General Motors, Marchionne ultimately rescued the American car company from bankruptcy.

News Overview

Rai Cinema International Distribution has revealed a first look image of Pierfrancesco Favino as former Fiat-Chrysler executive Sergio Marchionne in Marco Bellocchio's biopic Falcon, currently filming at the Mirafiori plant in Turin. The feature follows Marchionne's rise beginning in 2004 as he takes over a struggling Fiat, mentors John Elkann, and executes major corporate maneuvers with Chrysler ahead of its American Film Market presentation.

The narrative explores Marchionne's critical historical impact in reviving the Turin-based manufacturing institution Fiat during the decade of the 2000s. His leadership marked a defining chapter in modern European industrial history.

ld.articleBody:
Celebrating a Daytime Emmy Sweep

Kelly Clarkson recently took to social media to celebrate a major triumph at the Daytime Emmy Awards, where her former daytime talk show secured a remarkable five wins out of eleven total nominations. The program, which wrapped up its broadcast run on NBC earlier in the year, was notably honored with the prestigious title of Outstanding Daytime Talk Series.

Sharing her excitement on Instagram, the musician posted a photograph of the production crew holding their trophies. She expressed her gratitude to the team and commemorated the journey, stating that it was an incredible seven years.

Looking Back at Seven Years

The journey of the popular daytime program began with its premiere in 2019, providing viewers with music, heartfelt interviews, and entertainment. Over its extensive run, the show established itself as a staple of daytime television and earned widespread critical and popular acclaim.

Throughout the series, Clarkson thanked both her loyal viewers and her broadcasting partner, NBC, noting that the network had consistently acted as a supportive and incredible partner since the very beginning.

The Decision to Step Away

News of the host's departure from the program first surfaced in January through media reports, with the songwriter confirming her exit the following month. Although she acknowledged that stepping away was not an easy choice, she emphasized that prioritizing her family was necessary.

Her final episode aired on September 1, marking the end of an era for the daytime favorite. During this emotional broadcast, she was joined on screen by her children, commemorating the conclusion of the series alongside her loved ones.

Prioritizing Family After Tragedy

The decision to end the successful talk show was deeply rooted in the host's desire to focus on her children, daughter River, age 12, and son Remington, age 10. The family experienced a profound loss when Brandon Blackstock, the children's father, passed away from cancer in August 2025 following a lengthy legal and personal history with Clarkson, which included their 2022 divorce.

Sources close to the family noted that the mother's primary focus has been ensuring her children feel loved, supported, and stable as they navigate their grief. Clarkson explained that stability and schedule were initially major reasons for doing the show, but also became the primary reasons it was time to say goodbye.

Returning to the Stage and Screen

Despite stepping away from her daily hosting duties, the entertainer has remained active on television screens. In May, it was announced that she would rejoin the coaching panel for the reality singing competition series The Voice.

Fans welcomed her return when Season 30 premiered on September 21. On the coaching panel, she sits alongside fellow mentors Adam Levine, Queen Latifah, and Riley Green.

News Overview

Kelly Clarkson celebrated a five-win sweep at the Daytime Emmy Awards just two months after her talk show concluded its seven-year run on NBC. The host stepped down from the series to prioritize her children following the passing of their father, Brandon Blackstock, while also returning to television as a coach on The Voice.
