ld.articleBody:
Chat Show Appearance Sparks Intense Online Debate

Last month, the joint appearance of Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna on the popular television programme Koffee With Karan Season 9 generated immense discussion across digital platforms. During the broadcast, the couple discussed their journey from professional co-stars to romantic partners, alongside their perspectives on marriage. However, several remarks made during the episode drew sharp reactions from viewers.

A portion of the audience expressed discomfort regarding specific exchanges, with critics accusing Vijay of displaying arrogance and treating Rashmika disrespectfully. The backlash gained further traction after a disclosure regarding marriage proposals circulated widely online, prompting intense social media scrutiny and negative commentary directed at the pair.

Public Backlash and Strong Reactions

The negative response on social networks quickly escalated, with various online users labelling the interaction as problematic and ego-driven. In response to the wave of criticism and critical commentary, Vijay Deverakonda did not hesitate to hit back at his detractors, utilizing strong language on social media while addressing online trolls directly.

The heated discourse demonstrated the intense scrutiny public figures face regarding their personal relationships when broadcast on mainstream television. Viewers scrutinized every gesture and comment, transforming a lighthearted chat show appearance into a major celebrity controversy.

Legal Action Taken Against Misinformation

In the wake of the controversy, Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna took formal legal measures to address allegedly false and misleading content circulating across the internet. Their manager, P Nishanth Kumar, lodged a formal complaint with the Hyderabad Cyber Crime authorities, requesting a thorough investigation into the matter.

Representatives for the couple clarified that the legal step was not intended to limit freedom of expression or suppress legitimate criticism. Instead, the action was specifically targeted at tackling fabricated digital information and unlawful online activities that emerged following their television interview.

Co-Star Vladimir Angelove Shares His Experience

Amid the ongoing controversy, Bulgarian actor Vladimir Angelove offered an alternative perspective based on his professional collaboration with the duo. Having shared screen space with Vijay and Rashmika in the upcoming Telugu period action drama Ranabaali, Angelove admitted that he had no prior knowledge of their immense stardom in India when he joined the project.

Reflecting on his time on set, Angelove described the pair as remarkably ordinary and approachable in the most positive sense. He noted that neither actor exhibited any signs of superiority or allowed their massive popularity to influence their interactions with international crew members.

Praising the Actors' Grounded Personalities

Detailing his interactions, Vladimir Angelove highlighted Rashmika Mandanna's warmth, simplicity, and sincerity as an artist performing her duties without the heavy weight of fame. He shared a similarly favourable impression of Vijay Deverakonda, noting that everything on set felt natural and comfortable.

The Bulgarian actor only realized the true scale of the duo's fame later on, after discussing his co-stars with an Indian friend. This realization led him to reflect on how genuinely successful individuals often do not feel the need to constantly remind others of their status.

Unfair to Judge Stars Based on Television

Addressing the backlash stemming from the chat show, Vladimir Angelove emphasized that it is unfair to form definitive judgments about individuals based solely on isolated moments broadcast on television. He stated that he could only speak from his personal professional experience working alongside them.

Concluding his thoughts, the actor reminded audiences that public fascination with celebrity culture often causes people to overlook the human being behind the public persona, reinforcing that his own interactions revealed two talented and unpretentious individuals.

News Overview

Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna faced heavy online criticism following their candid conversation on Koffee With Karan Season 9, leading the couple to file a formal complaint with Hyderabad Cyber Crime authorities through their manager against misleading digital content. Amid the ongoing backlash, their Ranabaali co-star Vladimir Angelove defended the pair, describing them as grounded and unpretentious based on his own professional experience working with them on set.

ld.articleBody:
Wicker Leads the Weekend Chart

Black Bear achieved a milestone by capturing its first-ever number one position at the UK and Ireland box office. The romantic fantasy feature Wicker opened impressively, pulling in figures that easily outpaced the competition during the late October weekend session.

The film secured a strong opening haul supported by a solid site average across its numerous screening locations. When factoring in preview screenings, the overall total for the newly released title rose further.

Cast and Creative Team Behind the Winner

Wicker brings together notable talent in front of and behind the camera. Olivia Colman and Alexander Skarsgard take on the leading roles in this imaginative project.

The narrative explores an unusual premise centered on a solitary fisherwoman who enlists a basket weaver to construct a husband for her. Directing duties for the feature were shared by Alex Hutson Fischer and Eleanor Wilson.

Strong Debuts and Holdovers in the Top Five

A24 made a notable impact on the charts with the arrival of Primetime, which opened in third place. Directed by Lance Oppenheim, the project features Robert Pattinson stepping into the role of former television host Chris Hansen.

Meanwhile, Lionsgate maintained a formidable presence with Ghosts: The Possession Of Button House. Benefiting directly from the Halloween holiday period, the horror comedy experienced a minimal drop in its second week, building substantially upon its cumulative earnings.

Warner Bros and Animation Performance

Warner Bros saw steady numbers from its comic-inspired villain story Clayface. The DC feature held its ground reasonably well during its second session, adding to its growing multi-million pound cume.

In the realm of animation, Laika Studios maintained a firm grip on the fifth position with Wildwood. Distributed by Black Bear, the animated feature managed to retain audience interest despite sliding slightly from its previous weekend placement.

Halloween Weekend Horrors and Classics

A variety of genre offerings capitalised on the holiday timing. Universal animated title Forgotten Island and Paramount release Streetfighter both continued their runs deep into their third weeks.

Specialized screenings also made waves, notably a 4K restoration of Ken Russell's classic 1971 feature The Devils, which achieved the highest screen average of the entire weekend across its select venues.

Other Notable Chart Entries

Studiocanal contributed to the diverse box office landscape with a re-release of Guillermo del Toro's acclaimed fantasy Pan's Labyrinth. At the same time, long-running titles such as Christopher Nolan's sprawling epic continued to pull in modest figures on their deep weekend sessions.

Independent and biographical projects also found modest space, including Metis Films' release of In The Shadows. Anthony Wonke directed this feature detailing the real-life journey of refugee Ramla Ali, who pursued boxing in secret to eventually claim championship status.

News Overview

Black Bear secured its first number one position at the UK and Ireland box office as the romantic fantasy Wicker debuted at the top spot. Alongside this release, A24 launched Primetime in third place while various horror titles and holdovers capitalized on the Halloween holiday weekend.

ld.articleBody:
Cliffhanger Joins Netflix Library

The 1993 action thriller Cliffhanger has officially arrived on Netflix, expanding the streaming platform's collection of classic genre films. Featuring Sylvester Stallone as a rugged mountain rescue expert, the feature adds vintage cinematic thrills to the library.

The arrival on the service gives subscribers a chance to revisit the high-stakes production ahead of upcoming franchise expansions scheduled for next year.

A High-Altitude Plot and Stellar Cast

Directed by Renny Harlin, the storyline follows Gabe Walker, a skilled mountain rescue specialist caught in a harrowing confrontation with violent criminals on treacherous peaks. The narrative blends breathtaking alpine visuals with intense survival elements.

The production features notable performances, including John Lithgow as the antagonist Eric Qualen, alongside Michael Rooker and Janine Turner as Ranger Jessie Deighan.

Box Office Success and Historical Context

Released during the early 1990s, the film proved to be a major commercial triumph in theaters. It generated $255 million globally against a production budget of $70 million, cementing its status as a definitive blockbuster of the decade.

The project arrived during a prolific era for its lead actor, following notable commercial releases and preceding other prominent sci-fi and action projects of the period.

Critical Reception and Reviews

While commercially successful, the title received a mixed response from professional reviewers upon its initial release. Modern aggregate metrics reflect a respectable 67% approval rating among critics on Rotten Tomatoes, alongside a 53% score from general audiences.

Critics noted that while the project drew inspiration from standard genre tropes, it successfully highlighted the physical and screen presence that established its leading man as a prominent global star.

The Long-Awaited Franchise Reboot

Decades after the original release, the intellectual property is set to expand into a full franchise. A completely reimagined reboot is scheduled to premiere on February 24, 2027.

The upcoming project features direction by Jaume Collet-Serra and a fresh cast led by Lily James and Nell Tiger Free, portraying sisters whose mountain excursion is interrupted alongside their mountaineer father, played by Pierce Brosnan.

Absence of Original Star in the New Project

The forthcoming 2027 reboot will proceed without any direct involvement from Sylvester Stallone, marking a distinct shift in creative direction for the property. An earlier attempt at a direct sequel titled Cliffhanger 2: The Dam ultimately never materialized.

As audiences prepare for the upcoming reimagining, the original cinematic entry remains accessible for viewers looking to experience the roots of the mountain-survival adventure.

News Overview

The 1993 action thriller Cliffhanger starring Sylvester Stallone has officially been added to the Netflix streaming library. The film, which grossed $255 million during its original theatrical run, joins the platform ahead of a completely new franchise reboot directed by Jaume Collet-Serra set for release in February 2027.

Sylvester Stallone's Cult Classic Action Film Cliffhanger Arrives on Netflix

The high-altitude 1990s blockbuster starring Sylvester Stallone has officially joined the Netflix streaming catalog as fans await a brand-new franchise reboot.

Published 1 November 2026

Cliffhanger Joins Netflix Library

The 1993 action thriller Cliffhanger has officially arrived on Netflix, expanding the streaming platform's collection of classic genre films. Featuring Sylvester Stallone as a rugged mountain rescue expert, the feature adds vintage cinematic thrills to the library.

The arrival on the service gives subscribers a chance to revisit the high-stakes production ahead of upcoming franchise expansions scheduled for next year.

A High-Altitude Plot and Stellar Cast

Directed by Renny Harlin, the storyline follows Gabe Walker, a skilled mountain rescue specialist caught in a harrowing confrontation with violent criminals on treacherous peaks. The narrative blends breathtaking alpine visuals with intense survival elements.

The production features notable performances, including John Lithgow as the antagonist Eric Qualen, alongside Michael Rooker and Janine Turner as Ranger Jessie Deighan.

Box Office Success and Historical Context

Released during the early 1990s, the film proved to be a major commercial triumph in theaters. It generated $255 million globally against a production budget of $70 million, cementing its status as a definitive blockbuster of the decade.

The project arrived during a prolific era for its lead actor, following notable commercial releases and preceding other prominent sci-fi and action projects of the period.

Critical Reception and Reviews

While commercially successful, the title received a mixed response from professional reviewers upon its initial release. Modern aggregate metrics reflect a respectable 67% approval rating among critics on Rotten Tomatoes, alongside a 53% score from general audiences.

Critics noted that while the project drew inspiration from standard genre tropes, it successfully highlighted the physical and screen presence that established its leading man as a prominent global star.

The Long-Awaited Franchise Reboot

Decades after the original release, the intellectual property is set to expand into a full franchise. A completely reimagined reboot is scheduled to premiere on February 24, 2027.

The upcoming project features direction by Jaume Collet-Serra and a fresh cast led by Lily James and Nell Tiger Free, portraying sisters whose mountain excursion is interrupted alongside their mountaineer father, played by Pierce Brosnan.

Absence of Original Star in the New Project

The forthcoming 2027 reboot will proceed without any direct involvement from Sylvester Stallone, marking a distinct shift in creative direction for the property. An earlier attempt at a direct sequel titled Cliffhanger 2: The Dam ultimately never materialized.

As audiences prepare for the upcoming reimagining, the original cinematic entry remains accessible for viewers looking to experience the roots of the mountain-survival adventure.

News Overview

The 1993 action thriller Cliffhanger starring Sylvester Stallone has officially been added to the Netflix streaming library. The film, which grossed $255 million during its original theatrical run, joins the platform ahead of a completely new franchise reboot directed by Jaume Collet-Serra set for release in February 2027.

Key facts

  • Cliffhanger was released on May 28, 1993.
  • The original film has a runtime of 112 minutes.
  • Cliffhanger grossed $255 million against a $70 million budget.
  • The film holds a 67% critic rating and a 53% audience rating on Rotten Tomatoes.
  • Cliffhanger was added to Netflix on November 1, 2026.
  • The upcoming reboot is scheduled to premiere on February 24, 2027.

ld.articleBody:
Global Milestone in Sight

The action drama Jailer 2 has continued its impressive theatrical journey, accumulating an estimated worldwide gross of Rs 744 crore by the conclusion of Tuesday, October 27, according to tracking data from Sacnilk.

With only a small gap remaining to hit the Rs 750 crore threshold, the film is performing steadily during its second week on the big screen.

Domestic Net Collections on Day 13

On its thirteenth day in theatres, the movie brought in an estimated Rs 7.50 crore net across India.

This followed a Monday collection of roughly Rs 9.45 crore, indicating a standard weekday downward adjustment of about 20.6 percent in daily earnings.

Cumulative Earnings and Overseas Contribution

The latest figures push the film's cumulative domestic net total to Rs 415.65 crore, while the domestic gross has reached Rs 486.50 crore.

International territories added an estimated Rs 2 crore on Tuesday, lifting the cumulative overseas gross to Rs 257.50 crore.

Language-Wise Performance Breakdown

The Tamil version remained the primary contributor to domestic revenues on Tuesday, bringing in an estimated Rs 4.15 crore net from 4,620 shows with a 21.2 percent occupancy rate.

Meanwhile, the Telugu version generated Rs 1.65 crore net, the Hindi version earned Rs 1.45 crore net, and the Kannada version added Rs 25 lakh to the total across their respective screenings.

Audience Footfall and Show Counts

Across all four linguistic versions, the movie was screened across an estimated 10,664 shows on its thirteenth day.

Data indicates that approximately 6.09 lakh tickets were purchased on Tuesday alone, bringing the cumulative estimated ticket sales to roughly 2.77 crore.

Cast and Production Team

The sequel features superstar Rajinikanth reprising his prominent role as the retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian, alongside returning actors Ramya Krishnan, Yogi Babu, Mirnaa, and Rithvik.

New additions to the ensemble include S. J. Suryah, Mithun Chakraborty, Suraj Venjaramoodu, and Vidya Balan, alongside special cameo appearances by notable stars like Mohanlal, Shiva Rajkumar, Hrithik Roshan, Jackie Shroff, Vijay Sethupathi, and Vinayakan.

Direction and Background

Jailer 2 was written and directed by Nelson Dilipkumar and produced by Kalanithi Maran under the Sun Pictures banner, following the massive success of the original 2023 film.

The technical crew features music director Anirudh Ravichander, cinematographer Vijay Kartik Kannan, and editor R. Nirmal.

News Overview

Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 reached an estimated worldwide gross of Rs 744 crore by October 27, 2026, driven by strong domestic net collections crossing Rs 415.65 crore. Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar and produced by Sun Pictures, the sequel continues a successful second week in multiple languages globally.

news:i3w7pz.k: Gunmaaster G9, Emraan Hashmi, Genelia Deshmukh, Dard E Dil, Himesh Reshammiya, Emraan Hashmi Gunmaaster G9, Genelia Deshmukh Gunmaaster G9, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
Introduction To Dard E Dil

The makers of the forthcoming movie Gunmaaster G9 have officially launched a fresh romantic single named Dard E Dil. The newly unveiled track showcases the on-screen chemistry between lead actors Emraan Hashmi and Genelia Deshmukh, offering audiences a softer and more emotional glimpse into a project otherwise known for its heavy action and drama.

Serving as a soulful addition to the film's musical profile, the song aims to balance out the high-octane sequences featured in the main narrative. By highlighting the emotional bond between the central characters, the track establishes a distinct melodic identity for the upcoming release.

Musical Composition And Creators

The creative forces behind Dard E Dil include composer and singer Himesh Reshammiya, who collaborated vocally with Akasa Singh. The composition blends contrasting vocal textures to enhance the romantic tone of the piece.

The lyrics for the single were penned by Sonia Kapoor Reshammiya, adding a poetic layer that complements Himesh Reshammiya's signature musical arrangement and gives the track its distinctive emotional resonance.

Insights From Himesh Reshammiya

Himesh Reshammiya expressed deep enthusiasm for the release, noting that it follows the blockbuster success of previous tracks like Afsaana Banaaya Aapne and Do Do Din Ki Zindagi. Those earlier releases collectively accumulated over 300 million views across various platforms, including more than 150 million views on his dedicated YouTube channel.

The composer highlighted that this specific song holds a personal place in his heart due to its vibrant composition and the specific poetic contributions provided by his wife, Sonia.

Director Aditya Datt On Family Legacy

Director Aditya Datt shared that Dard E Dil carries a profound personal connection for him. Specifically, the mukhda and hook line of the track evoke memories of his grandfather, the legendary lyricist Anand Bakshi, and his iconic song Dard-E-Dil Dard-E-Jigar from the classic film Karz.

Although the newly released single is an entirely independent and fresh composition, the underlying emotional nod to his grandfather's legacy makes the project particularly meaningful to the filmmaker.

Producer Perspective On The Soundscape

Producer Deepak Mukut emphasized the necessity of a strong musical foundation for a movie of this scale. He noted that Gunmaaster G9 requires a soundtrack that enhances the overall viewing experience.

According to the producer, the new melody supplies a warm and heartfelt dimension that grants the starring duo of Emraan and Genelia a distinct musical high within the narrative structure.

Cast And Crew Overview

Alongside Emraan Hashmi and Genelia D'Souza, the feature film stars Aparshakti Khurana and Abhishek Singh. The project is directed by Aditya Datt and jointly produced by Deepak Mukut, Hunar Mukut, and Sangeeta Ahir under SRE Studio LLP.

The movie is presented by Soham Rockstar Entertainment Pvt. Ltd. For distribution, PEN Marudhar is managing the all-India theatrical release, while Phar Films has taken charge of overseas distribution.

Release Details And Distribution

Gunmaaster G9 is categorized as an action romance and is officially scheduled for a worldwide theatrical release on November 27, 2026.

With promotional efforts now rolling out via musical additions like Dard E Dil, anticipation continues to build ahead of its scheduled arrival in cinemas.

News Overview

Gunmaaster G9 has released a new romantic track titled Dard E Dil, featuring lead actors Emraan Hashmi and Genelia Deshmukh. Composed and sung by Himesh Reshammiya alongside Akasa Singh with lyrics by Sonia Kapoor Reshammiya, the song adds a melodic layer to the action film directed by Aditya Datt and produced by Deepak Mukut, Hunar Mukut, and Sangeeta Ahir. The film is slated for a worldwide theatrical release on November 27, 2026.

news:ipem28.d: Bruce Power takes Unit 5 offline to launch a major component replacement project as Ontario faces a surging demand for clean, low-carbon power.
news:ipem28.k: Bruce Power Unit 5, Ontario nuclear overhaul, Stephen Lecce energy, Eric Chassard Bruce Power, Stephen Lecce, Stephen Lecce Eric Chassard, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
The Shutdown of Unit 5

Technicians officially disconnected Unit 5 at the Bruce nuclear generating station, initiating a scheduled Major Component Replacement outage. This comprehensive core rebuild aims to extend the operational life of the reactor by an additional 30 to 35 years.

The shutdown represents the exact midway point of a privately financed Life-Extension Program intended to modernize six reactors across the facility by the year 2033.

Inside the Reactor Vault

Crews face an intensive mechanical undertaking within the reactor vault. Workers are tasked with completely stripping out and replacing 480 calandria tubes alongside an equal number of pressurized fuel channels.

Additionally, technical teams will fit 960 feeder tubes and hoist massive new steam generators into place, ensuring the renewed reactor continues producing low-carbon baseload electricity and medical isotopes.

Rising Power Demands in Ontario

The commencement of work on Unit 5 coincides with a critical period for Canada's most populous province. Provincial officials project that overall electricity demand will surge by 90 percent by 2050.

This dramatic increase in power consumption is being driven primarily by rapid industrial expansion and widespread electrification across the region.

Momentum From Previous Refits

Project teams are entering the Unit 5 refit buoyed by strong momentum from the neighboring Unit 4 outage. Engineers on Unit 4 completed the installation of 480 calandria tubes nearly a month ahead of schedule in October 2026.

Earlier phases of the multi-billion-dollar initiative also yielded strong results, with Unit 3 returning to commercial service months ahead of schedule and Unit 6 finishing under budget in 2023.

Leadership Perspectives and Future Schedule

Stephen Lecce, Ontario Minister of Energy and Mines, emphasized that extending the asset's life delivers reliable, affordable electricity while keeping 95 percent of spending within Canada. Bruce Power CEO Eric Chassard noted that performance improves with every successive refit.

To hit long-term targets, Bruce Power will run overlapping reactor outages continuously for seven years. Unit 7 will shut down in 2028, followed by Unit 8 in 2030, with planners also evaluating a second overhaul for Units 1 and 2.

News Overview

Bruce Power has taken Unit 5 offline to begin a major component replacement outage as part of a multi-billion-dollar life-extension program. The intensive overhaul seeks to modernize the reactor and secure clean electricity for Ontario as regional power demand rises.

news:iqeelc.d: Director CS Amudhan has officially started production on Tamizh Padam 3, bringing back actor Shiva for the third chapter of the popular Tamil spoof franchise.
news:iqeelc.k: Tamizh Padam 3, CS Amudhan, Shiva, YNOT Studios, CS Amudhan Tamizh Padam 3, Shiva Tamizh Padam 3, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
The Return of the Parody Franchise

Director CS Amudhan has commenced shooting for Tamizh Padam 3, the upcoming third instalment in the famous Tamil parody series. Fans of the franchise can look forward to another round of clever satire, with lead actor Shiva stepping back into the spotlight.

The project was announced on Thursday, November 5. The inaugural first-look poster signals a shift into uncharted cosmic territory, presenting Shiva under a fresh title rather than his previous moniker.

First-Look Poster Teases Intergalactic Adventure

In the newly released promotional visual, Shiva is introduced as the Intergalactic Superstar, replacing his famous Agila Ulaga Superstar tag from earlier films. The poster shows the actor dressed in a sharp suit while facing an alien spacecraft.

While plot specifics remain under wraps, the extraterrestrial imagery suggests that sci-fi tropes and space elements will feature prominently in the upcoming satirical universe. Producers are expected to share more updates regarding the supporting cast and crew in due course.

Behind the Production and Studios

The upcoming comedy is backed by AP International and YNOT Studios. Producers S Sashikanth and Chakravarthy Ramachandra are spearheading the production efforts for the venture.

YNOT Studios shares a long-standing relationship with the franchise, having successfully bankrolled both of the preceding films. Their continued involvement ensures that the distinct comedic tone of the series will remain intact.

Looking Back at Tamizh Padam and Tamizh Padam 2

CS Amudhan made his directorial debut with the original Tamizh Padam in 2010. At a time when commercial Tamil cinema leaned heavily on predictable storytelling, exaggerated hero intros, and formulaic romances, the film offered a refreshing counter-narrative through relentless parody.

The director followed up with Tamizh Padam 2 in 2018, which arrived eight years prior to the current third instalment. The sequel expanded its comedic scope to mock contemporary Tamil films, police tropes, and international pop culture references such as Game of Thrones.

Recent Projects of the Director and Star

ld.articleBody:
Strong Opening Momentum

The much-awaited mythological epic 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend' is witnessing an extraordinary wave of early interest, quickly approaching the significant Rs 25 crore mark in pre-release ticket sales. As the feature prepares for its grand theatrical rollout, tracking data compiled by Films Discourse indicates exceptional enthusiasm from audiences across the country.

Advance Booking Figures

Early box office tallies reveal that the feature has already moved approximately 2.16 lakh admissions across 161 urban centers. This initial surge has translated into an estimated gross total of Rs 12.50 crore strictly through advance reservations for its opening weekend.

Collections and Blocked Seats

Analyzing the financial metrics reveals a nuanced picture of the pre-sale performance. When excluding specifically blocked seats, the net collection generated by these early reservations sits at an estimated Rs 10.57 crore.

However, factoring in all currently blocked inventory significantly elevates the figures, bringing the reported gross collection closer to the projected milestones at an impressive Rs 23.28 crore, setting the stage for a blockbuster opening week.

Regional and City Dominance

Geographically, the state of Maharashtra has emerged as the clear frontrunner in driving these advance booking numbers. Audiences within the state have secured a remarkable 46,937 tickets, contributing an estimated Rs 3.20 crore to the pre-release tally.

At the city level, Mumbai stands proudly at the forefront of metropolitan ticket sales. The city alone accounted for 27,959 purchased admissions, generating an estimated collection of Rs 2.07 crore and cementing its status as a primary stronghold for the film.

Language and Format Preferences

A closer look at the linguistic distribution shows that the Hindi version is overwhelmingly driving the pre-sale momentum. Reports indicate that 1,84,010 tickets for the Hindi-language screenings have been snapped up by eager fans, yielding an estimated Rs 10.98 crore.

In terms of presentation formats, immersive 3D screenings are capturing a substantial share of the excitement. While specific tallies vary across reporting entries—with one dataset indicating 1,28,575 tickets generating Rs 6.51 crore and another pointing to 1,41,183 tickets bringing in Rs 7.10 crore—the format is undeniably proving to be a major draw for moviegoers.

Cast and Creative Leadership

The immense pre-release traction can largely be attributed to its stellar ensemble cast and celebrated creative team. Helmed by acclaimed director Nitesh Tiwari, the project brings together some of the biggest names in Indian cinema to breathe new life into the timeless epic.

Ranbir Kapoor takes on the revered role of Lord Ram, while Yash steps into the formidable persona of Ravana. The film also features Sai Pallavi as Sita, Sunny Deol as Hanuman, and Ravie Dubey as Lakshman, creating a powerhouse lineup for the worldwide theatrical launch.

Global Theatrical Launch

The massive advance ticket sales underscore the sky-high expectations surrounding the first part of this ambitious cinematic journey. Industry analysts and fans alike are watching the numbers closely as the release date approaches.

With a scheduled worldwide theatrical premiere on Thursday, November 5, 2026, 'Ramayana: Part 1' is poised to make a monumental splash at the box office, potentially rewriting opening-weekend records upon its arrival.

Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the movie features stars like Ranbir Kapoor and Yash, with strong early momentum driven largely by Hindi screenings, 3D formats, and strong sales in Maharashtra and Mumbai.

ld.articleBody:
The Halloween Box Office Slowdown

With Halloween falling on a Saturday, the box office faces a notoriously quiet weekend as audiences turn their attention to trick-or-treating, costume parties, and handing out candy instead of heading to movie theaters. Recognizing this holiday dip, major studios have cleared the calendar, leaving zero major studio releases to challenge the festive weekend.

The historical precedent for this frame is particularly bleak. Last year's Halloween weekend plummeted to a dismal $55.5 million, marking the lowest grossing frame in more than 30 years and setting a challenging benchmark for current theatrical runs.

You Can See Everything Seeks Continuation of Surge

A24's documentary about Elizabeth Holmes, titled You Can See Everything, is aiming for a first-place finish with a predicted $12 million to $17 million in its third weekend. Directed by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim, the film has consistently beaten expectations every week since its debut.

The documentary experienced an impressive 25% bump in its sophomore frame and currently boasts a domestic total of $45.1 million, positioning it as a formidable contender for the weekend crown.

Clayface Mounts a Strong Defense

Challenging for the top spot is Warner Bros. and DC Studios' body-horror origin story, Clayface. The film won the previous weekend with $24 million and secured an A-minus grade from CinemaScore.

Despite its strong initial reception, horror features typically face an uphill battle when a holiday like Halloween draws crowds away from indoor screenings. Current projections place its second-weekend gross between $10 million and $15 million.

Holdovers Round Out the Top Five

Laika's stop-motion fantasy film Wildwood is tracking comfortably for third place with anticipated earnings of $6 million to $8 million. The picture initially opened to $12.3 million—surpassing estimates by over $1 million—and maintains a pristine 100% score on Rotten Tomatoes alongside an A CinemaScore.

Further down the chart, Wicker and Street Fighter are projected to scrap for the remaining positions in the top five, with both titles looking at roughly $4 million each.

Fresh Additions Face Quiet Debuts

A small wave of new releases arrives in theaters with limited expectations of breaking into the top tier. Briarcliff's Christmas-themed horror movie Christmas at the Kringles enters as the widest new platform release.

Additional fresh arrivals include Samuel Goldwyn's action-thriller The Mongoose starring Liam Neeson, Disney's IMAX documentary Everest: The Other Side, and Sony Classics' expansion of The Only Living Pickpocket in New York starring John Turturro.

Projected Weekend Rankings

Industry tracking anticipates You Can See Everything to lead the box office charts with $14 million, closely followed by Clayface at $12 million.

The remaining projected top five positions include Wildwood at $7 million, alongside Wicker and Street Fighter, which are both expected to pull in $4 million.

News Overview

A quiet Halloween weekend devoid of major studio openings leaves holdovers You Can See Everything and Clayface to battle for the number one box office position. Previous holiday frames have historically struggled, setting a modest stage for these competing films and steady holdovers like Wildwood.

As trick-or-treaters keep audiences away from cinemas, a handful of specialty newcomers debut with modest expectations while established hits attempt to sustain their momentum.

ld.articleBody:
Surprise Halloween Release

Viewers tuning into streaming platforms for the holiday season received an unexpected surprise when a brand new chapter of a popular horror series suddenly appeared online. Rather than waiting for a full second season, enthusiasts of the terrifying television universe gained immediate access to a special thirty-minute installment.

The surprise drop served as a holiday treat, eliminating the lengthy waiting periods typically associated with major television productions and giving audiences fresh content right on the holiday itself.

Exploring Ancient History

Instead of focusing on the familiar shape-shifting clown that haunts the main narrative, this special installment shifts its focus far back in time. The storyline unfolds centuries before the primary events of the television series.

At the center of the plot are the members of the fictional Shokopiwah tribe. This Indigenous group previously appeared in the fourth episode of the inaugural season, and the new release delves deeper into their historical connection to the land.

Synopsis And Plot Details

According to the official summary provided for the release, the narrative follows three young individuals as they embark on a fateful journey into the Western Wood. During their expedition, they cross paths with a malevolent ancient entity.

The encounter highlights the deep-seated horrors that plagued the geographic location long before the modern town was ever established, expanding the overarching mythology of the franchise.

Creative Team Behind The Episode

The production of this special chapter was guided by a talented group of creators known for their work in television and storytelling. Directing duties were handled by Tazbah Chavez, recognized for contributions to Reservation Dogs.

The script was a collaborative writing effort penned by Cherie Dimaline and Jasmyne Flournoy, who crafted the narrative detailing the ancient encounters in the woods.

Finding The Content On Streaming

Following the sudden launch, some subscribers initially reported minor difficulties locating the thirty-minute special within the streaming application interface. Platform guides noted that the release could be accessed easily by checking the related section situated on the main page for the series.

The direct integration ensures that viewers searching for holiday scares can readily add the special viewing experience to their holiday watchlist without unnecessary complications.

ld.articleBody:
Introduction of the New Identity

The production banner Mahaveer Jain Films has officially refreshed its corporate branding by revealing a brand new moving logo. This updated visual design carries a distinct spiritual theme and is dedicated to Maa Saraswati, the revered Hindu deity associated with wisdom, knowledge, creativity, and music.

By aligning their brand identity with such divine principles, the studio aims to emphasize values of purity and spirituality in their upcoming cinematic ventures. The transition marks a notable step in the evolution of the production house as it steps forward with a renewed creative vision.

Inspiration from Rajshri's Longstanding Legacy

A major driving force behind the conception of this new logo is the remarkable 79-year filmmaking history of Rajshri Films. The legendary studio has spent nearly eight decades championing wholesome family entertainment rooted in traditional values, joy, and love.

Drawing from this rich heritage, Mahaveer Jain Films hopes to channel a similar ethos in their own storytelling approach. The creators noted that they sought the blessings of Maa Saraswati to guide their ongoing pursuit of artistic wisdom and creative excellence.

The Musical Composition Behind the Title Card

To bring the new title card to life on screen, renowned music composer Tanishk Bagchi crafted a custom auditory experience. His composition blends a deeply devotional atmosphere with modern cinematic grandeur.

The resulting audio-visual package is designed to captivate audiences the moment it plays in theaters, setting a spiritual and engaging tone right before the main feature begins.

Theatrical Debut with Yeh Prem Mol Liya

The newly designed logo is scheduled to make its very first appearance on the big screen with the upcoming movie Yeh Prem Mol Liya. Directed by Sooraj Barjatya, the film boasts a star-studded cast featuring Ayushmann Khurrana and Sharvari.

This theatrical release represents a significant milestone, making it the pioneer platform to display the banner's updated visual identity to general audiences worldwide.

Continuing Creative Partnerships

The connection between Rajshri and Mahaveer Jain Films is far from new, having previously collaborated on the 2022 film Uunchai. Their continued synergy highlights a shared commitment to producing meaningful stories for cinema lovers.

Yeh Prem Mol Liya further cements this creative alliance, bridging the traditional values upheld by Rajshri with the contemporary production outlook of Mahaveer Jain Films.

Upcoming Slates and Future Projects

Following the launch and theatrical run of Yeh Prem Mol Liya, Mahaveer Jain Films has already lined up several diverse projects for future release. Among these highly anticipated titles are Naagzilla and White.

These upcoming ventures indicate an active pipeline for the studio as they integrate their newly minted spiritual branding across a variety of upcoming cinematic genres.

The new identity is set to make its theatrical debut in Sooraj Barjatya's Yeh Prem Mol Liya, starring Ayushmann Khurrana and Sharvari, before continuing into future projects like Naagzilla and White.

Mahaveer Jain Films Unveils New Logo Dedicated to Maa Saraswati and Inspired by Rajshri Legacy

Mahaveer Jain Films has revealed a spiritual new moving logo that draws inspiration from Rajshri's 79-year legacy and features a musical composition by Tanishk Bagchi.

Published 3 November 2026

Introduction of the New Identity

The production banner Mahaveer Jain Films has officially refreshed its corporate branding by revealing a brand new moving logo. This updated visual design carries a distinct spiritual theme and is dedicated to Maa Saraswati, the revered Hindu deity associated with wisdom, knowledge, creativity, and music.

By aligning their brand identity with such divine principles, the studio aims to emphasize values of purity and spirituality in their upcoming cinematic ventures. The transition marks a notable step in the evolution of the production house as it steps forward with a renewed creative vision.

Inspiration from Rajshri's Longstanding Legacy

A major driving force behind the conception of this new logo is the remarkable 79-year filmmaking history of Rajshri Films. The legendary studio has spent nearly eight decades championing wholesome family entertainment rooted in traditional values, joy, and love.

Drawing from this rich heritage, Mahaveer Jain Films hopes to channel a similar ethos in their own storytelling approach. The creators noted that they sought the blessings of Maa Saraswati to guide their ongoing pursuit of artistic wisdom and creative excellence.

The Musical Composition Behind the Title Card

To bring the new title card to life on screen, renowned music composer Tanishk Bagchi crafted a custom auditory experience. His composition blends a deeply devotional atmosphere with modern cinematic grandeur.

The resulting audio-visual package is designed to captivate audiences the moment it plays in theaters, setting a spiritual and engaging tone right before the main feature begins.

Theatrical Debut with Yeh Prem Mol Liya

The newly designed logo is scheduled to make its very first appearance on the big screen with the upcoming movie Yeh Prem Mol Liya. Directed by Sooraj Barjatya, the film boasts a star-studded cast featuring Ayushmann Khurrana and Sharvari.

This theatrical release represents a significant milestone, making it the pioneer platform to display the banner's updated visual identity to general audiences worldwide.

Continuing Creative Partnerships

The connection between Rajshri and Mahaveer Jain Films is far from new, having previously collaborated on the 2022 film Uunchai. Their continued synergy highlights a shared commitment to producing meaningful stories for cinema lovers.

Yeh Prem Mol Liya further cements this creative alliance, bridging the traditional values upheld by Rajshri with the contemporary production outlook of Mahaveer Jain Films.

Upcoming Slates and Future Projects

Following the launch and theatrical run of Yeh Prem Mol Liya, Mahaveer Jain Films has already lined up several diverse projects for future release. Among these highly anticipated titles are Naagzilla and White.

These upcoming ventures indicate an active pipeline for the studio as they integrate their newly minted spiritual branding across a variety of upcoming cinematic genres.

news:j0pstn.d: The Malayalam fantasy action film I'm Game, starring Dulquer Salmaan and directed by Nahas Hidhayath, is officially heading to digital platforms in November…
news:j0pstn.k: I'm Game OTT release, Dulquer Salmaan I'm Game, I'm Game JioHotstar, I'm Game Malayalam movie, I'm Game, Dulquer Salmaan, Nahas Hidhayath I'm Game, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
Digital Premiere Details

The Malayalam fantasy action movie I'm Game is officially scheduled for its digital debut following its run in theaters. The streaming platform JioHotstar made the announcement regarding the online premiere through its social media channels.

Fans can expect the film to arrive on the streaming service on November 6, 2026. This digital release gives viewers who missed the theatrical run a chance to watch the project from home.

Multilingual Availability

To cater to a broader audience across different regions, the digital release will not be restricted to just its native tongue. The movie is set to launch in a total of five languages.

Subscribers will be able to stream the feature in Malayalam, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, and Kannada. This extensive language support aims to expand the reach of the project into multiple entertainment markets.

Plot and Premise

The narrative centers around a wealthy yet lazy businessman named Dan John who resides in Hyderabad. Dan struggles with a severe gambling addiction that begins to create major disruptions in both his professional endeavors and personal life.

Things escalate during a chaotic sports betting session that lands Dan in a perilous predicament. This pivotal moment triggers a chain of unpredictable events blending elements of fantasy and action.

Lead Cast and Crew

Dulquer Salmaan takes on the central role of Dan John in the feature. The film also features a diverse ensemble cast including Antony Varghese, Kayadu Lohar, Mysskin, Samyuktha Viswanathan, Kathir, Vinay Forrt, and Parth Tiwari.

Notably, the project marks the Malayalam cinema debut for actor and filmmaker Mysskin. The direction and story development were handled by Nahas Hidhayath.

Production and Technical Team

The screenplay for the production was penned jointly by Sajeer Baba, Ismail Aboobacker, and Bilal Moidu. Meanwhile, the dialogue was crafted by Adarsh Sukumaran, Shabas Rasheed, and Sajeer Baba.

Behind the camera, Jimshi Khalid served as the cinematographer while Chaman Chakko managed the editing. The production design was overseen by Ajayan Chalissery.

Music and Production Banner

The auditory experience of the movie is shaped by Jakes Bejoy, who composed both the original score and the songs. His work complements the high-stakes fantasy action tone of the feature.

The project was bankrolled by Dulquer Salmaan and Jom Varghese under their production banner, Wayfarer Films.

Theatrical Background

Before its upcoming transition to the digital space, I'm Game originally opened in movie theaters on September 3, 2026. The theatrical run established the foundation for its subsequent OTT rollout.

With the arrival of the streaming window, the fantasy action title transitions from cinemas to home screens, marking a new phase for its audience availability.

News Overview

Dulquer Salmaan's Malayalam fantasy action film I'm Game, directed by Nahas Hidhayath, is set to release on JioHotstar on November 6, 2026. The multilingual project will be available in Malayalam, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, and Kannada following its September 3, 2026 theatrical run.

news:j2m5kr.k: Jailer 2 box office, Rajinikanth Jailer 2 collections, Jailer 2 3rd Saturday collection, Jailer 2 500 crore club, Rajinikanth Jailer 2, Jailer 2, Rajinikanth, Nelson Dilipkumar Jailer 2, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
Third Saturday Surge at the Box Office

Rajinikanth's high-octane action drama Jailer 2 has continued its stellar theatrical run by pulling in an impressive Rs 10.50 crore on its third Saturday. This figure marks a significant 70 percent spike compared to the collections of the previous day, demonstrating strong lingering audience interest.

With this latest single-day boost, the film's cumulative domestic total has climbed to a staggering Rs 497 crore. Trade analysts note that the movie is on the absolute verge of crossing the major milestone of Rs 500 crore by the end of the day.

Milestones and Historical Standing

Reaching the half-thousand crore mark will cement Jailer 2 as only the second Tamil film in history to achieve this feat at the Indian box office, following the path paved by 2.0.

Furthermore, the mass entertainer is positioned to surpass 2.0 entirely to become the highest-grossing Tamil film domestically. Notably, the movie has already claimed the top position at the worldwide box office.

Breakdown of Weekly Earnings

The journey to Rs 497 crore has been built on exceptionally strong weekly holds. During its first week in theaters, the actioner raked in a massive Rs 375.50 crore.

Even as it transitioned into its second week, the film added another steady Rs 104.75 crore, followed by Rs 6.25 crore on its third Friday before the major weekend spike on Saturday.

Dominance in Tamil Nadu and Regional Markets

In its home state of Tamil Nadu, the Rajinikanth vehicle has smashed past Rs 192.25 crore so far and is barreling quickly toward the prestigious Rs 200 crore milestone.

Meanwhile, the film's run in the Telugu states of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana has nearly drawn to a close, pulling in around Rs 88.50 crore as newer regional releases enter the competitive landscape over the weekend.

Pankaj Mania Across Neighboring States

The star power of Rajinikanth generated record-shattering numbers in neighboring Karnataka and Kerala, where Jailer 2 successfully established itself as the highest-grossing Tamil film in both regions.

In addition to its stronghold in southern territories, the action drama managed a solid performance across the Rest of India region, bringing in Rs 52.00 crore despite a lack of distribution in national multiplex chains.

Territorial Revenue Summary

A closer look at the territorial collection breakdown highlights the widespread appeal of the movie across diverse linguistic and geographic markets.

Tamil Nadu contributed Rs 192.25 crore, Andhra Pradesh and Telangana added Rs 88.50 crore, Karnataka brought in Rs 88.50 crore, Kerala accounted for Rs 75.75 crore, and the Rest of India contributed Rs 52.00 crore, culminating in the Rs 497.00 crore domestic grand total.

Trade Estimates and Nature of Figures

Industry observers remind audiences that these box office metrics, including opening-day forecasts and lifetime collection projections, are subjective trade estimates.

These figures are compiled using commercial parameters, advance booking trends, and general market sentiment rather than being certified accounting statements.

News Overview

Rajinikanth's action drama Jailer 2 earned Rs 10.50 crore on its third Saturday, bringing its total domestic collections to Rs 497 crore. The Nelson Dilipkumar directorial is on the verge of entering the Rs 500 crore club as the second Tamil film to do so.

ld.articleBody:
Release Date Announced

Fans of the popular college romance series can mark their calendars as the upcoming premiere date has been officially revealed. The second installment of the hit show is scheduled to arrive on Prime Video in the spring.

Viewers will be able to stream the new episodes starting April 28, 2027, continuing the romantic and dramatic narratives established in the first outing.

Focus on Allie and Dean

The upcoming season will shift its narrative focus toward the central romance between the characters Allie Hayes and Dean Di Laurentis.

Mika Abdalla will portray Allie Hayes, while Stephen Kalyn will step into the role of Dean Di Laurentis, bringing the popular literary couple to life on screen.

Source Material and Background

The television adaptation draws its inspiration from the bestselling book series written by author Elle Kennedy, capturing the emotional complexities of young adults.

The narrative centers around an elite ice hockey team and the women in their lives, exploring themes of love, heartbreak, personal growth, and enduring friendships during the transition into adulthood.

Strong Viewership Legacy

The television series achieved a robust debut following its initial launch on the streaming platform, resonating strongly with audiences worldwide.

During its first 12 days on Prime Video, the first season reportedly accumulated 36 million viewers globally, establishing a solid foundation for the second chapter.

Expanding Ensemble Cast

A diverse group of actors will return as series regulars alongside the main leads, including Ella Bright, Belmont Cameli, Antonio Cipriano, Jalen Thomas Brooks, and India Fowler.

The expanded cast also features recurring guest stars such as Julia Sarah-Stone, Khobe Clarke, Miles Gutierrez-Riley, Phillipa Soo, Charlie Evans, and Shay Rudolph.

Creative Leadership

The creative vision behind the adaptation is guided by creator Louisa Levy, who also serves as co-showrunner and executive producer alongside Gina Fattore.

Additional executive production duties are handled by Wyck Godfrey, Marty Bowen, James Seidman, Leanna Billings, and Neal Flaherty, with Annika Patton acting as co-executive producer.

News Overview

The streaming platform has officially scheduled the release of the second season of the college romance series for April 28, 2027. The upcoming episodes will spotlight the romance between Allie Hayes and Dean Di Laurentis, building upon the strong global viewership achieved by its predecessor.

news:j4wc2t.d: Almost twenty years after his mother captured an accidental moment on a beach, Sam Griner reflects on growing up as the face of the internet's most famous…
news:j4wc2t.k: Sam Griner, Success Kid meme, Laney Griner, Justin Griner, Sam Griner Laney Griner, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
The Origins of a Viral Sensation

In 2007, an eleven-month-old infant named Sam Griner was photographed by his mother, Laney Griner, while visiting a beach. The candid snapshot captured the baby clutching a fistful of sand right before attempting to eat it. Laney uploaded the image to her Flickr account the very same day, initially garnering around three hundred likes before she largely put it out of her mind. However, within twelve months, the picture began resurfacing across digital platforms with various alterations and captions added by unknown users.

Losing Control to the Internet

As the image spread, the family quickly realized they had lost complete control over the photograph. One of the earliest edited versions featured a ruined sandcastle in the backdrop alongside the caption declaring a hatred for sandcastles. Because the family was unfamiliar with internet culture at the time and aware that early memes typically targeted individuals mockingly, they experienced a sense of helplessness as the picture proliferated globally.

How the Success Kid Title Was Born

Eventually, internet users superimposed the image over a blue and green background, designating it as the Success Kid meme. Laney Griner noted that this title carried a profound personal resonance because Sam had been born prematurely and underwent critical brain surgery at just six weeks of age. Believing the moniker was remarkably fitting for her son, she embraced the name gifted to the baby by the online community.

Global Reach and Surreal Encounters

Over the years, the photograph transcended standard internet forums to appear in high-profile locations. The image was utilized in various advertising campaigns, featured prominently in a Super Bowl commercial, displayed inside Barack Obama's White House, and printed in newspapers around the world. Growing up with this level of accidental notoriety brought mixed feelings for Sam, who occasionally encountered fans asking him to recreate the iconic pose or inquiring about the taste of sand.

Navigating Identity Beyond the Meme

Approaching adulthood nearly two decades after achieving digital fame, Sam Griner spends much of his time listening to music and pursuing artistic endeavors, an interest he inherited from his father, Justin. While he appreciates the widespread reach of the image, he has expressed a clear desire not to be defined solely by a single viral photo from his infancy, noting that personal mindsets, bodies, and interests evolve significantly over time.

Family Health Crisis and Crowdfunding Support

The meme also played an unexpected role during a severe family health crisis when Sam's father, Justin, developed chronic kidney disease. After enduring six years of dialysis, Justin struggled to qualify for a necessary kidney transplant due to the high cost of anti-rejection medications. Although initially hesitant to invoke the meme, the family launched a GoFundMe campaign that gained significant traction after being shared on Twitter, successfully surpassing its financial goal within the first week.

Legacy and Looking Forward

Today, the legacy of the meme extends into professional medical spaces, where nurses and doctors reportedly use the image to help get through challenging workdays. Sam has shared his happiness that a picture capturing him simply eating sand can bring comfort to individuals who save lives daily. Looking to the future, Sam hopes to eventually create original works that inspire others just as much as his viral baby photograph did.

News Overview

Sam Griner reflects on his life nearly two decades after becoming the global internet sensation known as Success Kid at eleven months old. The article explores how his mother's casual Flickr upload transformed into a worldwide meme appearing in Super Bowl commercials and the White House, while also detailing a successful fundraising campaign for his father's medical needs.

news:jatrko.k: Salman Khan house firing shooter bail, Vickykumar Gupta brother wedding jail, Salman Khan Galaxy Apartment shooting case, Lawrence Bishnoi gang Bollywood threats, Salman Khan Galaxy Apartment, Galaxy Apartment, Salman Khan, Vickykumar Gupta Galaxy Apartment, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
Special Court Rejects Temporary Bail Plea

A special court in proceedings on Wednesday officially denied temporary freedom to Vickykumar Gupta. Gupta stands as an accused shooter linked directly to the high-profile 2024 firearms incident outside the residence of prominent Bollywood actor Salman Khan.

The legal petition requested temporary release so that the applicant could travel and participate in family wedding festivities in his home state. Specifically, the plea aimed for release on designated dates at the beginning of December 2026.

Virtual Attendance via Video Conferencing

Although physical release was firmly rejected by the judiciary, the presiding judge offered an alternative solution for the family event. Prison officials received instructions to set up appropriate video conferencing facilities so the accused could watch and take part digitally.

This virtual participation remains strictly contingent upon technical feasibility and prison security standards. Authorities will supervise the digital link closely to ensure adherence to standard jail regulations without granting actual custody freedom.

Family Wedding Location and Requirements

The wedding celebration intended for remote attendance belongs to the applicant's biological brother. The ceremony is scheduled to take place within the West Champaran district located in the state of Bihar.

To make the virtual link operational, the presiding judge mandated that the applicant supply a working email identification. This technical requirement ensures that prison administrators can successfully establish the remote connection for the scheduled dates.

Background of the 2024 Galaxy Apartment Incident

The legal proceedings stem from a shocking early morning attack that occurred on April 14, 2024. Gunfire was discharged right outside the Galaxy Apartment residence where Bollywood star Salman Khan lives in Mumbai.

Investigative authorities identified Vickykumar Gupta alongside co-accused Sagar Pal as the individuals who executed the shooting. Both men, alongside three other co-accused individuals, currently face ongoing criminal prosecution.

Charges Under MCOCA and Penal Code

The ongoing trial involves severe legal charges brought against the group of accused participants. The formal accusations include provisions outlined in the Indian Penal Code concerning criminal conspiracy and attempt to murder.

Furthermore, prosecutors have invoked stringent clauses connected to the Maharashtra Control of Organised Crime Act. These heavy charges reflect the organized nature and seriousness of the security breach at the actor's home.

Broader Security Concerns Across Bollywood

The judicial decision arrives amid a wider wave of security threats targeting major figures within the Hindi film industry. Over preceding months, numerous prominent actors have approached legal authorities regarding extortion demands and intimidation.

Reports indicate that these threatening communications frequently originate from individuals claiming affiliation with the Lawrence Bishnoi gang. Cyber cell units have been actively tracing digital footprints and phone locations tied to these menacing messages.

Recent Incidents and Gang Threats

The security climate in the film fraternity worsened following an October attack involving actor Tiger Shroff. A representative of the Bishnoi syndicate publicly claimed responsibility for that assault through social media channels.

Additionally, actor Ayushmann Khurrana reportedly received a threatening audio message demanding substantial financial sums. Representatives of the syndicate have openly targeted anyone working in close association with Salman Khan.

A special court denied temporary physical bail to Vickykumar Gupta, an accused shooter in the 2024 Salman Khan residence firing case, for his brother's wedding in Bihar. Instead, the court permitted him to attend the ceremony virtually through supervised video conferencing from jail.

The case forms part of ongoing MCOCA proceedings against multiple accused individuals, coinciding with a broader pattern of recent threats and attacks directed at Bollywood actors by the Lawrence Bishnoi gang.

ld.articleBody:
Introduction to Valentina and the 12 Signs

Netflix is expanding its international catalog with an upcoming Brazilian romantic comedy series titled Valentina and the 12 Signs. Scheduled to launch in late 2026, the project brings an astrological twist to the romantic comedy genre, following a protagonist who decides to date systematically through every sign of the zodiac.

The series adapts the popular literary work Os 12 Signos de Valentina, written by Ray Tavares. Fans of contemporary romantic fiction and streaming television can look forward to seeing how the source material translates to the screen when the show makes its global streaming debut.

Release Date and Platform Details

Streaming giant Netflix has officially confirmed that Valentina and the 12 Signs will premiere globally on November 18, 2026. As a Netflix Original production, the series will be accessible to subscribers worldwide.

Ahead of the premiere, Netflix Brasil has offered early glimpses into the project, including releasing the official trailer on YouTube to build anticipation among international audiences and fans of Brazilian television.

Plot and Premise

The story centers on Valentina, a young woman who suffers a painful betrayal by her romantic partner. Blaming the failure of the relationship entirely on astrological incompatibility, she maps out a methodical plan for retaliation.

Her mission involves going on dates with one man from each of the twelve zodiac signs while broadcasting her detailed experiences and reviews on a livestream. However, her carefully calculated revenge hits an unexpected snag when she falls deeply in love with a man who possesses no astrological sign at all.

Cast and Character Highlights

Giovanna Grigio takes on the lead role of Valentina. The actress is well-known to streaming audiences for her previous work in Netflix's popular teen-Mexican drama series Rebelde, where she portrayed the character Emília Alo.

Grigio's television credits also include Young Hearts, As Five, Por Você, and The Good Side of Life, establishing her as a prominent young talent in television drama and comedy.

Expanded Ensemble Cast

Alongside Grigio, Valentina and the 12 Signs features a diverse supporting cast of notable Brazilian actors. The ensemble includes Jessica Marques, known for Insubmissas, and Manu Morelli from The Endless Night.

Rounding out the main cast are Larissa Bocchino from Criminal Code, Lucas Leto from An Unforgettable Year: Autumn, Pedro Ottoni from Toda Família Tem, Suzana Pires from Casa Grande, Ana Hikari from Body by Beth, and José Condessa from Turn of the Tide.

Production Team and Episode Count

Behind the scenes, the series is brought to life by a talented creative team. Author Ray Tavares co-wrote the script alongside Bia Crespo, ensuring the adaptation stays true to the spirit of the original novel.

The project is directed by Carol Durão and produced by Tiago Mello under the banner of Boutique Filmes. Viewers tuning into the first season can expect a total run of eight episodes.

News Overview

Netflix has scheduled the premiere of the Brazilian romantic comedy series Valentina and the 12 Signs for November 18, 2026. Starring Giovanna Grigio and based on Ray Tavares's novel, the eight-episode show follows a livestreaming protagonist who dates across all zodiac signs before falling for an unsignpped man.

ld.articleBody:
Introduction to the Box Office Run

The theatrical journey of Jailer 2 continues to capture attention as the film pushes further into its third week on the big screen. Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, the movie opened to massive numbers and has maintained a steady presence across multiple regional markets.

Even though daily earnings have dipped from the record-setting figures seen during the opening week, the project continues to accumulate revenue from ticket sales across the country.

First and Second Week Performance

During its opening week in theatres, the Rajinikanth starrer brought in an impressive Rs 334.35 crore net across domestic screens. This strong beginning laid a solid foundation for the subsequent weeks.

As the theatrical run progressed into the second week, the feature added another Rs 95.55 crore net to its tally, bringing the two-week domestic net total to an extraordinary Rs 429.90 crore.

Day 21 Estimates and Current Collections

According to live estimates from Sacnilk, the action entertainer added Rs 52 lakh net in India on Day 21 from a total of 2,195 shows. These numbers reflect the gradual slowdown typical of a film's third week.

The regional breakdown shows the Tamil version leading the day with Rs 32 lakh from 925 shows, followed by the Hindi version generating Rs 11 lakh across 1,041 shows, and the Telugu version collecting Rs 9 lakh from 229 shows.

Overall Earnings and Milestones

With the latest figures included, the overall India net collection for the feature stands at Rs 463.57 crore. Meanwhile, the total domestic gross has reached an estimated Rs 542.26 crore.

The movie is now closing in on the Rs 464 crore net milestone in India, positioning itself as a dominant force among recent releases.

Chasing All-Time Records

Having already crossed multiple major box-office landmarks, the Nelson Dilipkumar directorial is steadily moving toward becoming the highest-grossing Tamil film of all time.

Additionally, records such as Vijay's LEO collection of Rs 223 crore in Tamil Nadu remain within reach as the film pushes through its final major theatrical weeks.

Cast, Crew, and Production Details

The film features Rajinikanth in the lead role as Tiger Muthuvel Pandian. The star-studded cast also includes Mohanlal, Shivarajkumar, Ramya Krishnan, Vidya Balan, SJ Suryah, Mithun Chakraborty, Jackie Shroff, and Yogi Babu among others.

Music for the action entertainer is composed by Anirudh Ravichander, while the project is backed by production powerhouse Sun Pictures.

Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 continues its box office run in its third week, reaching a total domestic net collection of Rs 463.57 crore. The film is currently closing in on all-time records for a Tamil film as it nears the Rs 464 crore net milestone in India.

ld.articleBody:
The Return of Cormoran Strike

Fans of gritty crime dramas have reason to celebrate as the BBC officially announces the return of its hit television series Strike. The upcoming seventh season has been scheduled for a December 2026 release window, bringing back the beloved investigative partnership that has captured audiences for years. Unlike the fantastical wizarding worlds that cemented the creator's global fame, this television adaptation offers a grounded, gritty exploration of modern detective work.

The upcoming installment promises to maintain the high stakes and complex mysteries that fans have come to expect. Viewers will once again be plunged into the shadowy underworld of crime and deception alongside television's most resilient private investigator.

Familiar Faces and Core Cast

Tom Burke will reprise his role as the hardened, grizzled private detective Cormoran Strike, bringing his trademark rugged determination back to the screen. Alongside him, Holliday Grainger returns to portray Robin Ellacott, the brilliant and capable partner whose sharp instincts match the titular detective's own.

The dynamic between Burke and Grainger remains the beating heart of the adaptation. Their on-screen chemistry and professional evolution have driven the narrative forward across previous seasons, earning critical praise and a dedicated following.

Adapting The Running Grave

The seventh outing will adapt The Running Grave, serving as a five-part mystery spanning the length of the new television block. This narrative takes the detectives into dark, psychological territory as they tackle one of their most dangerous cases yet.

The storyline kicks off when Sir Colin and Sally Edensor approach the private investigators out of sheer desperation. They enlist Cormoran Strike and Robin Ellacott to help reconnect with their estranged son, Will, who has fallen under the sway of a dangerous group.

Infiltrating a Controversial Cult

At the center of the new season's mystery is the Universal Humanitarian Church, a secretive religious cult that has successfully indoctrinated the young Will Edensor. The parents discover that the organization has also systematically siphoned off their son's trust fund.

The detectives must gather concrete evidence to discredit the church and rescue Will from its grip. This investigation promises high tension, moral dilemmas, and intense confrontations as the duo goes up against a powerful, manipulative organization.

The Robert Galbraith Pseudonym

The source material for the television series is part of a bestselling crime fiction collection published under the pseudonym Robert Galbraith. The author originally adopted the pen name to establish a fresh writing career completely free from the impossibly high expectations and intense spotlight of her previous colossal literary success.

Media investigations swiftly uncovered the true identity of the author just months after the publication of the very first novel, The Cuckoo's Calling. Despite the secret coming to light early on, the pseudonym has remained attached to the publication of the crime series ever since.

Franchise Growth and Legacy

The exposure of the author's identity did nothing to stall the momentum of the crime novels, which have blossomed into a massive multimedia success story. To date, eight distinct novels have been published in the collection, with a ninth book currently actively in development.

The television adaptation has mirrored this literary triumph, steadily pulling in viewers and building a robust legacy across multiple seasons. With the seventh season arriving in December 2026, the franchise continues to cement its place as a cornerstone of contemporary British television drama.

News Overview

The BBC has officially confirmed that the television series Strike will return for its seventh season, titled Strike: The Running Grave, in December 2026. BBC Confirms Release Window for Strike Season 7

The acclaimed detective series based on J.K. Rowling's novels will return for its seventh season in December 2026.

Published 4 November 2026

The Return of Cormoran Strike

Fans of gritty crime dramas have reason to celebrate as the BBC officially announces the return of its hit television series Strike. The upcoming seventh season has been scheduled for a December 2026 release window, bringing back the beloved investigative partnership that has captured audiences for years. Unlike the fantastical wizarding worlds that cemented the creator's global fame, this television adaptation offers a grounded, gritty exploration of modern detective work.

The upcoming installment promises to maintain the high stakes and complex mysteries that fans have come to expect. Viewers will once again be plunged into the shadowy underworld of crime and deception alongside television's most resilient private investigator.

Familiar Faces and Core Cast

Tom Burke will reprise his role as the hardened, grizzled private detective Cormoran Strike, bringing his trademark rugged determination back to the screen. Alongside him, Holliday Grainger returns to portray Robin Ellacott, the brilliant and capable partner whose sharp instincts match the titular detective's own.

The dynamic between Burke and Grainger remains the beating heart of the adaptation. Their on-screen chemistry and professional evolution have driven the narrative forward across previous seasons, earning critical praise and a dedicated following.

Adapting The Running Grave

The seventh outing will adapt The Running Grave, serving as a five-part mystery spanning the length of the new television block. This narrative takes the detectives into dark, psychological territory as they tackle one of their most dangerous cases yet.

The storyline kicks off when Sir Colin and Sally Edensor approach the private investigators out of sheer desperation. They enlist Cormoran Strike and Robin Ellacott to help reconnect with their estranged son, Will, who has fallen under the sway of a dangerous group.

Infiltrating a Controversial Cult

At the center of the new season's mystery is the Universal Humanitarian Church, a secretive religious cult that has successfully indoctrinated the young Will Edensor. The parents discover that the organization has also systematically siphoned off their son's trust fund.

The detectives must gather concrete evidence to discredit the church and rescue Will from its grip. This investigation promises high tension, moral dilemmas, and intense confrontations as the duo goes up against a powerful, manipulative organization.

The Robert Galbraith Pseudonym

The source material for the television series is part of a bestselling crime fiction collection published under the pseudonym Robert Galbraith. The author originally adopted the pen name to establish a fresh writing career completely free from the impossibly high expectations and intense spotlight of her previous colossal literary success.

Media investigations swiftly uncovered the true identity of the author just months after the publication of the very first novel, The Cuckoo's Calling. Despite the secret coming to light early on, the pseudonym has remained attached to the publication of the crime series ever since.

Franchise Growth and Legacy

The exposure of the author's identity did nothing to stall the momentum of the crime novels, which have blossomed into a massive multimedia success story. To date, eight distinct novels have been published in the collection, with a ninth book currently actively in development.

The television adaptation has mirrored this literary triumph, steadily pulling in viewers and building a robust legacy across multiple seasons. With the seventh season arriving in December 2026, the franchise continues to cement its place as a cornerstone of contemporary British television drama.

News Overview

The BBC has officially confirmed that the television series Strike will return for its seventh season, titled Strike: The Running Grave, in December 2026. The upcoming five-part mystery adapts the seventh novel in the bestselling crime series, starring Tom Burke and Holliday Grainger as private investigators hired to rescue a young man from a religious cult.

Key facts

  • Strike will return for its seventh series titled Strike: The Running Grave in December 2026.
  • The new season will be a five-part mystery.
  • Tom Burke stars as Cormoran Strike and Holliday Grainger stars as Robin Ellacott.
  • Sir Colin and Sally Edensor hire the detectives to rescue their estranged son Will from the Universal Humanitarian Church.
  • The novels are written under the pseudonym Robert Galbraith, which started with The Cuckoo's Calling.
  • There are eight novels published to date with a ninth in development.

Introduction To The Episode Premiere

Followers of South Korean television are eagerly anticipating the next installment of the hit romantic series. Episode 6 is scheduled to premiere today, bringing fresh developments to the unfolding romance.

With character dynamics continuously shifting, audiences are looking forward to the new twists and turns introduced in this latest chapter.

Plot And Storyline Overview

The overarching narrative combines elements of a gripping murder investigation, covert operations, and unexpected romantic entanglements. It is adapted from the Kakao web novel Why You Don't Know It's a Girl? written by Lee A-yeon and Ryu Do-ha.

The plot centers around a corporate heir whose life is upended by a mysterious fatality among his staff, drawing the attention of law enforcement and setting the stage for a high-stakes cat-and-mouse dynamic.

Starring Cast And Character Dynamics

The show features Yim Si-wan in the role of Yoon Yi-jun, a meticulous executive and the perfectionist heir to Taegang Group. His world shifts dramatically when his personal secretary dies under suspicious circumstances.

Seol In-ah stars alongside him as Kang Jae-hee, a dedicated detective assigned to the case. Seeking an inside track, she assumes a false identity as a male executive secretary and bodyguard to keep close tabs on Yi-jun.

Undercover Complications And Workplace Tension

Jae-hee's undercover assignment requires her to navigate tricky workplace environments while concealing her true profession from the corporate heir. Managing daily office duties alongside her investigation creates numerous awkward and high-pressure moments.

As the two spend more time together, their professional boundaries blur, complicating her mission and heightening the emotional stakes of the unfolding mystery.

Release Schedule And Total Episode Count

The series follows a consistent release pattern, airing new installments every Monday and Tuesday. The entire season consists of 12 episodes, leading up to a dramatic conclusion later in the month.

The grand finale for the romantic drama is officially scheduled to premiere on November 24, keeping fans hooked on a tight bi-weekly broadcast schedule.

Streaming Platform And Timing In India

In South Korea, the episode broadcasts on tvN at 8:50 PM KST. International fans can tune in concurrently through major digital platforms.

Indian viewers can stream the latest episode on Amazon Prime Video starting at 5:20 PM IST on the same day, ensuring minimal delay for local audiences.

News Overview

Episode 6 of the Korean drama Love In Disguise releases today, continuing the story of an undercover detective and a corporate heir. Indian fans can catch the episode on Amazon Prime Video starting at 5:20 PM IST.
