ld.articleBody:
Henry Cavill Expands Into Game Development

Renowned actor Henry Cavill is adding game developer to his extensive list of creative talents through a brand new project. Known for his prominent roles in film and television, the star is now channeling his lifelong passion for gaming into building his own interactive title.

The upcoming project arrives as an unexpected yet fitting endeavor for an actor who is famously passionate about building personal computers and painting gaming miniatures.

The Concept Behind Mustache Protocol

Titled Mustache Protocol, the new creation is a colorful 2D retro side-scroller featuring the actor and a prominent facial hair motif. The humorous premise pokes fun at the controversial digital removal of his facial hair during past studio reshoots.

Gameplay centers around playful action mechanics, including wielding a trusty mustache comb imbued with lightning powers to defeat bald adversaries equipped with scissors for hands.

Collaboration with Google and AI Tools

The development process relies on a partnership with Google, utilizing a Googlebook device alongside an integrated suite of artificial intelligence tools. A brief demonstration video shared on YouTube highlights how easily the software allows users to build functional retro titles.

Despite ongoing industry debates regarding the integration of artificial intelligence in software creation, this specific initiative utilizes the technology for a charitable drive.

Supporting Movember Charities

The primary goal of Mustache Protocol is to raise funds and awareness for men's health causes throughout the month of November. Google has committed to donating eleven dollars for every individual playthrough of the 16-bit game.

Charitable beneficiaries include organizations focused on critical areas such as mental health support, suicide prevention initiatives, and ongoing cancer research efforts.

Fundraising Caps and Canine Cameos

Financial contributions generated through gameplay are capped at a substantial total of five hundred thousand dollars. This structure enables players to support meaningful causes simply by engaging with the digital arcade experience.

In addition to the main character, the title features appearances from the actor's two pet dogs, Cal and Baggins, who appear as muscle-bound anthropomorphic high-fiving brothers.

Part of a Three-Part Video Series

The announcement forms the first installment of a planned three-part short video series. Additional details and gameplay mechanics are expected to emerge as the subsequent episodes premiere online.

No specific release date has been confirmed other than a general launch window scheduled for the current month, giving supporters plenty of time to participate in the charitable campaign.

News Overview

Actor Henry Cavill is releasing a retro 2-bit side-scroller video game titled Mustache Protocol created with Google and AI tools. For every play of the game this month, Google will donate eleven dollars to men's health charities up to a cap of five hundred thousand dollars.

ld.articleBody:
Expanding International Festival Qualifiers

The Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences is actively looking to increase the number of film festivals that can operate as standalone qualifiers for the International Film Oscar category. Speaking during an interview at the Tokyo Film Festival, AMPAS Chief Executive Officer Bill Kramer confirmed that the organization intends to broaden this feeder network.

Under rules introduced in May, top awards from Berlin, Busan, Cannes, Sundance, Toronto, and Venice already allow winning films to be automatically submitted for the category alongside traditional country-selected entries.

Ensuring Global Representation and Juried Standards

According to Kramer, the initial group of six festivals was chosen specifically because they feature juried awards, a criterion that is not universal across all global events. The initiative forms a core part of the Academy's wider strategy to handle the international category in a more holistic way.

The leadership remains in constant communication with festivals worldwide to secure proper geographic representation and invite a larger volume of global cinema into the competitive conversation.

Broadening Apertures for Filmmakers

This push toward inclusivity follows earlier rule changes designed to tear down traditional submission barriers. A notable prior step allowed refugee filmmakers displaced from their home countries to have their movies put forward by a host-country committee.

Kramer emphasized that these cumulative reforms are meant to create a broader aperture for participation, ensuring that talented creators from diverse backgrounds have clear avenues to submit their work.

A Globally Minded Academy Membership

The organizational shifts coincide with a measurable transformation within the Academy itself, where 25 percent of the total membership now resides outside the United States. Kramer attributes this trend to profound global shifts in how films are both produced and consumed.

He noted that traditional boundaries separating domestic and international cinema, classic titles from first-run releases, and live-action from animation or documentaries have blurred significantly, partly accelerated by viewing habits adopted during the pandemic.

Transitioning the Oscars to YouTube

This increasingly global audience served as a primary rationale for selecting YouTube as the future broadcast home of the Academy Awards. Starting in 2029, the Google-owned service will take over hosting duties from ABC, which has broadcast the ceremony since 1976.

The agreement covers the 101st Oscars through 2033. Kramer highlighted that the platform enables simultaneous global reach to 2.5 billion people across more than 30 languages while offering enhanced control over fan engagement.

Protecting Artistic Freedom on Streaming Platforms

As major tech companies and streaming entities take over live entertainment broadcasts—such as Netflix handling The Actor Awards and Prime Video taking on the Emmys—questions regarding editorial oversight naturally arise. However, Kramer firmly stated that strict policies protect the Academy's output.

When questioned about potential interference reminiscent of past tech-industry missteps, Kramer stressed that censorship is strictly prohibited at the Academy, the Oscars, and on its broadcast platform, adding that Google and YouTube fully understand this stance.

News Overview

AMPAS CEO Bill Kramer announced at the Tokyo Film Festival that the Academy plans to increase the number of film festivals serving as standalone qualifiers for the International Film Oscar category. Alongside these structural changes, Kramer discussed the organization's expanding international membership and defended the upcoming broadcast transition to YouTube starting in 2029.

According to Kramer, the initial group of six festivals was chosen specifically because they feature juried awards, a criterion that is not universal across all global events. The initiative forms a core part of the Academy's wider strategy to handle the international category in a more holistic way.

The leadership remains in constant communication with festivals worldwide to secure proper geographic representation and invite a larger volume of global cinema into the competitive conversation.

Broadening Apertures for Filmmakers

This push toward inclusivity follows earlier rule changes designed to tear down traditional submission barriers. A notable prior step allowed refugee filmmakers displaced from their home countries to have their movies put forward by a host-country committee.

Kramer emphasized that these cumulative reforms are meant to create a broader aperture for participation, ensuring that talented creators from diverse backgrounds have clear avenues to submit their work.

A Globally Minded Academy Membership

The organizational shifts coincide with a measurable transformation within the Academy itself, where 25 percent of the total membership now resides outside the United States. Kramer attributes this trend to profound global shifts in how films are both produced and consumed.

He noted that traditional boundaries separating domestic and international cinema, classic titles from first-run releases, and live-action from animation or documentaries have blurred significantly, partly accelerated by viewing habits adopted during the pandemic.

Transitioning the Oscars to YouTube

This increasingly global audience served as a primary rationale for selecting YouTube as the future broadcast home of the Academy Awards. Starting in 2029, the Google-owned service will take over hosting duties from ABC, which has broadcast the ceremony since 1976.

The agreement covers the 101st Oscars through 2033. Kramer highlighted that the platform enables simultaneous global reach to 2.5 billion people across more than 30 languages while offering enhanced control over fan engagement.

Protecting Artistic Freedom on Streaming Platforms

As major tech companies and streaming entities take over live entertainment broadcasts—such as Netflix handling The Actor Awards and Prime Video taking on the Emmys—questions regarding editorial oversight naturally arise. However, Kramer firmly stated that strict policies protect the Academy's output.

When questioned about potential interference reminiscent of past tech-industry missteps, Kramer stressed that censorship is strictly prohibited at the Academy, the Oscars, and on its broadcast platform, adding that Google and YouTube fully understand this stance.

AMPAS CEO Bill Kramer announced at the Tokyo Film Festival that the Academy plans to increase the number of film festivals serving as standalone qualifiers for the International Film Oscar category. Alongside these structural changes, Kramer discussed the organization's expanding international membership and defended the upcoming broadcast transition to YouTube starting in 2029.

  • Lynette Howell Taylor is the AMPAS President.
  • Meredith Shea is the Chief Membership, Impact and Industry Officer.

news:pl7dxc.k: Jailer 2 box office collection, Rajinikanth Jailer 2 Day 20, Jailer 2 vs The GOAT record, Jailer 2 worldwide collection Rs 816 crore, Rajinikanth Jailer 2, Jailer 2, Rajinikanth, Nelson Dilipkumar Jailer 2, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
The Box Office Journey So Far

Jailer 2 has established itself as a massive theatrical triumph, pulling in crowds and rewriting box office benchmarks. The action entertainer directed by Nelson Dilipkumar has achieved a remarkable worldwide gross collection standing at Rs 816.90 crore.

As the feature approaches its next major milestones, it continues to draw steady footfalls across multiple regions, cementing its status as one of the most successful commercial releases of the period.

Day 20 Earnings and Domestic Standing

On its twentieth day in theaters, the Rajinikanth starrer brought in Rs 3.35 crore in India net collections. This latest single-day addition pushes the domestic net total to an impressive Rs 463.05 crore, while the overall India gross currently sits at Rs 541.65 crore.

International markets have further bolstered the earnings, contributing Rs 1 crore on Tuesday alone and raising international gross collections to a notable Rs 275.25 crore.

Chasing The GOAT Record in Tamil Nadu

In the home state of Tamil Nadu, the movie has grossed Rs 210.45 crore across its first 18 days of exhibition. The action drama now requires another Rs 6.80 crore to surpass Thalapathy Vijay's The Greatest Of All Time record.

Surpassing this state benchmark would add another stellar achievement to the film's theatrical run, bringing it neck and neck with previous regional history-makers.

Milestones and Regional Language Success

By crossing the Rs 800 crore threshold globally, Jailer 2 has officially become the first Tamil film to achieve this monumental financial feat. Furthermore, its Kannada-dubbed version has outperformed the collection records set by Allu Arjun's Pushpa 2: The Rule.

The Tamil version remained the primary revenue driver on Day 20, bringing in Rs 1.93 crore from 3,624 shows, followed by contributions from the Hindi, Telugu, and Kannada iterations.

Weekdays and Weekend Trends

The daily collections experienced a minor 1.5 percent decline on Day 20 compared to the Rs 3.40 crore netted on Monday. However, the feature recently enjoyed a strong third weekend that pulled in Rs 30.70 crore in India gross.

During that weekend surge, daily gross earnings climbed from Rs 6.40 crore on Friday to Rs 11.30 crore on Saturday and peaked at Rs 13 crore on Sunday.

Production Background and Cast

Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar and produced by Kalanithi Maran under Sun Pictures, Jailer 2 serves as the direct sequel to the 2023 hit Jailer.

Superstar Rajinikanth leads the project, reprising his iconic role as the retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian in this high-octane action follow-up.

News Overview

Rajinikanth's action entertainer Jailer 2 has reached a worldwide collection of Rs 816.90 crore, becoming the first Tamil film to cross the Rs 800 crore mark. The movie is currently closing in on Thalapathy Vijay's The Greatest Of All Time record in Tamil Nadu.

news:pn3khr.d: Following his removal from Ed Sheeran's tour, Macklemore has initiated his own benefit concert series in Dublin alongside supporting artists and activists.
news:pn3khr.k: Macklemore Free Palestine Tour, Macklemore Dublin concert 3Arena, Macklemore tour after Ed Sheeran, Macklemore, Ed Sheeran, Macklemore Loop Tour, Loop Tour, Ed Sheeran Loop Tour, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
The Kickoff in Dublin

Macklemore officially launched his benefit concert series on Monday night at the 3Arena in Dublin. The event marked the beginning of his self-organized tour following his sudden departure from another major concert lineup.

Organizers kept the performance lineup secret prior to the event, building anticipation for the sold-out opening night of the three-city concert series.

Star-Studded Benefit Lineup

The Dublin concert featured a diverse group of musicians and performers who joined Macklemore on stage. Among them were Hozier, Kneecap, Palestinian-American DJ and producer DJ Habibeats, Palestinian singer-songwriter Lina Makoul, and M1 of Dead Prez.

Crucially, Boega—the backing band that previously withdrew from Ed Sheeran's tour in solidarity with Macklemore—also performed at the sold-out event.

Special Guest Speakers and Humanitarian Focus

In addition to musical performances, the evening featured appearances by prominent activists and speakers. Irish actor Liam Cunningham, psychotherapist and activist Nadia Greenspan, and organizer Samir Eskanda addressed the audience.

Cunningham emphasized onstage that enjoying the night did not mean ignoring the hardships in Gaza, but rather honoring the life and humanity that Palestinians strive to protect.

Supporting Palestinian Relief Organizations

All financial proceeds collected from the concert series are directed toward organizations aiding the Palestinian movement. These funds target essential medical provisions, food supplies, and humanitarian assistance.

A published press release highlighted that the funds also support education, community advocacy, and policy changes globally, focusing heavily on families and communities impacted by the conflict in Gaza.

Background on the Ed Sheeran Tour Controversy

The tour stems from an earlier controversy when Macklemore was removed from Ed Sheeran's tour. Messina Touring Group, Sheeran's promoter, stated that several venues threatened to cancel shows if Macklemore remained on the bill due to his pro-Palestine remarks.

Sheeran later addressed the situation publicly, explaining that while he avoids being an activist musician, the ordeal highlighted complex arguments regarding freedom of speech and venue pre-approval.

Macklemore's Perspective on Artist Activism

When announcing his new tour via social media, Macklemore reflected on a broader shift in expectations for musicians. He asserted that remaining apolitical during a humanitarian crisis is no longer acceptable.

He encouraged fellow artists to educate themselves, engage with communities, and utilize their platforms to push back against attempts at censorship.

Remaining Tour Dates

The three-date concert run continues immediately following the Dublin opening. The artist is scheduled to perform at the Accor Arena in Paris.

The final stop of the current announced series will take place at the OVO Arena Wembley in London.

News Overview

Macklemore launched his Free Palestine Tour in Dublin after being dropped from Ed Sheeran's tour over his political statements. The sold-out benefit concert featured various artists, including Sheeran's former backing band, with all proceeds supporting humanitarian causes in Gaza.

news:po27ib.d: Global star Priyanka Chopra Jonas has boarded the Oscar-qualified Indian short film We Were Here in an executive producer role ahead of its Academy Awards…
news:po27ib.k: Priyanka Chopra Jonas We Were Here, We Were Here short film, Pranav Bhasin We Were Here, We Were Here Oscar qualified, We Were Here, Priyanka Chopra Jonas, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
Priyanka Chopra Jonas Joins the Project

Actor and producer Priyanka Chopra Jonas has officially associated herself with the Indian short film We Were Here, coming on board as an executive producer. Her involvement arrives as the project prepares for its upcoming Academy Awards campaign.

The acclaimed short film has gathered significant international momentum, and Chopra Jonas's attachment is expected to further elevate its visibility during the competitive awards season.

Star-Studded Executive Producer Roster

Alongside Priyanka Chopra Jonas, the film has also welcomed actor Andrew Scott and Tony Award-winning playwright and activist V as executive producers.

The addition of these prominent international figures strengthens the creative backing for the project as it pursues further acclaim and recognition globally.

Premise and Plot of We Were Here

The story centres on three retired men residing in a small Indian town who grow convinced that machines are systematically replacing human jobs. In response, they stage an unusual protest by impersonating household appliances.

Their eccentric form of resistance takes a surprising turn when the child of one of the men secures employment at an artificial intelligence company, deepening the domestic conflict.

Themes Explored by Director Pranav Bhasin

Written and directed by Pranav Bhasin, the comedy delves into contemporary themes such as technology, employment worries, and the underlying fear of human obsolescence.

Through the everyday lives of ordinary characters, the film crafts a witty and timely narrative about the rapid integration of automation in modern society.

Festival Run and Academy Award Qualification

We Were Here has completed an extensive festival circuit, screening at more than 80 international events and collecting over 20 awards along the way.

Notably, its victory at the Palm Springs International ShortFest—where it won Best Live-Action Short Film Under 15 Minutes and Best Comedy Short—secured its official eligibility for Academy Award consideration.

Global Recognition and Premiere Plans

The project initially held its world premiere at the Clermont-Ferrand International Short Film Festival, where it picked up the Canal Prize. It also earned accolades such as the Audience Award for Best Narrative Short at South by Southwest.

In terms of distribution, The New Yorker has acquired the short film and plans to host its premiere on the publication's official YouTube channels.

Director and Production Team Reactions

Director Pranav Bhasin described the backing of high-profile artists like Chopra Jonas, Scott, and V as a surreal development during the awards season.

The film itself is produced by Yash Gonsai, Dheer Momaya, and Dar Gai, with SPLF Media and Aarti Lohia serving as presenters.

News Overview

Priyanka Chopra Jonas has joined the Oscar-qualified Indian short film We Were Here as an executive producer alongside Andrew Scott and V. Directed by Pranav Bhasin, the comedy follows retired men protesting automation and has secured Academy Award eligibility through its festival wins.

About Dar-E-Nijaat

Some stories begin with love. Some are tested by loss. And some are remembered for the courage it takes to forgive.

Episode Summary

Is episode mein Malik sahab Abubakar ko apne ghar bulate hain aur unka bohot warm welcome karte hain. Abubakar jab Malik sahab ke ghar aata hai toh wahan ek purani tasveer dekh kar unke baray mein poochtay hain jo Malik sahab ke walid ki hoti hai. Malik sahab apni family ke baray mein batatay hain ki woh teen bhai hain aur koi behan nahi hai. Idhar Hamna khushbakht anty ko phone kar ke apni shadi ki khushkhabri sunati hai aur unse dua ki darkhwast karti hai. Woh yeh bhi poochti hai ki kya Abubakar ko is baray mein pata hai ya nahi, aur anty use kehti hain ke woh Abubakar ke liye bhi dua karein gi. Baad mein, khushbakht anty Hamna ke paas aati hain aur unhe samjhaane ki koshish karti hain ke Abubakar jaise achay insaan ko khona ya us par shaq karna galat hai. Woh kehti hain ke Abubakar aisi kisi baat ka qabil nahi hai aur Hamna ko chahiye ke woh apne naseeb aur Abubakar par bharosa rakhe. Idhar dinner table par Malik sahab Abubakar ko apni business family aur unke father ki death ke baray mein batatay hain aur kehte hain ke woh Abubakar ko ek CEO ke taur par dekhna chahte hain aur ek aisa offer dete hain jise woh inkar nahi kar sakta. Episode ke aakhir mein Abubakar aur Hamna ke darmiyan kuch moments dikhaye jatay hain jahan woh usay ek earring pehnhata hai aur kahani ek jazbati aur gehray mod par aakar khatam hoti hai.

The Return of Cliff Booth

Brad Pitt has officially stepped back into the shoes of the character that earned him an Academy Award. Netflix has unveiled a brand new trailer for the upcoming feature, generating massive excitement among fans of the original cinematic universe.

The actor, currently age 62, is reprising his famous role for this exciting continuation, showing that the iconic persona is ready for a brand new chapter.

Creative Team and Background

This new cinematic endeavor is directed by David Fincher and serves as a direct follow-up to Quentin Tarantino's acclaimed film Once Upon a Time in Hollywood. While Tarantino originally created and directed the character, he wrote the screenplay for this new installment.

Back in 2020, Brad Pitt secured the Best Supporting Actor Academy Award for his unforgettable work in the original movie, setting high expectations for this continuation.

Plot and Setting

The narrative shifts the timeline forward and transports audiences to a completely different era of the entertainment industry.

An official synopsis describes the setting: Brad Pitt returns to his Academy Award-winning role as Cliff Booth, only this time it is 1977 and it is a very different Hollywood.

Star-Studded Ensemble Cast

Alongside the Hollywood superstar, the project boasts a large and talented supporting cast featuring numerous recognizable names.

The film stars Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan, Carla Gugino, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II, Peter Weller, Matt Groove, JB Tadena, Corey Fogelmanis, and Karren Karagulian.

Theatrical and Streaming Release Schedule

Audiences will have multiple ways to experience the movie, starting with a special theatrical run before it arrives on home screens.

The film is scheduled to debut for a two-week exclusive engagement in IMAX theaters globally on November 25, followed by its streaming release on Netflix on December 23.

News Overview

Netflix has released a new trailer for The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth starring Brad Pitt in his Oscar-winning role. Directed by David Fincher and written by Quentin Tarantino, the movie arrives in IMAX on November 25 before hitting Netflix on December 23.

ld.articleBody:
Latest Arrest Expands Custody Count

The ongoing investigation surrounding the high-profile firing incident linked to Bollywood personality Tiger Shroff has taken another significant turn. The Mumbai Crime Branch successfully apprehended a 22-year-old female suspect hailing from Karnal district in Haryana, marking a fresh development in the case.

With this latest apprehension, the total count of individuals taken into custody by law enforcement has climbed to 13. Authorities continue to trace all leads and individuals connected to the criminal conspiracy behind the attack.

Identification of the New Suspect

According to reports from the Free Press Journal, the newly detained individual has been formally identified as Subeha Pandit. Her arrest marks a notable progression in the inquiry as she becomes the third female suspect implicated in the ongoing probe.

Investigators noted that Subeha Pandit joins previously detained women Radha and Babita. While Radha and Babita were earlier taken into custody over allegations of supplying weapons for the operation, the exact role attributed to Pandit forms a key part of the ongoing police investigation.

Ties to Organized Criminal Networks

Law enforcement intelligence revealed that the newly arrested woman has direct links to an organized criminal syndicate. Her alleged involvement in the syndicate's unlawful operations drew the focused attention of the authorities leading the investigation.

Acting on these specific findings, a dedicated team from the Mumbai Crime Branch coordinated closely with local law enforcement in Haryana. This joint effort culminated in the detention and formal arrest of the suspect from Karnal on November 1.

Chronology of the Juhu Firing Incident

The security scare unfolded on the evening of October 18, 2026, creating immediate panic in the neighborhood. Unidentified assailants arrived on a two-wheeler at the upscale Juhu locality and discharged firearms, creating widespread shock and prompting a rapid response from local police forces.

Following the incident, a formal case was registered at the Juhu Police Station. Given the gravity of the situation and potential organized crime angles, the Mumbai Crime Branch subsequently stepped in to take over the primary investigation.

Wider Sweep and Prior Arrests

Before the recent apprehension in Haryana, investigators had already conducted a sweeping operation across multiple regions. The Crime Branch previously tracked down and arrested 12 other suspects spread across Kota in Rajasthan, Delhi, and Sonipat in Haryana.

The expanding geographical footprint of the arrests highlights the multi-state nature of the criminal conspiracy. Law enforcement agencies across different states have been sharing intelligence to dismantle the network piece by piece.

Invocation of MCOCA Provisions

As the gravity of the conspiracy became increasingly evident, investigators escalated the legal framework surrounding the case. On October 27, 2026, authorities officially invoked stringent provisions under the Maharashtra Control of Organised Crime Act, 1999.

Specifically, Sections 3(1)(ii), 3(2), and 3(4) of MCOCA were applied to the case. This legal step underscores the organized crime dimension that law enforcement is tackling in connection with the security threat.

The Mumbai Crime Branch arrested a 22-year-old woman named Subeha Pandit from Karnal on November 1, bringing the total number of accused in the Tiger Shroff firing case to 13. The investigation follows a shooting incident in Juhu on October 18, leading to multi-state arrests and the invocation of MCOCA provisions on October 27.

ld.articleBody:
The Iconic Ritz Tower Residence

The former Manhattan home of renowned music executive and Grammy-winning producer Clive Davis has officially entered the real estate market with an asking price of $11 million. This listing arrives several months following his death in June 2026, offering potential buyers a rare opportunity to acquire a piece of music history located inside the historic Ritz Tower in Midtown East, New York City.

The property served as Davis's private sanctuary for over four decades, having been tied to the legendary producer since 1985. Nestled within one of New York's most established residential buildings, the residence reflects a vital chapter in the life of a man who heavily shaped the American music landscape.

Spanning Four Decades of History

Davis's journey at the Ritz Tower commenced in 1985 when he initially purchased apartments situated on the upper floors of the building. These individual residences were later combined to construct a massive duplex spanning the 36th and 37th floors of the Midtown East structure.

Encompassing roughly 4,500 square feet, the sprawling home was specifically configured to support both daily living and large-scale social gatherings. Its generous layout and scenic vantage points across the Manhattan skyline made it an essential backdrop for Davis's personal and professional life.

Inside The $11 Million Duplex

Among the most striking attributes of the residence is its grand living room, which proudly houses a Steinway grand piano. Given Davis's lifelong dedication to the music industry, the instrument naturally mirrored the creative atmosphere where he spent much of his time.

The layout also features two kitchens, including a dedicated catering kitchen designed to simplify the hosting of guests. A formal dining room served as another central hub for family gatherings, with traditional Sunday meals often featuring takeout brought in for the household.

A Gathering Place For Music Legends

Beyond functioning as a private home, the penthouse operated as an important social venue for figures across the entertainment sector. Davis frequently used the expansive space to bring together prominent performers, industry executives, and close friends.

One of the most notable events held at the address was a pre-Grammy party in 1992. The memorable evening famously drew intense attention when iconic singer Whitney Houston made her grand arrival at the gathering.

The Legacy of a Music Icon

Born in Brooklyn, New York, Davis forged an extraordinary legacy as a visionary music executive, producer, and talent scout renowned for identifying and nurturing generational stars. His professional synergy with Whitney Houston remains a towering highlight of his career, particularly his crucial guidance during the development of her legendary recording of I Will Always Love You.

A four-time Grammy Award winner, Davis was also honored by the Recording Academy with the prestigious Grammy Trustees Award in recognition of his profound impact on the music world.

Turning a New Page

With the property now listed at $11 million, the historic Ritz Tower duplex is prepared to welcome a new occupant. However, real estate observers note that the residence carries a cultural value that far surpasses its multi-million dollar price tag.

The sale marks the end of an era for a space that witnessed decades of musical greatness, high-profile celebrations, and the quiet domestic life of one of the industry's most influential architects.

ld.articleBody:
Reaching the ₹400 Crore Domestic Milestone

Rajinikanth's latest cinematic outing has officially crossed a major domestic financial milestone. Tracking data indicates that the film accumulated an estimated ₹9.45 crore net across the country on its twelfth day, pushing its overall domestic net collections past the ₹400 crore threshold to reach a cumulative total of ₹408.15 crore.

This latest single-day addition reflects the ongoing audience engagement with the project during its second week in cinemas, cementing its status as a major commercial success across domestic territories.

Global Gross Revenue Nears ₹734 Crore

Beyond domestic borders, the film has continued to pull in substantial numbers from international markets. Overseas box office contributions added an estimated ₹2.50 crore gross on Monday, bringing the total overseas gross collection to ₹255.50 crore.

Combined with domestic gross figures, the worldwide gross collection for the action-comedy sequel has now climbed to an impressive ₹733.35 crore, highlighting its wide appeal outside of India.

Analyzing the Weekday Dip Following the Second Weekend

The twelfth-day performance followed a robust second weekend that saw recovery across ticket counters following prior weekday lulls. During that preceding weekend, the feature brought in ₹14.50 crore net on Friday, ₹24.15 crore on Saturday, and ₹25.70 crore net on Sunday.

Monday's earnings of ₹9.45 crore net represented a typical weekday drop of approximately 63.2% compared to the figures recorded on the preceding Sunday, aligning with standard box office trends for second-week runs.

Language-Wise Breakdown of Day 12 Collections

The domestic collections on the twelfth day were distributed across multiple language versions, with the original Tamil version capturing the largest share. The Tamil screenings brought in an estimated ₹5.65 crore net from 4,518 tracked shows, registering a 25.1% occupancy rate.

Meanwhile, the Telugu version contributed ₹2 crore net with 24.2% occupancy, the Hindi version added ₹1.40 crore net with an 11% occupancy rate, and the Kannada version recorded ₹40 lakh net while achieving the highest individual occupancy rate of the day at 32%.

Overall Theatrical Occupancy and Show Counts

The overall engagement across the country on the twelfth day was monitored through a tracked total of 10,450 shows spanning various regions and languages. Across all these participating venues, the overall theatre occupancy rate stood at 19.8%.

While lower than the peak numbers seen during the opening weekend, this sustained participation level across thousands of screens helped keep the daily collections comfortably in the upper single digits.

Cast, Crew, and Production Background

Written and directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, Jailer 2 serves as the continuation of the 2023 hit film Jailer. The project is backed by producer Kalanithi Maran under the Sun Pictures banner, bringing back Rajinikanth to portray the protagonist, retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian.

The film features returning cast members alongside a slew of new additions and high-profile cameo appearances. Anirudh Ravichander provided the musical score, Vijay Kartik Kannan managed the cinematography, and R. Nirmal edited the feature.

News Overview

Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 surpassed ₹408 crore in domestic net collections by its twelfth day in theatres, supported by a strong worldwide gross of ₹733.35 crore. Despite a 63.2% drop on Monday compared to Sunday, the multilingual action comedy continued to draw audiences across its Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, and Kannada versions.

ld.articleBody:
Embracing a New Kind of Role

As the theatrical release of the heist thriller approaches this month, actor and comedian Pete Davidson has opened up regarding the demanding preparation required to portray his character. Known largely for comedic projects, Davidson described this new professional endeavor as a significant departure from his usual onscreen presence, testing both his emotional and physical limits.

The upcoming feature showcases a star-studded ensemble that includes prominent names like Nicholas Hoult and Zoë Kravitz. Within this dynamic cast, Davidson steps into the shoes of Vince, portraying a military veteran who puts his tactical expertise to use as part of a crew of tech-savvy and social-media-driven bank robbers.

Confronting Painful Parallels

Discussing the heavy emotional weight of the project, Davidson recounted a particularly moving experience on set while working alongside a young actress. He confessed that the moment left him genuinely choked up due to profound personal parallels between the narrative arc of his character and his own life experiences involving his father at a similar age.

Reflecting on the psychological intensity of the shoot, the performer admitted that he previously struggled to understand why dramatic actors often described their work as painful. However, experiencing it firsthand made him feel like a genuine dramatic actor for the first time, noting that he was finally stepping outside of his comfort zone rather than simply portraying a version of himself.

A Rigorous Physical Transformation

Beyond the psychological hurdles, the role demanded a major physical overhaul from the comedian. To accurately embody a battle-hardened military veteran, Davidson dedicated himself to a strict regimen that resulted in him gaining 15 pounds of pure muscle.

Achieving this muscular physique required heavy consumption of protein to support his intense training routine. Davidson expressed a desire for complete transparency regarding the lengths actors go to for physical changes, critiquing simplistic explanations often given by performers about their diets and emphasizing the grueling reality behind major body transformations.

Inside the Plot of How to Rob a Bank

The narrative of How to Rob a Bank centers on an unconventional gang of criminals who are motivated by factors far beyond simple financial gain. ld.articleBody:
Resignation Demands Refused

Spain's transport minister has firmly rejected mounting calls for his resignation following a catastrophic rail disaster that claimed dozens of lives. Opposition lawmakers and rail workers' unions have demanded immediate accountability, pointing to a severe failure in oversight after a second major rail accident occurred within a single year.

Instead of stepping down, the minister defended his immediate mandate, emphasizing that his primary focus remains on investigating the root causes of the tragedy rather than political survival.

Tragic Collision Details

The devastating crash occurred near the town of Urda in central Spain, when a moving train slammed directly into a stationary service at speeds reaching up to 200 kilometers per hour. The violent impact resulted in massive structural wreckage and a rapidly climbing death toll that has left the nation in shock.

Emergency services and rescue teams deployed heavy machinery to clear the debris and search for survivors, confronting harrowing scenes as identification efforts were severely hampered by the fragmentation of remains.

Protocol and Control Center Controversy

Investigations quickly zeroed in on actions taken by the central control center in Madrid following an initial automated signalling system failure. Officials revealed that dispatchers authorized a Renfe-operated train to proceed at normal speeds despite the presence of a stationary Iryo-operated train on the same tracks.

Leaked audio recordings indicated that standard safety protocols requiring reduced speeds under such conditions were seemingly bypassed, igniting fierce debates over whether human error or technical failures were fundamentally to blame.

Safety System Upgrades Delayed

Labor representatives and union leaders strongly pushed back against immediate accusations of human error, arguing that systemic infrastructure faults deserved much closer scrutiny. Public documents revealed that the line's safety system upgrade was significantly behind schedule.

Although advanced European rail standards had been widely rolled out across the country, the specific corridor linking Madrid and Seville experienced lingering delays in modernization contracts originally awarded years prior.

Identification Challenges and Casualties

Local authorities and regional spokespersons confirmed that forensic teams were working through dozens of autopsies to formally identify victims amidst a backdrop of lingering uncertainty regarding the final number of missing individuals.

Regional leaders acknowledged that the sheer difficulty of matching partial remains meant officials could not definitively rule out the possibility of discovering additional fatalities as recovery operations continued.

Broader Political Implications

The disaster has severely intensified political tensions across Spain as the country prepares for a tightly contested national election called by Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez. The prime minister publicly condemned the occurrence of two major rail catastrophes in a single year as entirely unacceptable for an advanced transportation network.

Public scrutiny continues to mount as citizens, families of victims, and political opponents demand complete transparency and thorough accountability from transport authorities regarding the structural safety of the nation's high-speed rail network.

Investigations focus on control center protocols and delayed signalling system upgrades as authorities struggle to identify victims amidst growing national scrutiny.

ld.articleBody:
Actor Issues Defiant Video Message

Veteran actor Naseeruddin Shah has released a powerful video statement in which he proudly embraces labels typically assigned to critics by political figures. Declaring himself an intellectual Naxal, the actor directly addressed the administration regarding its approach to student activists across the country.

The footage features Shah speaking out against what he perceives as targeted crackdowns on educational hubs. His remarks focus heavily on the welfare of young scholars and the preservation of academic independence.

Reversing Political Labels

During his address, Shah tackled terms like anti-national and the tukde-tukde gang, which he noted are frequently deployed by self-appointed watchmen against dissenting voices. Instead of accepting these designations, he directed the tukde-tukde label straight back at the government.

He questioned the motives of individuals surrounding the administration, describing them as dishonest and foolish. According to Shah, the actions taken against academic spaces pose a direct risk to the nation's democratic framework.

Highlighting Key Educational Institutions

The actor specifically highlighted three major centers of learning during his commentary: Jawaharlal Nehru University, the Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute, and Jamia Millia Islamia. He noted a recurring pattern of student oppression across these campuses.

His comments on Jamia align with ongoing student demands for a firm timeline regarding student union elections, which have been absent since 2006, alongside approval for the union constitution.

Invocation of Revolutionary Verse

To emphasize his stance on resistance, Shah recited lines from Bismil Azimabadi's classic revolutionary poem, Sarfaroshi Ki Tamanna. The verse speaks directly about the enduring desire for freedom and tests the resolve of those wielding authority.

This poetic inclusion served to underscore his warning that current mistreatment of student demonstrators will remain in the public memory and will not be easily erased.

Criticism of Media and IT Cells

Shah also directed sharp criticism toward partisan digital networks and specific media outlets, using strong phrasing to describe obedient broadcasting entities. He accused them of endlessly spreading falsehoods to defend the ruling party.

Addressing the Bharatiya Janata Party's IT cell directly, he challenged them to deploy all their resources, maintaining that the determination of the country's youth remains unbroken.

History of Student Advocacy

This recent commentary follows a pattern of outspoken support from the actor regarding campus protests. Earlier, he stood with students at SRFTI who engaged in an indefinite sit-in following campus violence.

Additionally, he voiced disapproval in July regarding the administration's handling of NEET 2026 examination irregularities and related protests led by the Cockroach Janata Party.

News Overview

Naseeruddin Shah released a fiery video defending protesting students at Jamia Millia Islamia, JNU, and SRFTI while labeling the government as a tukde-tukde gang and calling himself a dimagi Naxal. He criticized partisan media and the BJP's IT cell, warning that the youth's spirit cannot be broken.

ld.articleBody:
The Controversy Begins

Prominent Bollywood stunt coordinator and body double Geeta Tandon recently brought public attention to an unpleasant experience she faced during a shoot. The industry professional took to social media to voice her grievances regarding how she and her son were treated behind the scenes of a high-profile television production.

The incident centers around the television project hosted by renowned actor Anil Kapoor. Tandon detailed her grievances online, emphasizing that basic human decency should never be compromised regardless of a person's standing within the entertainment business.

Details Of The Long Wait

According to Tandon's public statement, she arrived at the designated shooting location at approximately 12:30 pm. The production team had assured her that her scheduled segment would be recorded after a brief passage of time, but this initial estimate stretched into a nearly all-day ordeal.

She noted that she and her son were confined to a tent for the duration of the delay without receiving any clear updates. Tandon had rearranged her own professional timetable and had even arranged for her son to travel back from Goa specifically to participate in the filming.

Interactions With Production

As the hours ticked by without progress, Tandon attempted to communicate with the crew members to find out when their work would begin. Instead of receiving transparency, she reported being brushed off repeatedly by staff who offered no concrete timeline for the shoot.

The situation escalated when she directly questioned a production manager named Jaydeep about the poor communication and prolonged confinement. According to her account, the response from the production side was dismissive, telling them they could leave only if they signed certain documents first.

Departure And Public Stance

Finding the attitude of the production crew unacceptable, Tandon and her son ultimately decided to walk away from the set at 9:15 pm. They had spent nearly nine hours waiting without receiving the courtesy of timely updates or basic hospitality.

In her social media post, she stressed that she had attended purely by invitation and had not requested any financial favors or special treatment. Her primary demand was simple professional courtesy and human dignity for everyone involved in media productions.

Reactions From Anil Kapoor And Farah Khan

Following the widespread attention generated by Tandon's post, key figures associated with the production stepped forward to address the matter. Host Anil Kapoor responded in the comment section to express sincere regret over the oversight during his show.

Filmmaker Farah Khan, who appeared as a guest on that particular episode, also offered an apology. Khan explained that she had been shooting for a different segment in the evening and would gladly have accommodated Tandon in her vanity van had she been aware of the situation.

News Overview

Stunt director Geeta Tandon publicly criticized the production team of Anil Kapoor's show after enduring a nine-hour wait alongside her son on set. Following her social media post detailing the disrespectful treatment, both host Anil Kapoor and guest Farah Khan issued public apologies.

ld.articleBody:
Addressing the Marriage Whispers

For quite some time, speculative chatter has circulated across the internet suggesting that high-profile couple Suki Waterhouse and Robert Pattinson had quietly exchanged vows. Because the pair are known for maintaining a relatively private personal life, online observers frequently jump to conclusions about their relationship status. However, the Daisy Jones And The Six actress has directly addressed these murmurs, firmly putting an end to talk of any clandestine chapel ceremonies.

The Vision For A Future Celebration

Rather than favoring a hushed or hidden gathering, Waterhouse explained that their philosophy for a future wedding leans heavily toward extravagance. In her own words, she noted that any official ceremony would need to be an all-or-nothing affair, emphasizing a desire to throw a massive party and completely blow it out. Fans hoping for an intimate elopement will have to wait, as the duo envisions a grand celebration whenever the time finally arrives.

A Decade Of Partnership And Family Life

The stylish duo first sparked romantic links back in 2018 and eventually took the next step by getting engaged in late 2023. Their family grew even larger when they welcomed their first child, a baby daughter, in March 2024. Reflecting on their journey together, the 34-year-old singer and actress expressed genuine wonder that their relationship has spanned nearly ten years, calling it a beautiful thing that brings her immense happiness.

Navigating Busy Careers And Travel

Planning a lavish wedding has naturally taken a backseat due to the demanding nature of their professional schedules. Between international film shoots, world music tours, and managing life with a toddler across various temporary rentals, logistics have proven challenging. Waterhouse acknowledged that coordinating their busy lives becomes difficult when neither partner lives in a fixed location and constant travel is required.

Putting Down Roots In West London

Amid their nomadic lifestyle and packed work diaries, the couple shares a primary objective for the near future. Both actors are currently focused on establishing a permanent family sanctuary and putting down firm roots in West London for their young daughter. This domestic goal takes precedence over immediate wedding planning while they manage their demanding careers in the entertainment industry.

A Rock-Solid Connection

Despite relentless public interest, media scrutiny, and the trials of international travel, the bond between the Twilight star and the singer remains completely unshakable. Approaching nearly ten years together, their relationship continues to thrive amidst the chaos of Hollywood fame and parenthood. Whenever the famous pair eventually decide to host wedding bells, it is clear the event will be a major, unforgettable spectacle.

Suki Waterhouse has officially debunked rumors of a secret elopement with long-time partner Robert Pattinson. While they are not legally married yet after nearly a decade together, Waterhouse stated that any future wedding will be a massive celebration once they finish settling down in West London.

ld.articleBody:
Release Date Adjusted

Sean 'Diddy' Combs has experienced another shift in his timeline behind bars. Following a transfer to a new correctional facility, his expected departure date has been moved up by nearly a month.

Previously slated to conclude his sentence in the spring of 2028, the music figure now anticipates regaining his freedom significantly earlier in that same year, according to recent confirmations.

Facility Transfer

The change in schedule comes in the wake of the Revolt co-founder's relocation from a New Jersey institution to FCI Allenwood Low located in Pennsylvania.

The move occurred last month following various reports regarding his prison conditions, leading federal authorities to shift him to the new facility.

Previous Incidents at Fort Dix

During his time at FCI Fort Dix, the fifty-six-year-old entertainer was reportedly involved in several internal issues and difficulties with other inmates.

Media reports had previously surfaced detailing claims of preferential treatment and lavish living conditions while incarcerated, which sparked significant scrutiny and subsequent facility raids.

Medical Attention and Altercation Reports

Combs also required a hospital visit for a head injury during his stay in New Jersey. Documentation indicated the wound resulted from striking his head against a bunk bed.

Additionally, outlets reported on alleged physical tensions involving other high-profile inmates, though representatives for the Federal Bureau of Prisons disputed claims of specific altercations.

Legal Background

The artist, often recognized for tracks like 'Act Bad', was sentenced following legal proceedings last July where he faced conviction on two counts of transportation for prostitution.

That judgment resulted in a total sentence of fifty months behind bars, establishing the timeline that is now subject to the updated release scheduling.

ld.articleBody:
Looking Back at a Missed Marvel Opportunity

In a candid discussion about her extensive acting career, Amanda Seyfried recently revisited her decision to turn down a prominent superhero role within the Marvel Cinematic Universe. The performer, who is forty years old, explained that she was initially offered the part of Gamora in the popular sci-fi franchise Guardians of the Galaxy. Although the character ultimately became a defining role for fellow actress Zoe Saldana, Seyfried chose to pass on the opportunity when it was first presented to her.

Hollywood Trivia and Career Choices

The casting decision has since become a notable piece of Hollywood trivia, especially given the monumental success of the film and its subsequent sequels. While discussing her career choices during a retrospective event with the SAG-AFTRA Foundation, Seyfried touched upon the resurfaced interview moments that shed light on her reasoning from years prior.

Skepticism Over the Talking Tree and Raccoon

At the time the project was being developed, Seyfried felt strongly that the unique premise of the movie might not resonate with audiences. She admitted that the concept of featuring a talking tree and a talking raccoon felt entirely too risky for her career trajectory. Fearing that the unusual cinematic elements could lead to a critical failure, she opted to protect her professional standing by declining the part.

Reflecting on Past Miscalculations

Reflecting on her mindset during that period, she noted that she believed the film had a significant chance of turning out poorly. With a humorous perspective on her past miscalculation, the actress acknowledged that she was clearly incorrect about the ultimate reception of the blockbuster hit.

Personal Preferences and Makeup Trailers

Beyond her doubts regarding the movie's box-office potential, Seyfried had several practical concerns about the physical demands of playing an alien superhero. She expressed a strong dislike for spending prolonged hours sitting in a makeup chair, noting that she simply cannot sit still for long periods of time. Furthermore, the extensive prosthetics and specialized appearance required for the character did not align with her personal comfort.

Aversion to Stunts and Green Screens

The actress also pointed out her general aversion to performing stunts, dealing with heights, and acting against green screens where she would have to pretend the entire world around her existed only in imagination. She emphasized her need for tangible physical elements to hold onto during a performance rather than relying entirely on CGI environments.

Valuing Human Connections in Acting

For Seyfried, creative fulfillment often comes from working closely with other performers on grounded, real-life narratives. She has previously shared that filming a scene centered on human interaction and genuine emotional discussions feels much more rewarding to her than participating in large-scale fantasy productions.

No Regrets Over Franchise Appearance

Even with the benefit of hindsight, the actress maintains that she does not regret turning down the role. She made the decision based on what she wanted for herself and her future family, prioritizing personal peace and career contentment over a major franchise appearance.

News Overview

Amanda Seyfried discusses why she declined the role of Gamora in Guardians of the Galaxy. She cited fears of the film failing due to its unusual premise, as well as her dislike for extensive makeup, stunts, and green-screen acting. Despite the film's massive success, she holds no regrets about her decision.

ld.articleBody:
First-Look Images Released

MGM+ has provided audiences with an initial glimpse of its upcoming prequel series, Bosch: Start of Watch, featuring stars Cameron Monaghan and Omari Hardwick. The newly released photographs showcase the main actors ahead of the show's scheduled January debut.

The streaming network distributed these images to build anticipation for the origin story, highlighting the atmospheric setting and the central partnership between the two lead characters.

Premise and Background

The narrative of Bosch: Start of Watch serves as an origin story for the iconic detective Harry Bosch, originally created by author Michael Connelly. Set in 1992 Los Angeles, the plot transports viewers back to the earliest days of Bosch's career in law enforcement.

During this period, Los Angeles is portrayed as a city on the edge, characterized by severe racial tension, widespread gang violence, and a deeply fractured Los Angeles Police Department. The storyline follows a 26-year-old Bosch navigating these dangerous conditions.

Plot and Conflict

Amid routine police calls and escalating public unrest, the young rookie finds himself entangled in a high-profile heist. This event pulls him into a complex network of criminal corruption.

The unfolding situation challenges his dedication to his duties and puts his loyalty to the badge to the ultimate test, ultimately shaping his future as the detective driven by the personal code that everybody counts or nobody counts.

Cast and Characters

Cameron Monaghan steps into the role of rookie police officer Harry Bosch, while Omari Hardwick portrays veteran officer Eli Bridges, who serves alongside him.

The supporting cast features Ariana Guerra as Rosa and JD Pardo as Cory as series regulars. Additional appearances include Kathleen Wilhoite, William Fichtner, Rafi Gavron, Raphael Sbarge, Azita Ghanizada, Kenneth Miller, Seamus Dever, Ryan McPartlin, Marco Rodriguez, and Shelli Boone across the eight-episode season.

Production and Creative Team

The prequel series is produced by Fabel Entertainment. Tom Bernardo and Brian Anthony serve as co-creators and executive producers, with Bernardo also taking on the responsibilities of showrunner.

Additional executive producers include Michael Connelly, Henrik Bastin, Jamie Boscardin Martin, Stephen Kay, and Jasmine Russ. Mark Douglas works as a co-executive producer, and Theresa Snider acts as co-executive producer for Hieronymus Pictures.

Premiere Schedule and Regions

Bosch: Start of Watch is set to premiere on Sunday, January 10, launching with the release of its first two episodes. Subsequent episodes will air on a weekly schedule leading up to the season finale on Sunday, February 21.

The series will be available for streaming on MGM+ across multiple territories, including the United States, United Kingdom, Belgium, Ireland, Italy, Germany, Netherlands, Spain, and Latin America.

ld.articleBody:
Tour Rejections Across the United States

American rapper Macklemore stated that multiple prominent US concert venues refused to host his Free Palestine tour. Nine distinct facilities across the country declined to let him secure dates through the conclusion of the year.

Among the locations that turned down the booking requests were New York's Madison Square Garden and the Kia Forum located in Los Angeles. The artist expressed that such an obstacle was entirely unprecedented throughout his extensive touring career spanning more than twenty years.

Recent European Performances

Prior to the difficulties encountered in the United States, the rapper successfully completed a series of three concert dates in Europe dedicated to the same cause. These performances took place in Dublin, Paris, and London.

The primary goal of these European concerts was to raise charitable funds intended for organizations that support the Palestinian people. Following these events, the musician intended to bring the fundraising tour home to domestic audiences before facing widespread venue denials.

Previous Removal From Ed Sheeran Tour

The tension surrounding the artist's public statements began months prior during the summer season. In August, he was removed from his position as the opening act on musician Ed Sheeran's concert tour.

At that time, Macklemore explained that stadium owners had raised objections regarding him stating the phrase 'Free Palestine' while performing on stage. This initial removal served as a precursor to the broader booking roadblocks he would later encounter in the US.

Venue Responses and Availability Claims

Representatives for MSG Entertainment, the organization operating Madison Square Garden alongside other properties, addressed the situation through a public statement. They asserted that their facilities rank among the busiest venues globally and suffer from extremely limited availability.

Furthermore, the spokesperson for MSG Entertainment claimed that Macklemore is simply not an arena-level act. Meanwhile, representatives for the Kia Forum did not immediately provide responses to requests for comment regarding the rejected tour dates.

Artist Statements on Freedom of Speech

Addressing the situation on social media, the rapper emphasized the contradictions he perceived within the American cultural and political landscape. He noted that the nation frequently prides itself on upholding freedom of speech.

However, he argued that society has reached a juncture where a small group of billionaires holds the power to dictate acceptable causes. According to the musician, these individuals essentially decide which voices are welcome and which human lives are deemed worthy of defense.

Broader Conflict Background and Context

The geopolitical backdrop of the tour involves the ongoing conflict in Gaza and Israel. The military assault by Israel commenced following an attack led by Hamas fighters in southern Israel on October 7, 2023, which resulted in the deaths of about 1,200 people.

Subsequent actions by Israeli forces have led to a death toll exceeding 74,000 according to Palestinian authorities. While Israeli officials maintain that their military actions constitute justified self-defense, the immense casualties have sparked international protests and artistic activism worldwide.

Future Plans and Collaborations

Despite facing severe pushback from major domestic arena operators, the performer remains committed to his advocacy efforts. He announced plans to continue working alongside fellow artists and independent organizers.

Through these collaborative partnerships, he aims to stage additional performances dedicated to supporting the Palestinian cause, bypassing traditional mainstream venues if necessary to deliver his message and raise funds.

While venue representatives cited limited availability and status, the artist criticized the cancellations as a suppression of free speech and vowed to pursue future benefit performances with other organizers.

Previous Removal From Ed Sheeran Tour

The tension surrounding the artist's public statements began months prior during the summer season. In August, he was removed from his position as the opening act on musician Ed Sheeran's concert tour.

At that time, Macklemore explained that stadium owners had raised objections regarding him stating the phrase 'Free Palestine' while performing on stage. This initial removal served as a precursor to the broader booking roadblocks he would later encounter in the US.

Venue Responses and Availability Claims

Representatives for MSG Entertainment, the organization operating Madison Square Garden alongside other properties, addressed the situation through a public statement. They asserted that their facilities rank among the busiest venues globally and suffer from extremely limited availability.

Furthermore, the spokesperson for MSG Entertainment claimed that Macklemore is simply not an arena-level act. Meanwhile, representatives for the Kia Forum did not immediately provide responses to requests for comment regarding the rejected tour dates.

Artist Statements on Freedom of Speech

Addressing the situation on social media, the rapper emphasized the contradictions he perceived within the American cultural and political landscape. He noted that the nation frequently prides itself on upholding freedom of speech.

However, he argued that society has reached a juncture where a small group of billionaires holds the power to dictate acceptable causes. According to the musician, these individuals essentially decide which voices are welcome and which human lives are deemed worthy of defense.

Broader Conflict Background and Context

The geopolitical backdrop of the tour involves the ongoing conflict in Gaza and Israel. The military assault by Israel commenced following an attack led by Hamas fighters in southern Israel on October 7, 2023, which resulted in the deaths of about 1,200 people.

Subsequent actions by Israeli forces have led to a death toll exceeding 74,000 according to Palestinian authorities. While Israeli officials maintain that their military actions constitute justified self-defense, the immense casualties have sparked international protests and artistic activism worldwide.

Future Plans and Collaborations

Despite facing severe pushback from major domestic arena operators, the performer remains committed to his advocacy efforts. He announced plans to continue working alongside fellow artists and independent organizers.

Through these collaborative partnerships, he aims to stage additional performances dedicated to supporting the Palestinian cause, bypassing traditional mainstream venues if necessary to deliver his message and raise funds.

American rapper Macklemore stated that nine US concert venues, including Madison Square Garden and the Kia Forum, refused to book his Free Palestine tour following his earlier removal from Ed Sheeran's tour in August. While venue representatives cited limited availability and status, the artist criticized the cancellations as a suppression of free speech and vowed to pursue future benefit performances with other organizers.

ld.articleBody:
Theatrical Distribution Plans

The upcoming feature film Wind of Change, centered around the iconic German rock band Scorpions, has officially locked in its theatrical distribution paths. Fox Entertainment Studios and Ali Afshar's ESX Entertainment are bringing the project to audiences, with Roadside Attractions handling the North American theatrical rollout scheduled for March.

Before the film arrives in North American cinemas, it will first premiere in the band's home country. Warner Bros. Germany is set to distribute the picture across German theatres in January, giving local fans the very first look at the biographical drama.

Tracing Roots and Historical Impact

The narrative arc of the movie follows the group's journey beginning from its formation roots in 1965 through its eventual climb to international superstardom. A central theme of the project focuses on how the musicians managed to bridge the cultural divide between East and West, bringing rock and roll music behind the Iron Curtain.

The title itself is directly inspired by the band's massive 1991 power ballad, which emerged as a defining musical anthem signalling the end of the Cold War. The track served as a powerful symbol of hope, peace, and unity following a turbulent period that included a failed coup attempt against Soviet President Mikhail Gorbachev by Communist Party hardliners.

Global Success and Iconic Soundtrack

Upon its original release, the title single achieved staggering worldwide success, topping international music charts and accumulating global sales of 14 million copies. The film's musical backdrop will also feature several of the group's other enduring classics, including 'Rock You Like a Hurricane' and 'Still Loving You'.

Over their decades-long career, the Scorpions have successfully sold more than 110 million albums worldwide, solidifying their reputation as one of the most successful musical exports to ever emerge from Germany.

Cast and Creative Team

The biographical drama features a talented ensemble cast portraying the real-life musicians and key figures of the era. Alexander Dreymon steps into the role of lead and rhythm guitarist Rudolf Schenker, while Ludwig Trepte takes on the character of frontman Klaus Meine.

Additionally, Ed Speleers portrays lead guitarist Matthias Jabs, and Luke Brandon Field appears as drummer Herman Rarebell. The production also features Dominic West as renowned music manager Doc McGhee and David Kross as Andrej, an imprisoned friend of the band residing on the opposite side of the Berlin Wall.

Production and Behind-The-Scenes Leadership

Behind the camera, the film is guided by director Alex Ranarivelo working from a script written by Mark Andrews. The production effort is a collaborative endeavor between Fox Entertainment Studios and ESX Entertainment, partnering alongside Warner Bros.

The roster of producers steering the project includes ESX Entertainment's Ali Afshar, Christina Moore, and Daniel Aspromonte. They are joined on the production team by Fox Entertainment Studios representatives Fernando Szew, Hannah Pillemer, Ani Kevork, and Larry Grimaldi.

Studio Perspectives on the Project

Executives from the studios involved have expressed great enthusiasm for the film's unique cultural message and broad theatrical appeal. Prentiss Fraser, president of Fox Entertainment Global, highlighted that the band's ambitions stretched far beyond standard fame into fostering profound global change.

Roadside Attractions co-presidents Howard Cohen and Eric d'Arbeloff echoed these sentiments, emphasizing that while the group's hits defined the MTV generation, the extraordinary tale of taking music beyond the Iron Curtain demonstrates how artists can genuinely inspire people to alter the course of the world.

News Overview

The biographical feature film Wind of Change will debut in German cinemas in January through Warner Bros. Germany before arriving in North American theatres in March via Roadside Attractions. Directed by Alex Ranarivelo and starring actors such as Alexander Dreymon and Ludwig Trepte, the movie chronicles the Scorpions from their 1965 roots to international stardom behind the Iron Curtain.

ld.articleBody:
A Journey from Garage Startup to Global Producer

Producer Namit Malhotra has opened up about the immense hardships he faced early in his professional life, revealing that he lost ninety percent of his accumulated wealth back in 2008. Reflecting on his humble beginnings, he recalled starting out at just nineteen years old as a garage entrepreneur working alongside his teachers on an Apple computer.

Today, the landscape looks remarkably different for the filmmaker, whose family boasts a massive net worth estimated at sixteen thousand crore rupees according to the Hurun India Rich List for 2026. Now fifty years old, Namit stands at the helm of one of the most ambitious cinematic undertakings in modern Indian film history.

The 2008 Financial Setback in Los Angeles

In his quest to bridge Eastern and Western filmmaking traditions, Namit relocated to the United States in 2007 with aspirations of establishing a truly global enterprise. However, his grand ambitions faced a severe roadblock just a year later when the global financial recession crippled markets and devastated immigrant businesses across America.

Recalling those turbulent times, the producer acknowledged how close he came to losing everything during the economic downturn. Bouncing back from that catastrophic loss to spearhead a massive international production has given him a profound sense of accomplishment and disbelief at how far his career has traveled.

Hosting a Special Los Angeles Showcase

Ahead of his upcoming cinematic venture, Namit recently organized an exclusive special screening at the Academy Theater located in Los Angeles. He described the gathering as his very own personal Oscar moment, drawing a poetic parallel to the dreams he harbored as a teenager tinkering with computers in a makeshift workspace.

Addressing the attendees, the producer relished the opportunity to speak without interruption, celebrating the milestone in the legendary city of dreams. The event served as a prelude to the worldwide release of his upcoming project, bringing international industry peers together to witness a glimpse of the monumental retelling.

An Eight-Time Oscar Winning Visual Effects Legacy

A cornerstone of Namit's success lies in his visual effects powerhouse, DNEG, which has built an extraordinary reputation on the global stage. The company and its dedicated teams have triumphed at the Academy Awards on eight separate occasions, securing seven of those prestigious accolades over the past eleven years alone.

Through DNEG, Namit has collaborated with some of the most celebrated visionary directors of the modern era, including cinematic heavyweights like Christopher Nolan and Denis Villeneuve. This world-class VFX expertise forms the bedrock of the cutting-edge technology being deployed for his current cinematic adaptation.

Family Roots and Gratitude for Supporters

Coming from a lineage deeply rooted in the film industry as part of a third-generation movie family, Namit credited his foundational push into production to his filmmaker father. He emphasized that his initial foray into post-production and visual effects was always driven by a steadfast ultimate goal of making movies.

During his address, the producer made a point to express deep gratitude toward his parents, Nita and Naresh Malhotra, alongside his wife. He acknowledged that their unwavering support and belief in his overarching vision provided the emotional pillar necessary to weather his early financial storms.

Inside the Ambitious Ramayana Project

Scheduled for a worldwide multilingual theatrical rollout on November 5, the two-part screen adaptation of the timeless Indian epic Ramayana carries a staggering reported budget of four thousand crore rupees. The magnum opus is directed by Nitesh Tiwari and co-produced by Yash, positioning it as one of the largest independent productions globally.

The feature boasts a star-studded primary cast featuring Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Ravi Dubey in pivotal lead roles. They are joined by an expansive supporting ensemble that includes well-known actors such as Rakul Preet Singh, Vivek Oberoi, Lara Dutta, and Arun Govil.

News Overview

He hosted a Los Angeles showcase for his upcoming four thousand crore rupee Ramayana adaptation, highlighting his company's eight Oscar wins in visual effects.

The multilingual two-part film directed by Nitesh Tiwari and co-produced by Yash is slated for release on November 5, featuring stars like Ranbir Kapoor and Sai Pallavi.

ld.articleBody:
The Grand Announcement Of RC17

Actor Ram Charan and visionary filmmaker Sukumar are joining forces once again for a brand new pan-India cinematic venture temporarily titled RC17. The project has officially commenced its journey in the industry, generating immense excitement among fans and trade circles alike.

The production banner Mythri Movie Makers officially shared the news with audiences through social media, posting a striking promotional poster on their official Instagram handle to mark the beginning of this ambitious undertaking.

A Major Creative Reunion

This upcoming movie serves as a major reunion between the acclaimed RRR star and the master storyteller Sukumar. Their previous partnership resulted in the 2018 blockbuster Rangasthalam, which achieved massive critical acclaim and commercial success.

Given the triumphant history of their last creative outing, expectations for RC17 are exceptionally high as the actor-director duo looks to recreate their cinematic magic on an even larger pan-India scale.

Traditional Pooja Ceremony And Muhurat

The journey of RC17 officially got underway with a traditional pooja ceremony. According to an official press release issued by the makers, the grand muhurat event was scheduled to take place on Sunday directly on the film's set.

The production team confirmed the commencement of work with an enthusiastic caption accompanying their social media announcement, officially welcoming the megastar and the director to the new venture.

Looking Back At Rangasthalam

The monumental success of Rangasthalam remains a key milestone in both Ram Charan's and Sukumar's careers. The 2018 rural drama captivated audiences globally and crossed a phenomenal milestone by earning over Rs 210 crore at the worldwide box office.

That film starred Samantha Ruth Prabhu alongside Charan and featured Jagapathi Babu as the formidable, corrupt village president Phanindra Bhupathi, whose thirty-year tyranny drove the narrative.

Plot And Character Legacy Of Rangasthalam

Rangasthalam centered around a village subjected to intimidation, land seizures, and debt exploitation under an autocratic leader. The core storyline ignited when Charan's character sought vengeance for the brutal murder of his elder brother, Kumar Babu, who had fought to protect the village.

The gripping narrative and raw rural backdrop established a high benchmark for regional cinema that later crossed boundaries to achieve widespread national and international appreciation.

Ram Charan's Recent Professional Ventures

Before embarking on this new pan-India undertaking, Ram Charan was recently seen starring in the film Peddi. In that project, he portrayed a dedicated laborer in 1980s rural Andhra Pradesh.

His role in Peddi highlighted a character who successfully overcomes a severe physical injury to transform into a dedicated track athlete, further showcasing his versatility as a leading actor.

News Overview

Actor Ram Charan and filmmaker Sukumar are reuniting for a pan-India project titled RC17, produced by Mythri Movie Makers following their 2018 hit Rangasthalam. A grand pooja ceremony and muhurat event were held on the film's set to celebrate the commencement of this major collaboration.
