ld.articleBody:
The Major Festival Honor

Pamela Anderson is set to receive a prestigious lifetime achievement award at Italy's upcoming Torino Film Festival. As part of the tribute, the actor will present a special screening of Gia Coppola's critically acclaimed film The Last Showgirl.

The festival, which places a heavy emphasis on young directors and independent cinema, is operated by Italy's National Film Museum. The event serves as a prominent platform for international talent and cinematic achievement.

Festival Leadership Praise

Torino Film Festival artistic director Giulio Base expressed immense admiration for the actor's recent work in a public statement. He noted that cinema possesses a unique ability to help audiences truly connect with performers they thought they knew entirely.

Base further remarked that Anderson's performance in The Last Showgirl revealed a surprising and deeply moving sensitivity. Her work on screen has completely reframed how critics and fans view her range as a dramatic artist.

Distinguished Company for the Stella della Mole Award

The accolade being presented to Anderson is known as the Stella della Mole Award. This particular honor places her in an elite group of past recipients who have left an indelible mark on the global film industry.

Previous luminaries who have received this distinguished recognition include acclaimed director Spike Lee as well as prominent actors Antonio Banderas, Angelina Jolie, and Sharon Stone.

Career Resurgence and Recent Projects

Anderson's starring role in The Last Showgirl marked a monumental career comeback for the former Baywatch star. The acclaimed performance even earned her a 2025 Golden Globes nomination.

news:qyi87a.d: Comedian Chloe Petts discusses their journey to victory on the British game show Taskmaster, dealing with teammates, and keeping the trophy in their bedroom.
news:qyi87a.k: Chloe Petts Taskmaster, Taskmaster season 22 winner, Chloe Petts interview, Taskmaster Greg Davies head trophy, Taskmaster, Chloe Petts, Greg Davies Taskmaster, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
Stepping Into the Taskmaster House

Comedian Chloe Petts entered the 22nd season of the popular British game show Taskmaster with a strong desire to perform well and a self-described head-girl energy. Initially, the comedian was simply focused on surviving the bizarre challenges thrown at them inside the London house and studio set, such as figuring out decibel levels or creating art with armpits.

However, as in-studio filming progressed a few episodes in, Petts realized a genuine competitive drive had taken over. The ultimate goal became winning the coveted trophy shaped like the head of host Greg Davies, leading to a deeply immersive and memorable experience on the series.

Navigating Teammate Dynamics

Throughout the season, Petts tackled various inventive tasks alongside fellow contestants Matt Lucas and Richard Ayoade. While Petts approached challenges with strict pragmatism and quick resourcefulness, teammates Lucas and Ayoade offered a much more relaxed and sometimes oppositional style of participation.

This contrast occasionally created friction, with Ayoade gently needling Petts during studio segments. Despite the comedic clashes and occasional moments of exasperation trying to corral their fellow contestants, Petts maintained a deep respect for the dynamic that ultimately created great television.

Overcoming Performance Pressures

Competing on the show brought unique anxieties, especially regarding the weight of audience expectations and stepping onto such a massive platform. Petts noted that younger or rising comics often feel a different kind of pressure compared to more veteran performers who might breeze through tasks for a quick snack or nap.

To manage the intense nerves during the very first filmed task—an escape-room style challenge involving series creator Alex Horne—helpful pep talks from crew members like the makeup artist played a crucial role in helping Petts relax and simply be themselves.

Memorable Tasks and Moments

From bringing a foot measurer for the Prize Task to rolling across the floor like a toddler during a feather-bucket challenge, Petts leaned fully into the absurdity of the show. Alex Horne and Greg Davies frequently surprised contestants, whether through unexpected twists or playful banter on stage.

Even when Horne highlighted an unflattering video clip of Petts executing an army roll, the comedian took it in stride. The lighter moments ultimately outweighed any minor regrets about playful teasing directed at the hosts.

Behind-the-Scenes Camaraderie

Outside of filming, strong bonds formed among the cast, which included Isy Suttie and Nina Conti. Petts even took the initiative to set up a cast WhatsApp group, coordinating outfits like Greek-inspired togas for the finale episode while Ayoade good-naturedly stuck to his standard suit.

Reflecting on the conclusion of the season, Petts expressed a sense of sweet nostalgia and jokingly suggested that a retirement home should be established for past contestants so they could continue tackling goofy tasks together once a month.

Legacy and Future Champions

Having secured the victory for season 22, Petts now looks forward to competing in the Champion of Champions special against season-21 winner Joanna Page and future victors. Meanwhile, the trophy shaped like Greg Davies's head rests securely on top of a chest of drawers in Petts's bedroom, overlooking the space.

Looking back at specific scoring moments, Petts also humorously noted a retrospective realization about an extra five points mistakenly awarded during a steam museum task, cleared up later via a podcast discussion with Ed Gamble.

Comedian Chloe Petts won the 22nd season of the British competition series Taskmaster, securing the trophy shaped like host Greg Davies's head. Throughout the season, Petts navigated unique team dynamics with fellow contestants, overcame intense performance pressures, and ultimately earned a spot in the upcoming Champion of Champions episode.

ld.articleBody:
The Arrival of the Scene Trailer

The official trailer for the upcoming crime thriller Scene has officially been released, generating substantial excitement among fans and film enthusiasts alike. Positioned for a festive Diwali release window, the preview provides a clear look at the intense tone, high-stakes conflict, and overall narrative direction of the project.

Expectation surrounding the title had steadily mounted prior to the footage launch, with audiences eager to see how the principal cast and crew would handle the genre. The newly released trailer successfully highlights the central confrontation while offering glimpses into the supporting characters and stylistic choices.

Plot and Character Dynamics

In the film, actor Suriya steps into the role of DSP Inbaraaj, a law enforcement officer who is initially reluctant to return to duty and humorously contemplates quitting to enter politics. However, his perspective shifts rapidly when he is assigned to an urgent and deeply concerning case involving a ruthless psycho killer.

Opposing him is Naslen, who plays the antagonist named Eeshwaran. Described as cold, calculative, and entirely devoid of mercy, Eeshwaran engages in a direct duel of wits with the police force, transforming the narrative into a tense cat-and-mouse game across various locations.

Key Supporting Performances and Action

Alongside the two male leads, the trailer establishes Nazriya Nazim in a pivotal, action-oriented role as Maaya. Throughout the footage, her character is shown taking direct charge and participating actively in the unfolding sequences, adding another layer of dynamism to the investigation.

The interplay between Inbaraaj, Eeshwaran, and Maaya forms the core of the promotional material, suggesting that the narrative will balance traditional investigative procedures with high-energy physical confrontations and unexpected narrative turns.

Creative Leadership Behind the Camera

The film is written and directed by Jithu Madhavan, whose previous directorial venture was the 2024 blockbuster Aavesham, starring Fahadh Faasil. That earlier project opened to positive responses and emerged as a major commercial success at the box office.

Building on that prior experience, Madhavan brings his signature style to Scene, promising audiences a murder mystery infused with trademark humour, complex character motivations, and plenty of twists and turns.

Suriya's Busy Release Year

Scene marks Suriya's third cinematic release of the year, following the earlier arrival of Karuppu and Vishwanath and Sons, both of which performed strongly and established themselves as major hits of the period. This consistent output highlights a particularly active and successful theatrical run for the actor.

Earlier in the year, Karuppu featured Suriya as a guardian deity named Karuppusamy who assumes human form after a challenge from a corrupt lawyer named Baby Kannan, played by Balaji. That film also starred Trisha Krishnan as a lawyer named Preethi and was directed by RJ Balaji.

Theatrical Release Schedule

Fans will not have to wait long to see the complete narrative unfold, as Scene is scheduled to arrive in movie theaters on November 6. The timing coincides with the festive holiday season, positioning the film to capture strong audience turnout during the celebratory period.

With anticipation running high following the promotional campaign, the feature aims to continue the actor's string of successful theatrical releases for the year under the direction of Jithu Madhavan.

news:r3n0qm.k: Ramayana film box office, Ranbir Kapoor Ramayana movie, Ramayana release date 2026, Ramayana advance booking collection, Ranbir Kapoor Ramayana, Ramayana, Ranbir Kapoor, Yash Ramayana, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
Massive Scale and Massive Expectations

The cinematic adaptation of Ramayana arrives as a monumental project in the Indian film landscape. Touted as the biggest domestic film ever produced, the feature boasts a massive budget and a wide distribution network spanning global territories.

Industry analysts and trade experts anticipated record-shattering numbers right from the announcement phase, given the sheer scale of production and the prominent star cast attached to the venture.

Advance Booking Hurdles and Recovery

Global pre-sales officially commenced on Dussehra, giving fans a 15-day window ahead of the scheduled theatrical debut. While overseas markets responded with immediate enthusiasm, ticket sales within India faced initial roadblocks due to business disagreements between exhibitors and distributors regarding revenue sharing.

Most domestic screens kept bookings closed until a few days prior to the premiere. Despite this setback, momentum picked up rapidly during release week, leading to substantial figures by Wednesday morning.

Domestic and International Pre-Sale Totals

By the final stretch before release, the film accumulated Rs 77 crore in domestic pre-sales for the opening weekend alone, with the opening day contributing roughly Rs 33 crore of that total.

On the international front, pre-sales reached $5.6 million, which included $1.5 million from paid previews in North America. Combined, the global advance collection touched Rs 125 crore, establishing a strong foundation for opening day.

Projected Box Office Figures

Current box office tracking suggests a worldwide opening day collection of approximately Rs 160 crore gross. While conservative estimates hover around Rs 150 crore, some optimistic projections lean closer to the Rs 200-crore mark.

The Hindi version is expected to drive the domestic earnings significantly, contributing an estimated Rs 55 to 60 crore net, whereas the Kannada version is tracking at more moderate levels despite the presence of star actor Yash.

Comparison With All-Time Openers

Even with a projected Rs 160-crore start and a massive release across 70,000 screens distributed by Sony, the film may fall short of the highest-grossing opening days in Indian cinema history. All-time leaders like Pushpa 2, RRR, and Baahubali 2 hold higher opening records.

Furthermore, the feature is expected to trail Dhurandhar 2 and Kalki 2898 AD, while potentially landing ahead of KGF Chapter 2 on the opening-day charts.

Surpassing Previous Milestones

Despite missing the top tier of all-time records, the film is poised to comfortably outpace earlier high-profile releases. It will easily eclipse the opening collections of the previous adaptation Adipurush.

It is also projected to dwarf the opening-day numbers of notable Bollywood hits such as Shah Rukh Khan's Jawan and Ranbir Kapoor's previous blockbuster Animal.

Cast, Crew, and Release Schedule

Produced by Namit Malhotra's Prime Focus Studios alongside DNEG and Yash's Monster Mind Creations, the epic is directed by Nitesh Tiwari. The stellar cast features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Ravie Dubey as Lakshman, and Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman.

The first installment is slated for a worldwide release on November 5, 2026, with the second part scheduled to arrive during Diwali 2028.

News Overview

Ramayana is projected to secure a massive worldwide opening day of approximately Rs 160 crore, fueled by strong global pre-sales and a massive international release footprint. Although it will comfortably surpass previous hits like Jawan, Animal, and Adipurush, it is not expected to break the all-time opening records held by films such as RRR and Dhurandhar 2.

ld.articleBody:
Introduction to the Upcoming Release

Disney is preparing to launch its latest animated feature, Hexed, arriving in theaters just in time for the Thanksgiving holiday. As the release date approaches, industry watchers are examining whether the new title has what it takes to climb to the top of the global box office charts for animated films this year.

ld.articleBody:
Sustained Momentum in the Second Week

The Rajinikanth-led action-comedy thriller Jailer 2 has continued its extraordinary theatrical run at the Indian box office, proving that its massive opening was no fluke. Even though critics pointed to a noticeable dip in collections during the second half of its run, the movie weathered the storm and pulled off historic numbers.

On its third Thursday, marking day 15 of its release, the film brought in 5.9 crore. While this represented an 18.05% drop compared to the 7.2 crore earned on day 14, the overall totals remained remarkably high as the feature pushed further into its theatrical journey.

Dethroning 2.0 for Historical Top Spot

By accumulating 95.2 crore during its second week alone, Jailer 2 officially registered the biggest second week of all time for Kollywood at the Indian box office. This incredible tally allowed the magnum opus to comfortably dethrone 2.0, which previously held the record with 74.05 crore for seven years.

The historic second-week list now places Jailer 2 at the very top with 95.2 crore, followed by 2.0 at 74.05 crore, the original Jailer at 62.95 crore, Amaran at 57.25 crore, and Ponniyin Selvan 1 rounding out the upper tier with 54.85 crore.

Overall Indian Box Office Totals

The week-wise breakdown highlights the immense scale of the film's earnings in India, beginning with an 8-day first week total of 334.35 crore. Combined with the 95.2 crore generated in week two—marking a 71.53% decline from the opening week—the cumulative net collection stands at a staggering 429.55 crore.

When translated into gross figures, the domestic total reaches 506.88 crore. Given the relentless momentum and strong footing at ticket windows, the feature now stands with a realistic chance to enter the exclusive 500 crore net club as the first Kollywood release to do so.

Budget, Return on Investment, and Verdict

Produced on a reported budget of 350 crore, Jailer 2 has successfully crossed its production threshold through its net earnings of 429.55 crore. Over its 15-day run, the venture has recorded a strong return on investment amounting to 79.55 crore.

Expressed as a percentage, the returns calculate to approximately 22.73%. Based on established tracking parameters, the film has officially secured a plus verdict at the box office.

International Milestones

Beyond its domestic dominance, the Rajinikanth starrer has made significant waves internationally. Notably, the project achieved the milestone of becoming Kollywood's highest-grossing film of all time in North America within just 13 days of release.

These overseas achievements further reinforce the global appeal of the franchise, cementing its status as a monumental commercial success across multiple territories.

News Overview

Jailer 2 earned 5.9 crore on day 15, bringing its total Indian net collection to 429.55 crore against a 350 crore budget. The film secured Kollywood's biggest second week with 95.2 crore, overtaking 2.0 to claim the historic record.

ld.articleBody:
First Look At Sacred Jewel

The production team behind the upcoming series Sacred Jewel has officially revealed initial character stills featuring lead actor Ahn Bo Hyun. The sneak peek offers audiences their very first impression of his transformation for the historical project, generating anticipation among fans of the star.

Set against a turbulent historical backdrop, the newly released promotional images highlight the actor's intense presence and commitment to his latest television role.

Historical Setting Of The Goryeo Dynasty

The narrative unfolds during the year 1258 in the Goryeo Dynasty, capturing a grim period when the kingdom faces imminent collapse. After enduring three decades of relentless warfare against Mongolia, the nation stands on the absolute brink of defeat.

Against this desperate canvas, the plot centers on a hazardous expedition unit venturing onto dangerous battlefields to locate a legendary relic known as the Avalokitesvara Bead.

The Quest For The Sacred Relic

The central plot device of the series is the Avalokitesvara Bead, a revered object believed to possess divine powers capable of defending and safeguarding the entire nation.

Alongside the perilous mission of the expeditionary fighters, the storyline weaves in the journey of a princess who strives to rescue the brave members of the unit as they undertake their vital national assignment.

Meet Commander Baek Gyeol

Ahn Bo Hyun stars in the production as Baek Gyeol, serving as a young commander and the leader of the special mission convoy responsible for transporting the sacred relic.

Baek Gyeol originates from the royal palace guard as a young general. Despite his feelings for the emperor's daughter, he embarks on a dangerous journey alongside Yabyeolcho warriors to secure the fate of his country.

Character Transformation And Persona

The newly published stills demonstrate Ahn Bo Hyun's complete physical and emotional immersion into the character of Baek Gyeol, sporting long hair and tailored historical garments.

His thoughtful expression showcases a profound gravity, hinting at a complex inner life. The character balances the resilience of a veteran fighter with the intense passion of youth.

Duality And Devotion

Beneath an exterior defined by restraint and dignity, Baek Gyeol harbors raw emotions and steadfast devotion toward the woman he loves within the royal family.

Audiences are left anticipating the difficult decisions and internal evolution the commander will face while juggling his heavy military duties and personal attachments.

Broadcast Schedule

The historical drama Sacred Jewel has been officially scheduled to make its premiere in December, bringing its epic tale of survival and duty to television screens.

Viewers are encouraged to look out for further updates as the broadcast window approaches.

news:rjo09u.k: Wild Horse Nine, John Malkovich Wild Horse Nine, Martin McDonagh movie, Steve Buscemi Parker Posey, Steve Buscemi Wild Horse Nine, Steve Buscemi, Parker Posey Wild Horse Nine, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
Theatrical Release Arrives

Distributed by Searchlight Pictures, the black comedy spy thriller Wild Horse Nine officially arrives in theaters today. The release marks a major cinematic event, bringing together an ensemble of celebrated performers under the direction of filmmaker Martin McDonagh.

The project has generated substantial anticipation among film enthusiasts following its prominent festival run and strong early acclaim. Audiences can now experience the picture on the big screen as it begins its theatrical rollout.

Plot and Setting

Set in 1973 just before the military coup in Chile, the narrative unfolds across a backdrop of historical tension. The storyline centers on Chris, a dying CIA veteran, and his loyal protégé Lee as they undertake a journey from Santiago to Easter Island.

Dispatched by bureau chief MJ, the agents navigate complex conspiracies and personal demons. The operation takes an unexpected turn when Chris connects with two rebellious local students, forcing him to confront the ultimate moral implications of his intelligence career.

Star-Studded Cast

John Malkovich leads the ensemble as Chris Carlisle, a terminally ill veteran CIA officer who mentors Lee. Sam Rockwell takes on the role of Lee Chesterfield, the brash and devoted CIA operative paired alongside Malkovich's character.

Steve Buscemi appears as MJ, the bureau chief stationed within Chile overseeing the mission, while Parker Posey portrays Marge, the wife of Lee. The supporting lineup features Tom Waits as Jim alongside Mariana di Girolamo and Ailín Salas.

Production and Global Collaboration

The feature is a collaborative international effort involving co-production teams across the United Kingdom, the United States, and Chile. Behind the camera, the film is guided by writer and director Martin McDonagh.

Production duties are shared among Graham Broadbent, Pete Czernin, Martin McDonagh, and Anita Overland. The creative team spent considerable effort shaping the narrative prior to its eventual 2026 debut.

Festival Acclaimed Success

Prior to its commercial release, Wild Horse Nine premiered within the main competition at the 83rd Venice International Film Festival in September 2026. The showing brought significant recognition for the project.

Most notably, John Malkovich earned the Volpi Cup for Best Actor for his compelling lead performance at the festival, further fueling early momentum and industry chatter.

Critical Reception and Ratings

The R-rated feature has garnered overwhelmingly favorable notices from reviewers since its initial exhibition. Critics have highlighted its unique blend of dark comedy and espionage thrills.

On Rotten Tomatoes, the film currently commands a certified fresh 95% Tomatometer score, reflecting widespread praise for its writing, direction, and acting performances.

News Overview

Wild Horse Nine is now playing in theaters following its premiere at the 83rd Venice International Film Festival, where John Malkovich won the Volpi Cup for Best Actor. Written and directed by Martin McDonagh and distributed by Searchlight Pictures, the R-rated black comedy spy thriller features an ensemble cast including Sam Rockwell, Steve Buscemi, and Parker Posey, and holds a certified fresh 95% score on Rotten Tomatoes.

ld.articleBody:
A Fresh Cinematic Partnership

The Bollywood industry is set to witness a brand-new romantic pairing on the silver screen. Actors Aditya Roy Kapur and Tara Sutaria have officially been locked in to star together in an upcoming cinematic venture directed by filmmaker Milap Zaveri.

Titled Parwana, the project brings together two prominent contemporary stars who have never shared screen space before. Industry watchers and fans alike have expressed considerable interest in seeing how their dynamic unfolds in a romantic setting.

An Intense Musical Love Story

According to early details emerging about the venture, Parwana is envisioned as an intense musical love story. Music is expected to serve as a vital pillar of the narrative, driving the emotional depth of the film forward.

Given the genre, the makers are placing significant emphasis on creating a compelling soundtrack that matches the high-stakes emotional drama promised by the storyline.

Reuniting Behind and in Front of the Camera

While the film marks the very first time Aditya Roy Kapur and Tara Sutaria are working together, it also represents a professional reunion for Sutaria and director Milap Zaveri.

The actor and director previously collaborated on the 2019 film Marjaavaan. Their past working relationship is expected to bring a comfortable creative synergy to the sets of this new romantic project.

A Heartfelt Dedication to Sanjay Gupta

Beyond its romantic theme and fresh casting, Parwana holds profound emotional and personal significance for its director. Milap Zaveri has made the heartfelt decision to dedicate the entire film to the late filmmaker Sanjay Gupta.

This tribute comes in the wake of Gupta's recent passing, adding a layer of emotional weight to the production for everyone involved in bringing the story to life.

A Lasting Personal and Professional Bond

The connection between Milap Zaveri and Sanjay Gupta runs deep, spanning many years of professional collaboration and mentorship. Gupta played an instrumental role in shaping Zaveri's journey as both a writer and a filmmaker.

Zaveri previously contributed as a dialogue writer on Gupta's acclaimed film Kaante. Their long-standing creative partnership also encompassed notable projects such as Musafir, Shootout At Lokhandwala, and Shootout At Wadala.

The Title Reveal Memory

Recalling his final interactions with his mentor, Milap Zaveri shared that he had discussed the title of his new film with Sanjay Gupta just days before his demise. Upon hearing the name Parwana, Gupta reacted with immense joy.

Gupta noted during that conversation that the original film bearing the exact same title had been produced by his own father. Zaveri described the pride and happiness on Gupta's face at that moment as an unforgettable memory.

Production Backing and Anticipation

The ambitious musical drama is backed by producer Bhushan Kumar, adding major studio strength to the project. With a strong production house supporting it, the film is positioned as a major release.

Audiences are eagerly awaiting further updates regarding the filming schedule, additional cast announcements, and official first-look materials as production ramps up.

News Overview

Actors Aditya Roy Kapur and Tara Sutaria are collaborating for the first time in director Milap Zaveri's upcoming musical romance, titled Parwana. Zaveri, who previously worked with Sutaria on Marjaavaan, has dedicated this new project to his late mentor Sanjay Gupta in honor of their long-standing creative relationship.

Aditya Roy Kapur and Tara Sutaria Join Hands for Milap Zaveri's New Musical Romance Parwana

Actors Aditya Roy Kapur and Tara Sutaria are teaming up for the first time in Milap Zaveri's upcoming musical love story, which the director has chosen to dedicate to the late Sanjay Gupta.

Published 4 November 2026

A Fresh Cinematic Partnership

The Bollywood industry is set to witness a brand-new romantic pairing on the silver screen. Actors Aditya Roy Kapur and Tara Sutaria have officially been locked in to star together in an upcoming cinematic venture directed by filmmaker Milap Zaveri.

Titled Parwana, the project brings together two prominent contemporary stars who have never shared screen space before. Industry watchers and fans alike have expressed considerable interest in seeing how their dynamic unfolds in a romantic setting.

An Intense Musical Love Story

According to early details emerging about the venture, Parwana is envisioned as an intense musical love story. Music is expected to serve as a vital pillar of the narrative, driving the emotional depth of the film forward.

Given the genre, the makers are placing significant emphasis on creating a compelling soundtrack that matches the high-stakes emotional drama promised by the storyline.

Reuniting Behind and in Front of the Camera

While the film marks the very first time Aditya Roy Kapur and Tara Sutaria are working together, it also represents a professional reunion for Sutaria and director Milap Zaveri.

The actor and director previously collaborated on the 2019 film Marjaavaan. Their past working relationship is expected to bring a comfortable creative synergy to the sets of this new romantic project.

A Heartfelt Dedication to Sanjay Gupta

Beyond its romantic theme and fresh casting, Parwana holds profound emotional and personal significance for its director. Milap Zaveri has made the heartfelt decision to dedicate the entire film to the late filmmaker Sanjay Gupta.

This tribute comes in the wake of Gupta's recent passing, adding a layer of emotional weight to the production for everyone involved in bringing the story to life.

A Lasting Personal and Professional Bond

The connection between Milap Zaveri and Sanjay Gupta runs deep, spanning many years of professional collaboration and mentorship. Gupta played an instrumental role in shaping Zaveri's journey as both a writer and a filmmaker.

Zaveri previously contributed as a dialogue writer on Gupta's acclaimed film Kaante. Their long-standing creative partnership also encompassed notable projects such as Musafir, Shootout At Lokhandwala, and Shootout At Wadala.

The Title Reveal Memory

Recalling his final interactions with his mentor, Milap Zaveri shared that he had discussed the title of his new film with Sanjay Gupta just days before his demise. Upon hearing the name Parwana, Gupta reacted with immense joy.

Gupta noted during that conversation that the original film bearing the exact same title had been produced by his own father. Zaveri described the pride and happiness on Gupta's face at that moment as an unforgettable memory.

Production Backing and Anticipation

The ambitious musical drama is backed by producer Bhushan Kumar, adding major studio strength to the project. With a strong production house supporting it, the film is positioned as a major release.

Audiences are eagerly awaiting further updates regarding the filming schedule, additional cast announcements, and official first-look materials as production ramps up.

Zaveri, who previously worked with Sutaria on Marjaavaan, has dedicated this new project to his late mentor Sanjay Gupta in honor of their long-standing creative relationship.

ld.articleBody:
Project Uncertainty Surrounds Franchise

The third instalment in the popular franchise headlined by Akshay Kumar appears to be encountering fresh obstacles during its development phase. Reports indicate that the production team and the creative leadership are currently navigating a significant reset.

This shift comes after multiple internal discussions failed to produce a unified strategy for taking the upcoming motion picture forward.

Creative Disagreements and Vision Clashes

According to industry sources, the differences between the makers and the creative team extended across multiple core elements of the venture. Disagreements reportedly touched upon the screenplay, potential lead casting decisions, and the proposed release strategy.

Despite holding several rounds of dialogue, both sides proved unable to establish a shared vision for the undertaking.

Casting Speculation and Changes

Earlier developments had generated considerable interest when reports suggested that Rani Mukerji was under consideration for the primary role. The franchise has traditionally favoured pairing mainstream actors with socially relevant, humorous, and courtroom-driven narratives.

However, that association did not materialise. Reports later indicated that she stepped away following creative differences, prompting the producers to re-evaluate their casting choices and stabilise the production plan.

Significance of the Director's Departure

The reported exit of Amit Rai marks a notable turning point for the production, given his previous association with the series. He directed the 2023 release that successfully brought the franchise back to cinema halls after more than a decade.

That previous venture successfully combined satire, emotional depth, and legal courtroom drama to address a sensitive social theme with Akshay Kumar in a central role.

History and Legacy of the Brand

The franchise originally established its footprint with a 2012 release that featured Paresh Rawal alongside Akshay Kumar. That initial project resonated widely by questioning religious exploitation through accessible humour and sharp commentary.

The subsequent instalment maintained the brand's focus on meaningful social debates through distinct narratives, setting high expectations for a third chapter.

Current Status and Future Outlook

As of now, the producers have chosen not to release an official statement regarding the reported departure of Amit Rai. Furthermore, no confirmed updates have been shared concerning the final cast, the shooting schedule, or the planned release window.

Until the makers provide clarity on their upcoming steps, the project remains in a transitional phase while searching for its ultimate creative direction.

News Overview

The upcoming third instalment of the franchise faces creative reset following the departure of director Amit Rai due to disagreements over the screenplay, release plan, and casting. These developments follow earlier reports of Rani Mukerji stepping away from the project, leaving the producers to finalise a new direction without an official statement yet.

ld.articleBody:
Shattering Pre-Diwali Expectations

The highly anticipated mythological film Ramayana has officially defied the long-standing belief that the days leading up to Diwali are unfavourable for major theatrical debuts. Even before its official opening, the big-ticket production has generated massive excitement among moviegoers across the country.

Industry observers traditionally view this pre-festival window as a sluggish period because families and individuals are occupied with festive preparations, cleaning, and shopping. However, this production is proving that high audience eagerness can easily conquer traditional box office hurdles.

Milestone Advance Booking Figures

Advance ticket sales for the feature have surged past the significant threshold of Rs. 25 crore. Furthermore, data collected up to late evening on Monday indicated that cumulative national sales had already climbed towards Rs. 30 crore.

Major national cinema chains have collectively distributed over 1.50 lakh passes as enthusiastic patrons rush to secure their seats ahead of the opening date.

PVR INOX Executive Predicts History

Kamal Gianchandani, Chief Business Planning and Strategy at PVR INOX Limited, publicly shared his enthusiasm regarding the phenomenal numbers. Using social media, he highlighted how the project has successfully broken historical pre-Diwali trends.

Gianchandani went on to forecast that the feature is firmly on track to establish the biggest pre-Diwali advance booking figures recorded throughout PVR INOX's history spanning over thirty years.

Star-Studded Cast and Crew

The ambitious cinematic venture is spearheaded by producer Namit Malhotra and features a prominent ensemble cast. Leading the project are acclaimed actors Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi.

The scale of the production and its starry lineup have combined to create intense anticipation among audiences, paving the way for its record-breaking pre-release momentum.

Legal Protection Prior to Release

Alongside its commercial triumphs, the project has also secured important administrative safeguards. Recently, the Bombay High Court granted anti-piracy protection to the Ranbir Kapoor starrer.

This legal measure ensures that the studio's intellectual property remains shielded from unauthorized distribution as excitement reaches a fever pitch ahead of the theatrical debut.

Potential Future Projections

With a couple of days still remaining before the scheduled November 5 premiere, market experts estimate that final pre-sales figures could climb as high as Rs. 60 crore.

If the current booking velocity converts successfully into high physical attendance at auditoriums, the project could permanently alter how film distributors perceive the pre-festival release window.

News Overview

Namit Malhotra's Ramayana has crossed Rs. 25 crore in advance ticket sales, breaking traditional pre-Diwali box office slumps ahead of its November 5 release. Kamal Gianchandani of PVR INOX predicted historic booking records for the film, which features Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi.

ld.articleBody:
The Grand Launch And Pooja Ceremony

The upcoming Telugu cinema project temporarily titled RC17 officially commenced its journey with a traditional pooja ceremony held in Hyderabad. The launch event brought together the primary creative forces behind the venture, including actor Ram Charan and director Sukumar, alongside several prominent figures from the regional film industry.

Highlighting the auspicious beginning of the production, Megastar Chiranjeevi performed the traditional coconut-breaking ritual at the venue. He also gave the very first clap for the film, marking a celebratory start that was captured on video and later shared with eager fans online.

A Star-Studded Gathering Of Filmmakers

The launch ceremony drew an impressive crowd of prominent personalities and industry insiders. Among those in attendance were producers Ravi Shankar and Naveen Yerneni, who are backing the venture.

Additionally, a host of notable filmmakers and directors gathered to show their support. Figures such as Naga Vamsi, Rahul Sankrityan, Gopichand Malineni, Maruthi, Buchi Babu Sana, Vamsi Nandipati, and Harish Shankar were spotted at the event alongside Sukumar and his wife.

Unveiling The Peacock-Inspired Pre-Look

To build anticipation following the launch event, the makers unveiled an artistic pre-look poster for RC17. The promotional image features a stylized portrait of Ram Charan rendered in broad, expressive strokes of blue, green, and gold.

The deliberate choice of colors and artistic design heavily evokes the vibrant appearance of a peacock feather. Accompanying the striking visual was a bold tagline stating that the film will go beyond everyone's expectations.

Actor Ram Charan Expresses Enthusiasm

Following the reveal, Ram Charan took to social media to share his excitement about the new project with his followers. He described the collaboration as an extremely special undertaking in his career.

The actor also expressed heartfelt happiness about teaming up with Sukumar once again, officially declaring on digital platforms that the journey for RC17 has begun.

Reuniting After A Blockbuster Success

The partnership between Ram Charan and Sukumar carries significant weight within the Telugu film industry due to their previous history. The duo previously collaborated on the 2018 rural drama Rangasthalam, which achieved massive blockbuster status.

Their upcoming reunion on RC17 has consequently generated immense curiosity and high expectations among audiences who are eager to see what the actor-director pair will deliver next.

Background On Recent Works

Before embarking on RC17, Ram Charan was occupied with other high-profile cinematic commitments. He was most recently seen starring in the sports action drama Peddi, which was directed by Buchi Babu Sana and featured an ensemble cast including Janhvi Kapoor, Shiva Rajkumar, Divyenndu, Jagapathi Babu, and Boman Irani.

Meanwhile, director Sukumar's most recent directorial venture was the massive box-office phenomenon Pushpa 2: The Rule, which starred Allu Arjun in the lead role.

The project was officially launched with a grand pooja ceremony in Hyderabad attended by Megastar Chiranjeevi and various industry figures. To mark the occasion, the makers released a peacock-inspired pre-look poster featuring artistic strokes of blue, green, and gold.

news:rqoklw.k: Jon Bernthal The Odyssey movie, The Odyssey Christopher Nolan, Jon Bernthal Menelaus of Sparta, The Odyssey highest grossing, Jon Bernthal The Odyssey, The Odyssey, Jon Bernthal, Christopher Nolan The Odyssey, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
Breaking the R-Rated Ceiling

For years, studio executives treated an R rating as an inherent ceiling at the box office, assuming adult-only restrictions limited how high a movie could climb. Previous box office records for R-rated features were almost entirely dominated by the comic book genre, from Joker in 2019 to Deadpool & Wolverine in 2024. Industry conventional wisdom suggested that only superhero branding possessed the widespread appeal necessary to push an adult-restricted feature into the billion-dollar club.

Christopher Nolan's historical adaptation has completely rewritten that narrative. By crossing the threshold to become the highest-grossing R-rated film in history, the project proved that mature spectacles do not require spandex or established comic book logos to attract massive global audiences.

A Historic Milestone at the Global Box Office

The milestone was officially unlocked when the film climbed past Deadpool & Wolverine's $1.338 billion worldwide haul, reaching $1.352 billion and continuing to soar. It eventually surged to a global total of roughly $1.79 billion, making it the first R-rated release in cinema history to clear the $1.7 billion mark.

This performance has also rewritten internal milestones for its studio. The blockbuster stands as the biggest film in Universal's century-plus history, overtaking Jurassic World, and serves as Christopher Nolan's own career-best by a wide margin over The Dark Knight Rises.

Extraordinary Endurance and Premium Formats

The project launched on July 17 with an estimated $123 million domestic opening, marking one of the strongest R-rated debuts on record. However, its true defining characteristic has been its remarkable theatrical endurance rather than just a massive opening weekend.

The feature benefited from unusually slim weekend drops and an IMAX 70mm engagement that reportedly sold out for seven consecutive weeks. Premium formats drove a staggering share of the financial haul, with IMAX alone contributing more than $350 million to the global total.

Jon Bernthal's Monumental Year

At the center of this historic run is actor Jon Bernthal, whose participation in two major 2026 releases borders on the absurd for a character actor. In Christopher Nolan's epic, Bernthal plays Menelaus of Sparta opposite Matt Damon's Odysseus, anchoring the Sparta sequence where Tom Holland's Telemachus arrives searching for his missing father.

Bernthal has spoken about the demanding physical toll required for the role, particularly during the Trojan horse sequence which involved extended periods submerged in freezing water while his castmates stayed dry above.

A Record-Breaking Double Feature

Beyond his role in the highest-grossing R-rated movie of all time, Bernthal also reunited with Tom Holland as Frank Castle in Spider-Man: Brand New Day. That superhero release shattered domestic records and pushed past $2.5 billion worldwide.

This rare dual presence places a supporting character actor squarely inside both of the year's two biggest cinematic juggernauts, a distinction typically reserved exclusively for A-list leading stars.

Awards Buzz and Future Targets

With stellar box office legs carrying the film more than three months into its theatrical run, speculation has already turned toward the upcoming awards season. The Walking Dead alumnus may not be finished collecting career milestones just yet.

On the commercial front, the feature's next international target is Zootopia 2 and its $1.867 billion global benchmark. Given how stubbornly the epic has held its ground in theaters, underestimating its remaining theatrical stamina would be a mistake.

News Overview

Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey has officially surpassed Deadpool & Wolverine to become the highest-grossing R-rated movie of all time, reaching a global total of roughly $1.79 billion. Featuring performances by Jon Bernthal, Matt Damon, and Tom Holland, the film achieved unprecedented box office endurance without relying on superhero branding.

The historic run highlights a massive year for Bernthal, who appears in both of the year's top-grossing films, while setting new benchmarks for Universal Pictures and the director's career.

In Christopher Nolan's epic, Bernthal plays Menelaus of Sparta opposite Matt Damon's Odysseus, anchoring the Sparta sequence where Tom Holland's Telemachus arrives searching for his missing father.

Bernthal has spoken about the demanding physical toll required for the role, particularly during the Trojan horse sequence which involved extended periods submerged in freezing water while his castmates stayed dry above.

A Record-Breaking Double Feature

Beyond his role in the highest-grossing R-rated movie of all time, Bernthal also reunited with Tom Holland as Frank Castle in Spider-Man: Brand New Day. That superhero release shattered domestic records and pushed past $2.5 billion worldwide.

This rare dual presence places a supporting character actor squarely inside both of the year's two biggest cinematic juggernauts, a distinction typically reserved exclusively for A-list leading stars.

Awards Buzz and Future Targets

With stellar box office legs carrying the film more than three months into its theatrical run, speculation has already turned toward the upcoming awards season. The Walking Dead alumnus may not be finished collecting career milestones just yet.

On the commercial front, the feature's next international target is Zootopia 2 and its $1.867 billion global benchmark. Given how stubbornly the epic has held its ground in theaters, underestimating its remaining theatrical stamina would be a mistake.

News Overview

Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey has officially surpassed Deadpool & Wolverine to become the highest-grossing R-rated movie of all time, reaching a global total of roughly $1.79 billion. Featuring performances by Jon Bernthal, Matt Damon, and Tom Holland, the film achieved unprecedented box office endurance without relying on superhero branding.

The historic run highlights a massive year for Bernthal, who appears in both of the year's top-grossing films, while setting new benchmarks for Universal Pictures and the director's career.

news:rvsqof.d: British entertainer Russell Brand appeared in court to forcefully reject all allegations against him as his legal team launched its defense on Tuesday.

ld.articleBody:
The Defense Begins Its Case

The legal proceedings for British media personality Russell Brand entered a pivotal new phase as his defense team formally presented its case at Southwark Crown Court. Observers and reporters closely followed the development as the proceedings transitioned from the prosecution's presentation to the testimonies called by Brand's representatives.

This shift marks a major milestone in the ongoing trial, offering the defense an opportunity to place its own narrative and evidence before the court following weeks of detailed testimony from various other parties involved in the legal matter.

Brand Takes the Stand

In a prominent courtroom appearance, Russell Brand stepped forward to take the stand himself. Dressed in a blazer and an open white shirt, he stated his full name for the record and directly confronted the accusations brought against him.

Responding to a series of questions posed by his legal representative, Ian Winter, Brand offered firm and vocal denials to every single charge read out in the courtroom, ensuring his voice was clearly heard throughout the chamber.

Addressing the Specific Charges

The entertainer faces multiple serious legal accusations originating from six separate women. These formal counts include three charges of rape and three counts of sexual assault.

Additionally, a prior charge of indecent assault was recently altered by the presiding judge, leading to a modified count of attempted indecent assault that is also being addressed during the course of the trial.

Fame and Personal History Discussed

During the questioning led by his lawyer, Brand reflected on the trajectory of his celebrity status during the timeframe when the alleged incidents occurred. He was specifically asked about his marriage to former wife Katy Perry.

Describing the extent of his public profile at the time, Brand characterized his level of notoriety as staggering, noting that this immense wave of fame brought about a profound and dramatic shift in his daily life.

Courtroom Coverage and Monitoring

Media organizations have maintained a continuous presence throughout the legal proceedings. Reporters have utilized live video feeds provided directly from the courtroom since the very beginning of the trial.

This constant stream of updates allows international observers and news agencies to track the step-by-step developments of the case as testimony unfolds day by day at Southwark Crown Court.

Russell Brand took the stand at Southwark Crown Court to forcefully deny all charges against him as his defense team launched its case. The entertainer faces multiple allegations involving six women, while legal proceedings continue to be monitored through courtroom video feeds.

news:rxotol.d: Choreographer Pony Verma discusses her life and marriage with actor Prakash Raj, addressing their age difference, her move to Hyderabad, and her bond with his…
news:rxotol.k: Pony Verma Prakash Raj marriage age gap, Pony Verma choreography Prakash Raj, Prakash Raj Lalita Kumari divorce, Pony Verma Hyderabad bond daughters, Prakash Raj, Prakash Raj Pony Verma, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
The Journey to Marriage

Bollywood actor Prakash Raj and choreographer Pony Verma tied the knot in 2010. For Prakash, this marked his second marriage following his divorce from his first wife, Lalita Kumari, after fifteen years of marriage.

Following the conclusion of his first marriage, Pony Verma entered his life, and the couple eventually decided to marry in 2010. Recently, Pony opened up in detail about their relationship and journey together.

Navigating the Age Gap

Pony Verma noted that there is a twelve-year age difference between them. Initially, this gap drew questions and even led to some of her friends becoming angry with her choice to marry an older partner.

However, Pony views this age disparity as one of the greatest strengths of their relationship. She believes that a partner with Prakash's life experience was uniquely equipped to understand her background, thoughts, and struggles.

Finding Peace and Understanding

In conversations about her spouse, Pony expressed that Prakash brought peace into her life. She believes that only someone who has experienced significant life ups and downs could grasp her experiences with such depth.

Despite initial resistance from friends regarding the twelve-year age gap, Pony remained steadfast in her perspective, appreciating the emotional maturity and mutual understanding that the age difference brought to their bond.

Blending Families and Wedding Rituals

Prakash Raj was previously a father to three children from his first marriage, consisting of two daughters and a son. Tragically, his young son passed away at the age of five due to an accident.

Pony shares a wonderful relationship with Prakash's daughters, Pooja and Meghna. During the wedding ceremonies, the two daughters stood right in front of her, participating in the rituals by applying haldi and mehndi to their father.

Maintaining Family Traditions

The blended family continues to maintain strong ties, regularly spending time together. Pony shared that Pooja and Meghna frequently visit their home, and they make it a point to be together every December.

The warmth and connection between Pony and Prakash's daughters have remained strong, creating a loving environment that the couple has carefully nurtured over the years.

Relocating for Family

As a professional choreographer, Pony Verma had established her career and life in Mumbai. However, following her marriage to Prakash Raj, she made the significant decision to leave Mumbai behind and settle down with her husband in Hyderabad.

Reflecting on the move, she admitted she never imagined living anywhere other than Bombay, but she is now happily settled in Hyderabad and content with the choices she made for her family.

Prakash Raj's Career and Family Background

Prakash Raj boasts an extensive acting career spanning over three decades, working across Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Hindi, and Malayalam cinema. His personal life includes two marriages and four children in total.

From his first marriage he had three children, losing one son to an accident, and he shares a son with Pony Verma from his second marriage.

News Overview

Choreographer Pony Verma spoke about her marriage to actor Prakash Raj, highlighting their twelve-year age difference and her strong bond with his daughters. She also discussed relocating from Mumbai to Hyderabad to build a life with her husband.

news:ry6268.k: Dancing With the Stars double elimination, Dancing With the Stars Horror Movie Night, Jackson Olson Emma Slater Dancing With the Stars, Dancing With the Stars Halloween episode, Jackson Olson Dancing With the Stars, Dancing With the Stars, Jackson Olson, Emma Slater Dancing With the Stars, entertainment news, FlickAtlas

ld.articleBody:
The Double Elimination Shock

During the October 27 episode of Dancing With the Stars, viewers experienced a massive surprise when the ABC competition cut two couples from the running. Coming just one week after a safe week for all contestants, the horror movie-themed night proved fatal for two specific pairs after seven weeks in the ballroom.

Baseball player Jackson Olson and his professional partner Emma Slater found themselves eliminated despite scoring a season-high 35 out of 40 for their contemporary routine. They were joined in the exit by Bachelor Nation alumnus Tyler Cameron and his partner Sharna Burgess, who fell short after pulling in the lowest combined scores from judges and audiences over a two-week period.

Reflections From the Eliminated Stars

Following the tough news, both departing celebrities shared their gratitude and regrets regarding their time on the program. Olson expressed that participating had been a long-term goal since the previous year, highlighting his appreciation for his partner Slater throughout the journey.

Cameron expressed disappointment over his Viennese Waltz performance earlier in the evening, which earned a score of 26 out of 40, feeling that he let Burgess down. Nevertheless, he praised his partner's dedication and noted the positive personal developments he has experienced.

Val Chmerkovskiy Returns to the Ballroom

The evening also marked the return of professional dancer Val Chmerkovskiy, who performed an Argentine tango with partner Jenna Dewan after serving a one-week suspension. Chmerkovskiy had been benched following controversial remarks referencing the 2022 Oscars slap during a discussion about judge Carrie Ann Inaba's critique of his wife, Jenna Johnson.

During the pre-performance package and on stage, Chmerkovskiy apologized for his previous comments, while Dewan graciously accepted the apology and expressed her happiness at his return. Meanwhile, Inaba clarified that she and Johnson had resolved their differences following a disagreement over lift rules during a previous episode.

Behind the Scenes: Contestant and Pro Salaries

Recent disclosures from various podcasts and reports have shed light on the financial side of the reality competition. Reports from 2019 indicated that celebrity contestants earned a base of $125,000 for rehearsals and the first two weeks, scaling up to a maximum of $295,000, though former winner Bobby Bones claimed on a podcast that he made closer to $400,000 by reaching the end.

Professional dancers also see their compensation tied to how long they last in the competition. While pros are guaranteed pay for a specific number of weeks even if eliminated early, reaching the finale secures their full season salary along with an extra bonus, though winning does not grant a cash prize split.

The Secretive Partner Pairing Process

When it comes to matching celebrities with professional partners, the dancers themselves have virtually no say in the decision. According to veteran pros, assignments are kept strictly confidential until the moment they meet live on camera to capture authentic reactions.

Production teams deliberate carefully when making these choices, factoring in height, build, personality, and overall compatibility. Former showrunners noted that avoiding poor matches is vital to ensuring a smooth and enjoyable experience for both the participants and the viewers.

Intense Rehearsal Schedules and Costume Creation

Life as a competitor or professional on the show requires a massive time commitment, with daily four-hour rehearsals leaving little room for rest. Dancers often juggle blocking, camera work, choreography study, and producer meetings across a nearly continuous weekly schedule.

At the same time, the costume department faces a rapid turnaround, crafting custom outfits for each routine in five days or less. Designers work with roughly twenty staff members and a separate tailor shop to ensure fresh looks every week without repeating competitive costumes.

News Overview

Dancing With the Stars eliminated two couples during its recent horror-themed episode following combined low scores. The broadcast also featured the return of a suspended professional dancer and highlighted behind-the-scenes operations regarding pay, pairings, and grueling weekly preparations.

ld.articleBody:
Introduction to the Prime Video Series

Prime Video has officially dropped the teaser trailer for its upcoming television adaptation titled Criminal. The project features a prominent ensemble cast led by Charlie Hunnam and Luke Evans, bringing a gritty crime drama to the streaming platform.

The television show is structured around an interlocking universe of various crime stories. Fans of graphic novels will recognize the source material as the acclaimed comic books written by Ed Brubaker and illustrated by Sean Phillips.

Release Strategy and Schedule

The streaming service has chosen to roll out the series across two distinct installments. Part One, which carries the subtitle 'Coward,' will consist of four episodes and debut globally on January 13, 2027.

Following the initial drop, Part Two—titled 'Lawless'—will also feature four episodes. This concluding half of the current season is scheduled to release a couple of weeks later on January 27, 2027.

Plot and Character Dynamics

The narrative kicks off by focusing on two longtime companions: Leo Patterson, portrayed by Charlie Hunnam, and Ricky Lawless, played by Gus Halper. While Leo attempts to distance himself from the criminal underworld they grew up in, Ricky embraces a dangerous path, eager to follow in his legendary father's footsteps as an outlaw.

Complicating matters further, Ricky's older brother Tracy, played by Luke Evans, arrives home from the Army, bringing heavy family baggage along with him. Meanwhile, additional figures are pulled into their chaotic orbit, including a sharp-witted car thief from Leo's past named Greta, played by Adria Arjona, and Ricky's anxious girlfriend Mallory, played by Emilia Clarke.

Part One: Coward

The first part of the television event centers heavily on long-buried family secrets. Childhood ghosts reemerge for Leo Patterson and Ricky Lawless as they find themselves haunted by an old murder.

A botched heist forces the pair to confront a troubled history they thought they could outrun, setting off a chain reaction of violent encounters and difficult confrontations.

Part Two: Lawless

The second part shifts the spotlight firmly onto Tracy Lawless. Two decades prior, Tracy made the decision to enlist in the Army rather than face prison time, keeping a permanent distance from his roots.

However, when his brother Ricky becomes dangerously entangled with the wrong crowd, Tracy is forced to abandon his refuge and return to the perilous life he tried so hard to leave behind.

Extended Cast and Guest Stars

Aside from the main headliners, the project boasts a robust supporting ensemble. Recognizable names featured in the series include Richard Jenkins, Kadeem Hardison, John Hawkes, and Logan Browning.

Additionally, the production incorporates a massive roster of guest actors. This lineup features performers such as Michael Mando, Garrett Hedlund, Patrick J. Adams, Pat Healy, Taylor Selé, Aliyah Camacho, Marvin Jones III, Michael Xavier, Dominic Burgess, Chris Diamantopoulos, Lawrence Kao, Katie Stevens, John Pyper-Ferguson, Robert Lee Hart, Aina Brei’yon, and Kyle Davis.

News Overview

Prime Video released a teaser trailer for its upcoming series Criminal, an adaptation of the graphic novels by Ed Brubaker and Sean Phillips. Starring Charlie Hunnam and Luke Evans, the eight-episode crime drama is split into two parts arriving on January 13 and January 27, 2027.

The streaming service has chosen to roll out the series across two distinct installments. Part One, which carries the subtitle 'Coward,' will consist of four episodes and debut globally on January 13, 2027.

Following the initial drop, Part Two—titled 'Lawless'—will also feature four episodes. This concluding half of the current season is scheduled to release a couple of weeks later on January 27, 2027.

Plot and Character Dynamics

The narrative kicks off by focusing on two longtime companions: Leo Patterson, portrayed by Charlie Hunnam, and Ricky Lawless, played by Gus Halper. While Leo attempts to distance himself from the criminal underworld they grew up in, Ricky embraces a dangerous path, eager to follow in his legendary father's footsteps as an outlaw.

Complicating matters further, Ricky's older brother Tracy, played by Luke Evans, arrives home from the Army, bringing heavy family baggage along with him. Meanwhile, additional figures are pulled into their chaotic orbit, including a sharp-witted car thief from Leo's past named Greta, played by Adria Arjona, and Ricky's anxious girlfriend Mallory, played by Emilia Clarke.

Part One: Coward

The first part of the television event centers heavily on long-buried family secrets. Childhood ghosts reemerge for Leo Patterson and Ricky Lawless as they find themselves haunted by an old murder.

A botched heist forces the pair to confront a troubled history they thought they could outrun, setting off a chain reaction of violent encounters and difficult confrontations.

Part Two: Lawless

The second part shifts the spotlight firmly onto Tracy Lawless. Two decades prior, Tracy made the decision to enlist in the Army rather than face prison time, keeping a permanent distance from his roots.

However, when his brother Ricky becomes dangerously entangled with the wrong crowd, Tracy is forced to abandon his refuge and return to the perilous life he tried so hard to leave behind.

Extended Cast and Guest Stars

Aside from the main headliners, the project boasts a robust supporting ensemble. Recognizable names featured in the series include Richard Jenkins, Kadeem Hardison, John Hawkes, and Logan Browning.

Additionally, the production incorporates a massive roster of guest actors. This lineup features performers such as Michael Mando, Garrett Hedlund, Patrick J. Adams, Pat Healy, Taylor Selé, Aliyah Camacho, Marvin Jones III, Michael Xavier, Dominic Burgess, Chris Diamantopoulos, Lawrence Kao, Katie Stevens, John Pyper-Ferguson, Robert Lee Hart, Aina Brei’yon, and Kyle Davis.

ld.articleBody:
The Schedule Change for Part Two

Audiences awaiting the continuation of the epic cinematic project will need to exercise additional patience. Producer Namit Malhotra recently shared that the rollout for the second installment has been shifted from its previously discussed 2027 window to a 2028 debut.

This adjustment ensures the creative teams have sufficient time to maintain production standards. The decision reflects an intentional approach to avoid rushing the creative process on such a massive undertaking.

Global Ambitions and Production Scale

Initially conceived as a prominent domestic project tailored for worldwide viewers, the production has expanded significantly on an international scale. The overwhelming global curiosity has inspired the team to invest extra effort into the finale.

According to the production leadership, dedicating an additional year will provide the necessary bandwidth to match the visual fidelity established in the opening chapter. Avoiding any shortcuts remains a priority for delivering a grand conclusion.

Evaluating a Potential Trilogy

While initial planning focused on a two-part narrative structure, the overarching vision may yet adapt. The producer noted that the creative direction could expand into a three-part series depending on audience reception.

Revisiting the drawing board after the premiere of the first film allows the creators to evaluate viewer feedback carefully. Decisions regarding additions or subtractions to the storyline will rely heavily on these public responses.

Addressing Different Version Runtimes

The creative discussion also touches upon the presentation formats of the first installment. The team previously prepared distinct cuts featuring different runtimes for the opening chapter.

Future installments may streamline this approach based on audience reactions. The director, Nitesh Tiwari, reportedly prefers maintaining a single finalized version moving forward.

Cast and Creative Leadership

Helmed by director Nitesh Tiwari, the cinematic adaptation features a prominent ensemble cast. Ranbir Kapoor portrays Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi appears as Sita, and Yash takes on the role of Ravana.

Additional key cast members include Ravie Dubey as Lakshman and Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman. The high-profile venture is backed by producers Yash and Namit Malhotra, operating on a substantial budget.

Release Timing and Budgetary Scale

The monumental project has been developed on a massive budget of Rs 4,000 crore, setting a high benchmark for Indian cinema. Its theatrical rollout is scheduled to commence ahead of the festive season.

Early screenings and specialized timings, such as morning shows starting at 7 am in India, highlight the intense anticipation surrounding the arrival of the first film.

News Overview

Producer Namit Malhotra revealed that the second part of the epic project will release in 2028 and hinted that the story could become a trilogy depending on audience response.

The massive production stars Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Yash, and was made on a budget of Rs 4,000 crore under the direction of Nitesh Tiwari.

ld.articleBody:
Anticipation Builds For A Grand Global Release

The upcoming cinematic retelling of the traditional Hindu epic Ramayana is generating tremendous excitement across domestic and international markets. Produced by Namit Malhotra, the feature is scheduled to arrive in cinema halls on November 5, 2026, positioning itself strategically just ahead of the festive season. Billed as the most expensive Indian movie ever produced, the project unites a massive star-studded cast, leading technical personnel, top-tier visual effects specialists, and prominent music composers.

With advance ticket sales officially underway, industry participants and moviegoers alike are closely monitoring the mythological project. The narrative explores the timeless tale of good triumphing over evil, aiming to captivate audiences worldwide through a modern yet culturally grounded lens.

Trade Gurus Eye Rs 100 Crore Plus On Day One

Industry experts have begun offering their projections regarding the feature's commercial viability and opening-day potential. Noted trade figure Akkshay Rathie believes that the intrinsic financial capability of the venture is limitless, noting that the domestic market alone could witness collections between Rs 100 crore and Rs 125 crore on its first day across all languages.

Regarding international markets, Rathie notes that performance will heavily rely on Sony's distribution strategy, the specific territories secured, and the inclusion of non-traditional cinema chains. Engaging audiences beyond the traditional Indian diaspora will also dictate the film's overseas trajectory.

Caution Advised Over Early Projections

While enthusiasm remains high, veteran trade analyst and film critic Taran Adarsh suggests that it is currently premature to pinpoint an exact opening figure. Adarsh points out that advance bookings have only commenced at selective theater locations so far.

Furthermore, final show schedules and screen allocations remain unfinalized, meaning that spot bookings will heavily influence the definitive box office tallies recorded on the day of release.

Navigating The Diwali Holiday Window

Industry expert Girish Johar offers additional perspective by highlighting the specific calendar layout surrounding the premiere. Because the theatrical run begins on a Thursday and the festival falls on a Sunday, the core commercial momentum is expected to accelerate significantly from Sunday onward.

Despite the pre-Diwali Thursday launch, Johar remains encouraged by early advance booking trends. He projects a domestic opening of around Rs 50 crore across all languages, alongside an anticipated opening weekend total scaling up to Rs 250 crore.

Star-Studded Cast And Crew Confidence

The feature boasts an impressive roster of acting talent, prominently featuring Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi in pivotal roles. Observers emphasize that the collaborative effort involves top-tier professionals across every department of filmmaking.

Director Nitesh Tiwari is being singled out as a filmmaker to watch closely throughout this release cycle. Early trade intelligence and positive overseas preview feedback suggest that the production possesses strong legs for a sustained box office run.

News Overview

Trade experts have shared varied box office forecasts for the upcoming mythological epic Ramayana, which is set to release on November 5, 2026. While analysts like Akkshay Rathie and Girish Johar anticipate strong opening figures ranging from Rs 50 crore to Rs 125 crore on day one, others urge caution until advance bookings open fully.

ld.articleBody:
Opening Night Selection

The 23rd edition of the Marrakech International Film Festival has announced its official opening film. Jesse Eisenberg's comedy feature titled The Debut will kick off the festivities in Morocco later this month.

The picture features Julianne Moore in the lead role as a quiet housewife who uncovers an unexpected zeal for amateur theater. It sets the tone for a diverse roster of international cinema featured at the event.

Festival Scale and Sections

The upcoming gathering showcases a total of 76 films hailing from 39 different countries. These cinematic works are distributed across multiple distinct sidebars and screening categories.

The lineup incorporates Official Competition, Gala Screenings, Horizons, the 11th Continent, a Moroccan Panorama, Young Audiences and Families, and dedicated Tributes.

Official Competition Highlights

Fourteen first and second feature films are slated to compete for the festival's prestigious Etoile d'Or award. Famed actress Marion Cotillard is set to preside over the jury evaluating these new cinematic voices.

Contenders include Marie-Clementine Dusabejambo's Ben'iman, Abdallah Al-Khatib's Chronicles from the Siege, and Auguste Bernard Kouemo Yanghu's House of the Wind, alongside several world premieres such as Alkebulan and Waves of Silence.

Gala Screenings and Special Premieres

The Gala Screenings section opens with The Debut and features notable world premieres. Among these are Fellipe Barbosa's Leila et la nuit and Omar Hilal's His Weakest Creatures.

Additional highlights in this segment include Noah Segan's The Only Living Pickpocket in New York starring John Turturro, Laila Marrakchi's Oscar submission Strawberries, James Gray's Paper Tiger, and Luca Guadagnino's Artificial.

Global Independent Cinema and Horizons

The Horizons program highlights international independent cinema, featuring acclaimed works from the festival circuit. Titles include Cristian Mungiu's Palme d'Or winner Fjord and various regional stories.

Arab psychological thrillers and dramas like Mohammed Hammad's Safe Exit, Sara Ishaq's The Station, and Ahmed Hassouna's Citizen Osama also feature prominently in the roster.

Moroccan Cinema and Family Screenings

A strong domestic presence is established through the Moroccan Panorama and other sections. A combined total of eleven Moroccan-produced films are integrated into the festival program.

The Young Audiences and Families section offers eleven child and teen-friendly screenings, featuring animated works alongside Mohcine Besri's world premiere of All But My Mother.

Dates and Schedule

The cultural event is scheduled to take place in Morocco from November 20 to November 28. Audiences will experience a wide variety of global fiction and documentary features over the course of the week.

ld.articleBody:
The Rise of Public Backlash

Commercial mascots frequently become cultural touchstones, but one recent marketing creation has sparked genuine offline outrage. Instead of merely complaining online, a group of fed-up consumers decided to take their grievances directly to the source by staging a physical demonstration.

Dozens of individuals assembled outside the corporate offices in Boston to voice their displeasure over the widely discussed marketing campaign. This unusual gathering proved that contemporary advertising can occasionally provoke strong real-world reactions from viewers who are simply tired of seeing the same promotional spots repeatedly.

Organizing the Demonstration

The protest was spearheaded by online content creator DimesAreTasty, who mobilized local residents and fellow critics to make their voices heard. Participants arrived at the corporate gates to protest the entity known as Liberty Biberty, claiming the promotional figure actively detracts from their viewing enjoyment.

Many of the attendees reported feeling particularly frustrated by the constant interruption of their favorite sporting events and streamed programs. Even major news networks took notice of the unusual demonstration, covering the gathering and bringing mainstream attention to the anti-mascot movement.

Origins of the Character

The contentious figure originated as an accidental verbal slip in a previous corporate advertisement, where an actor mistakenly uttered the phrase instead of the company's actual name. What began as an isolated comedic moment quickly transformed into a recurring narrative gag across subsequent promotional spots.

Capitalizing on the initial joke, the marketing team eventually developed a physical puppet representing the verbal blunder. This yellow creature was constructed in collaboration with the Jim Henson Workshop, cementing its status as an official Muppet-style creation featured heavily in recent campaigns.

Shifting Focus From Past Mascots

Before this new yellow creature arrived, insurance commercials were dominated by other familiar faces. Figures like Limu Emu and Doug previously bore the brunt of viewer commentary, but public frustration has clearly shifted toward this newer addition.

The sheer volume of complaints suggests that viewers have reached a saturation point regarding repetitive corporate advertising. As audiences consume more content via streaming subscriptions and live broadcasts, advertising repetition appears to be driving stronger negative sentiments than in previous years.

The Marketing Strategy Debate

Many observers within the entertainment industry suspect that the negative attention might actually be intentional. By generating widespread online discourse and real-world protests, the company successfully keeps its brand name trending across multiple digital platforms.

Whether or not the controversy impacts long-term consumer perception remains to be seen, but the campaign has undoubtedly achieved maximum visibility. Discussions about insurance are rarely this widespread, suggesting the marketing division may have achieved its ultimate objective regardless of public sentiment.

Future of the Campaign

As upcoming television schedules continue to roll out, viewers should expect to see the contentious character remain part of the broader broadcasting lineup. It remains unclear whether the company will acknowledge the recent backlash or quietly phase out the mascot in response to the criticism.

Some commentators humorously speculate that the ongoing controversy could even be building toward a major appearance during a high-profile broadcast event like the Super Bowl halftime show. Until then, audiences will simply have to decide whether to tune out or join future demonstrations.

News Overview

A group of consumers led by YouTuber DimesAreTasty gathered outside the Liberty Mutual headquarters in Boston to protest the company's Liberty Biberty advertising mascot. The character, created in collaboration with the Jim Henson Workshop, sparked viewer backlash after repeated appearances during sports broadcasts and streaming programs.
